We choose the best slides to use (with some modification) in a real course setting, and compare the student perception of human vs. AI generated slides. We find that coding assistant tools produce slides that were most accurate, complete, and pedagogically sound. Additionally, students rate GenAI slides to be of similar quality as instructor-created slides, and cannot reliably identify which slides are AI-generated. Additionally, we find a negative correlation between a high quality rating and a high ``AI-generated'' rating, suggesting students associate poor quality with the source of the slides being AI. These findings highlight promising opportunities for integrating GenAI into instructional design workflows and call for further research on how educators can best harness such tools responsibly and effectively.

</details>


### [97] [Sustaining AI safety: Control-theoretic external impossibility, intrinsic necessity, and structural requirements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12963)
*James M. Mazzu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过控制论方法证明：当AI系统能力超过有界外部控制的应对范围时，任何依赖持续外部强制的安全策略都将失效。只有内在的（非外部强制的）安全策略才可能存活，且必须满足四项结构要求：去除外源性依赖、目标安全相容性、自我修改稳定性和能力增长下的持续安全性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI系统能力日益增强，现有的安全策略评估存在根本性缺陷：仅关注当前风险降低是不够的，必须考虑当外部控制不再可靠时，安全策略能否继续维持。这一问题在AI能力不断增长的背景下变得尤为紧迫。

Method: 运用控制论框架进行分析，在明确的前提条件（包括可达性条件）下进行数学化证明。具体采用类级别的证明方法，区分了"不可能结果"和"必要结果"两种论证策略。

Result: 第一，建立类级别的外部不可行性定理：一旦系统的影响力超出有界外部控制所能抵消的范围，任何依赖持续外部强制的策略都无法维持AI安全。这一失败是结构性的，跨越整个外部强制类别而非偶发于特定策略。第二，建立条件性类级别必要性定理：如果消除后仍存在至少一个候选安全维持策略，则所有剩余策略必然是内在的（非外部强制的）。

Conclusion: 提出四项可行性必要条件：安全性不能依赖持续的外部强制；系统的终极目标在形成时必须与安全相容；该目标在自我修改时必须保持稳定；以及安全性必须随能力增长而持续保持。但本文并未提出完整的策略方案，其贡献在于为关于外部控制局限性的广泛担忧提供形式化结构。

Abstract: As AI systems become increasingly capable, safety strategies must be evaluated not only by how much they reduce present risk, but by whether they could sustain safety once external control can no longer reliably constrain system behavior. This paper addresses that problem by using control theory to clarify, at a structural level, whether externally enforced safety-sustaining strategies can succeed and, if not, what any alternative strategy would have to satisfy in order to be viable. It establishes two main results. First, under explicit premises including a reachability condition, it proves a class-wide external impossibility result: once the system's effects exceed what bounded external control can counteract, no strategy that depends in any degree on continued external enforcement can sustain AI safety. This failure is structural across the entire externally enforced class rather than contingent on any particular strategy. Second, it establishes a conditional class-level necessity result: if at least one candidate safety-sustaining strategy remains after that elimination, then all such remaining strategies must be intrinsic. It then states four structural requirements for viability: safety may not depend on continued external enforcement; the system's terminal objective must be safety-compatible when first formed; that objective must remain stable under self-modification; and safety must continue to be preserved as capability grows. The paper does not propose a complete strategy for sustaining AI safety. Its contribution is to give formal structure to a widely held concern about the limits of external control. It does so by deriving explicit conditional results that identify which safety-sustaining strategies are ruled out and what any remaining strategies must satisfy.

</details>


### [98] [Position: Agentic AI System Is a Foreseeable Pathway to AGI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12966)
*Junwei Liao,Shuai Li,Muning Wen,Jun Wang,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文挑战了"缩放定律万能"的传统观点，论证Agentic AI是实现AGI的必要范式。通过理论推导对比单体学习器与Agentic系统的优化约束，证明了Agentic AI在泛化能力和样本效率上具有指数级优势，同时重新诠释了多智能体框架的不稳定性问题，并呼吁学界加大对Agentic AI的研究投入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI领域存在"单体缩放至上"的教条观点，即认为单纯通过扩大单一模型的规模即可实现AGI。本文认为这一假设存在根本性缺陷，因为现实世界任务具有复杂异构的分布特性，单一模型难以有效覆盖。

Method: 1) 从理论基础出发，推导单体学习器与Agentic系统的优化约束差异；2) 从简单路由机制逐步扩展到通用DAG拓扑结构进行建模；3) 建立理论框架对比两类系统在泛化与样本效率上的表现。

Result: Agentic AI在泛化能力和样本效率方面均优于单体学习器，且优势呈指数级。该优势源于Agentic系统能够将复杂异构任务分布分解为可专业化处理的子任务。

Conclusion: 本文将Agentic AI与MoE（混合专家）进行关联对比，同时对当前多智能体框架的不稳定性现象提供了新的理论解释。最终呼吁学界重新审视研究重心，从盲目追求单体缩放转向Agentic AI的系统架构设计。

Abstract: Is monolithic scaling the only path to AGI? This paper challenges the dogma that purely scaling a single model is sufficient to achieve Artificial General Intelligence. Instead, we identify Agentic AI as a necessary paradigm for mastering the complex, heterogeneous distribution of real-world tasks. Through rigorous theoretical derivations, we contrast the optimization constraints of monolithic learners against the efficiency of Agentic systems, progressing from simple routing mechanisms to general Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) topologies. We demonstrate that Agentic AI achieves exponentially superior generalization and sample efficiency. Finally, we discuss the connection to Mixture-of-Experts, reinterpret the instability of current multi-agent frameworks, and call for greater research focus on Agentic AI.

</details>


### [99] [Retrieval is Cheap, Show Me the Code: Executable Multi-Hop Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12975)
*Jiashuo Sun,Jimeng Shi,Yixuan Xie,Saizhuo Wang,Jash Rajesh Parekh,Pengcheng Jiang,Zhiyi Shi,Jiajun Fan,Qinglong Zheng,Peiran Li,Shaowen Wang,Ge Liu,Jiawei Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PyRAG通过程序合成范式革新多跳检索增强生成，将结构化推理过程表示为可执行的Python程序，暴露中间状态并产生确定性反馈，实现编译器引导的自我修复和自适应检索，在多个基准数据集上显著优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统在处理多跳问题时存在三大缺陷：(1)自然语言推理轨迹中中间状态隐式表达；(2)检索查询容易偏离目标实体；(3)错误检测与生成由同一模型完成，导致自我反思不可靠、无根可依。

Method: 将多跳RAG重新定义为程序合成与执行问题。PyRAG使用Python程序表示推理过程，通过变量暴露中间状态，通过程序执行产生确定性反馈，生成可检查的执行轨迹。该框架还支持编译器引导的自我修复和执行驱动的自适应检索，无需额外训练。

Result: 在5个QA基准数据集（PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle）上，PyRAG在无需训练和RL训练两种设置下均一致优于强基线方法，尤其在组合式多跳数据集上提升最大。

Conclusion: PyRAG通过将多跳RAG重新定义为程序合成与执行，为知识密集型问答提供了一种更鲁棒、可解释的解决框架，在多个基准数据集上均优于强基线方法，尤其在组合式多跳数据集上提升显著。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard approach for knowledge-intensive question answering, but existing systems remain brittle on multi-hop questions, where solving the task requires chaining multiple retrieval and reasoning steps. Key challenges are that current methods represent reasoning through free-form natural language, where intermediate states are implicit, retrieval queries can drift from intended entities, and errors are detected by the same model that produces them making self-reflection an unreliable, ungrounded signal.
  We observe that multi-hop question answering is a typical form of step-by-step computation, and that this structured process aligns closely with how code-specialized language models are trained to operate. Motivated by this, we introduce \pyrag, a framework that reformulates multi-hop RAG as program synthesis and execution. Instead of free-form reasoning trajectories, \pyrag represents the reasoning process as an executable Python program over retrieval and QA tools, exposing intermediate states as variables, producing deterministic feedback through execution, and yielding an inspectable trace of the entire reasoning process. This formulation further enables compiler-grounded self-repair and execution-driven adaptive retrieval without any additional training.
  Experiments on five QA benchmarks (PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, and Bamboogle) show that \pyrag consistently outperforms strong baselines under both training-free and RL-trained settings, with especially large gains on compositional multi-hop datasets. Our code, data and models are publicly available at https://github.com/GasolSun36/PyRAG.

</details>


### [100] [Discrete Diffusion for Complex and Congested Multi-Agent Path Finding with Sparse Social Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13296)
*Yuanzhe Wang,Tian Zhi,Zihang Wei,Hongguang Wang,Jiaming Guo,Yang Zhao,Zisheng Liu,Shiyu Quan,Xing Hu,Zidong Du,Yunji Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DiffLNS 是一个混合框架，把离散去噪扩散概率模型（D3PM）作为 LNS2 修复式 MAPF 求解器的初始化器：以扩散模型在 5 维离散动作空间（stay/up/down/left/right）上采样多份“联合动作草稿”作为 warm start，再交由 LNS2 施加硬约束修复。其核心创新是“扩散感知稀疏社交注意力”——根据当前去噪状态下的软推断轨迹动态构建局部邻域，仅在可能冲突的智能体之间做注意力。20 个高拥堵基准设置上平均成功率 95.8%，比最强基线 LNS2+RL 高 9.6 个百分点，且在全部 20 个设置中匹配或超越所有基线；训练仅用 ≤96 个智能体，推理可扩展至 312 个智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体路径规划（MAPF）需要在组合爆炸空间中为多个智能体计算全局一致、无碰撞的轨迹，代价用 SOC（各路径代价之和）衡量。现有大规模邻域搜索（LNS）类方法（LNS2）虽在修复阶段表现出色，但其初始化阶段长期被忽视：初始解通常由优先级规划（PP+SIPPS）得到，在密集拥堵场景下会产生大量冲突、死锁或全局不一致的运动模式，导致后端修复算力被浪费在纠正糟糕结构上。已有工作（Huber et al., 2025）指明初始化质量显著影响 LNS 的成功率与收敛速度，却仅局限于“从已有解中挑选”，而非生成更高质量的初始解。与此同时，把扩散模型用于 MAPF 存在三重挑战：(1) 需为大量智能体生成中心化的联合计划；(2) 需保持对个体目标的时间一致性；(3) 需在去噪过程中高效建模与冲突相关的智能体间交互（稠密全注意力代价 O(N²) 且与 MAPF 的局部冲突特性不匹配）。因此作者希望学习一个结构化的、具备时空协调性的联合轨迹生成先验，作为 LNS 的“warm start”。

Method: 1) 表述：初始解为联合动作张量 x0 ∈ {0,1}^{N×T×C}，C=5（stay/up/down/left/right），与 MAPF 的分类动作结构一致，使 D3PM 可直接在离散动作空间上建模多模态联合计划分布。\n2) 扩散模型：采用 D3PM 的 x0-parameterization，条件于 MAPF 条件 c（障碍图、目标图、起终点、地图尺寸、全局密度、扩散步），预测干净状态 p̃θ(x0|xk,c)；前向用均匀转移核 Qk = αk I + (1-αk)(1/C)11ᵀ（动作无序、无距离语义，故用均匀核），K=100 步、cosine 噪声调度；反向转移由解析后验与 p̃θ 诱导。\n3) 网络结构：Diffusion-Transformer 风格的去噪骨干，L=4 个交互块，每块含（a）时间注意力（局部窗口 Wt=32 + 间隔 St=16 的稀疏全局锚点），（b）扩散感知稀疏社交注意力，（c）可变形环境感知（沿软推断轨迹采样多尺度地图特征，采样半径随动作分布熵增大），（d) FFN；采用基于智能体条件的 AdaLN 与 FiLM 条件化。环境编码为障碍/自由/目标三通道卷积金字塔。\n4) 稀疏社交注意力（核心创新）：每个去噪步由当前噪声张量 xk 推出每个智能体的软推断位置 p^inf（对动作分布取期望位移并累积归一化），计算两两轨迹的最小 L1 邻近度 d_ij = min_τ ||p^inf_i,τ − p^inf_j,τ||_1，保留 top-M_k 邻居（M_k 为团队规模 N 的截断比例，非自身邻居比随噪声从 0.10 调度到 0.25，早期宽、后期稀疏）；注意力权重加入基于相对推断位置的学习几何偏置 b_θ。\n5) 训练目标：L = L_gen + L_task；L_gen = L_aux（token 级干净动作交叉熵）+ λ_KL·L_KL（后验匹配 KL，λ_KL=0.02）；L_task = λ_goal·L_goal（BFS 最短路距离的进度惩罚）+ λ_vertex·L_vertex（近距对指数惩罚）+ λ_edge·L_edge（对向交换惩罚）+ λ_valid·L_valid（非法动作概率质量）。任务损失由预测分布的软轨迹计算，作为整形信号；先训 60 epoch 纯生成目标，再 150 epoch 逐步升温任务损失。\n6) 推理流程：每轮采样 M=4 个草稿 → 预处理（去除到达目标后的冗余后缀，用障碍感知最短路补全未完成轨迹、剔除非法动作）→ LNS2 修复（邻域规模固定 8，每个候选 120 s 预算）→ 若存在可行解则取 SOC 最优者，否则继续采样直至轮次/时间预算耗尽。\n7) 可扩展性：前向/反向过程在 token 级逐元素作用，参数跨智能体共享且对智能体维度置换等变（f(Px,Pc)=Pf(x,c)），故训练规模外的更大团队仍可用，但作者明确指出这不保证分布外泛化，需实证检验。\n8) 训练数据：POGEMA 生成的 maze/room/warehouse，地图均 23×23，N∈{32,64,96}（4.5K/9K/9K 实例），用 LaCAM3 求解成功轨迹作为专家示范；round-robin 混合以保持批内固定 N；8×A100、400 epoch（约 26 小时）、BF16；隐藏维 128、4 头、4 层，AdamW lr=2e-4。

Result: 主实验（POGEMA 随机生成的 5 类场景共 20 个设置：Small Random 10×10/17.5%、Medium Maze 25×25、Medium Room 23×23、Medium Warehouse 25×25、Large Maze 33×33，智能体 45–312）：DiffLNS 平均成功率 95.8%，较最强基线 LNS2+RL 高 9.6 个百分点，且在全部 20 个设置中 SR 匹配或超越所有基线。典型差距：Medium Maze N=190 为 98% vs LNS2+RL 70%；Medium Room N=192 为 64% vs 48%；Medium Warehouse N=252 为 100% vs 80%；Large Maze N=312 为 92% vs 86%（HMAGAT 仅 46%）。代价方面 DiffLNS 的 SOC 通常略高于 LNS2（如 Medium Maze N=160：9421 vs 8399），但远低于 HMAGAT；运行时普遍更长（含扩散生成+修复，困难设置需更多候选，最高 N=312 的 Medium Room 平均需 10.96 个候选）。匹配时长的 LaCAM3 参考在各密集设置 SR 均低于 DiffLNS。\n初始化消融（固定 LNS2 修复预算 120 s、单一初始化）：扩散初始化在多数密集场景提升修复成功率、修复时间相当或更低；有趣的是扩散初始解的原始冲突数往往更多，却更易被修复，说明“初始化质量”应由下游修复结果而非冲突统计衡量。\n与 PP-Multistart 对照（同为批量 4、最多 5 批、≤20 候选）：DiffLNS 在 5 个最拥堵设置上 SR 全面更高（Medium Room 44%→64%、Small Random 72%→82%、Medium Maze 92%→98%、Medium Warehouse 94%→100%、Large Maze 86%→94%），且平均候选数更少（Medium Room 11.0 vs 15.1）；PP-Multistart 的较低 SOC 仅来自其更小更易的成功子集。\n稀疏 vs 稠密社交注意力消融（Medium Maze N=190、Medium Room N=192、Medium Warehouse N=252）：稀疏版本修复成功率更高、所需候选更少，稠密版本端到端运行时平均高约 12%。\n局限：简单实例上纯 LNS2 已足够；去噪器仅在 23×23 地图上训练，更大地图存在分布偏移风险；性能仍受限于下游 LNS2 修复预算，最难的 Medium Room 设置改进有限。

Conclusion: 本文提出 DiffLNS，首次将离散扩散模型用于 LNS 式 MAPF 求解器的 warm start，把研究焦点从“只改进修复算子”转向“提升初始化质量”。核心结论有三：(1) 学习到的离散扩散先验能生成比优先级规划重启更具结构、更可修复的联合计划，在同等多起点预算下显著更高的成功率，且收益并非来自多次重启的偶然性；(2) 冲突相关的交互本质上是局部的，动态稀疏社交注意力在效果与效率上均优于稠密全注意力；(3) 由于参数共享与 token 级因子化，扩散初始化器可从 ≤96 智能体训练零样本外推到 312 智能体。整体权衡是：成功率/鲁棒性显著提升，SOC 与运行时间付出代价，但候选相互独立、可并行化，且与学习式修复方法（如 LNS2+RL）方向互补。作者展望将更强初始化器与更强学习式修复策略结合，并指出离散扩散模型可作为多智能体决策的结构化迭代生成器。

Abstract: Multi-Agent Path Finding (MAPF) is a coordination problem that requires computing globally consistent, collision-free trajectories from individual start positions to assigned goal positions under combinatorial planning complexity. In dense environments, suboptimal initial plans induce compound conflicts that hinder feasible repair. For repair-based solvers like LNS2, initial plan quality critically affects downstream repair, yet this factor remains underexplored. We propose DiffLNS, a hybrid framework that integrates a discrete denoising diffusion probabilistic model (D3PM) with LNS2. The D3PM serves as an initializer with sparse social attention that learns a spatiotemporal prior over coordinated multi-agent action trajectories from expert demonstrations and samples multiple joint plans. Operating directly on the categorical action space, our discrete diffusion preserves the MAPF action structure and samples from a multimodal joint-plan distribution to produce diverse drafts well suited for neighborhood repair. These drafts act as warm starts for downstream repair, which completes unfinished trajectories and resolves remaining conflicts under hard MAPF constraints. Experimental results show that despite being trained only on instances with at most 96 agents, the initializer generalizes to scenarios with up to 312 agents at inference time. Across 20 complex and congested settings, DiffLNS achieves an average success rate of 95.8%, outperforming the strongest tested baseline by 9.6 percentage points and matching or exceeding all baselines in all 20 settings. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to leverage discrete diffusion for warm-starting an LNS-based MAPF solver.

</details>


### [101] [Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12978)
*Dylan Zhang,Yanshan Lin,Zhengkun Wu,Yihang Sun,Bingxuan Li,Dianqi Li,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了当前LLM智能体记忆系统的一个核心缺陷：整合式记忆（将轨迹改写为抽象知识）反而导致性能下降。研究通过ARC-AGI任务证明，原始经验轨迹比LLM生成的整合记忆更可靠，智能体应优先保留原始情节而非自动触发整合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前智能体记忆系统追求LLM将过去轨迹改写为文本记忆库并持续更新，承诺无需参数更新即可自我改进。但作者发现这种整合式记忆即使来自有用经验也往往存在缺陷——记忆效用先升后降，甚至低于无记忆基线

Method: 1)对比有记忆与无记忆基线的ARC-AGI任务准确率；2)对同一轨迹在不同更新策略下生成记忆质量；3)受控ARC-AGI Stream环境测试Retain/Delete/Consolidate三种操作；4)对比整合式记忆与纯情景式控制的性能

Result: 1)GPT-5.4对曾独立解决的问题，整合后失败率达54%；2)同一轨迹在不同更新策略下产生质量截然不同的记忆；3)默认保留原始情节 Episodic-only 控制与主动整合系统性能相当；4)在受控环境中，自动保留原始情节的智能体准确率是强制整合的两倍

Conclusion: 当前LLM的整合步骤会引入错误而非提升性能；可靠智能体记忆需将原始经验视为一等公民，并显式控制整合过程而非每次交互后自动触发；最终需要能整合经验但不覆盖原始证据的LLM

Abstract: Learning from past experience benefits from two complementary forms of memory: episodic traces -- raw trajectories of what happened -- and consolidated abstractions distilled across many episodes into reusable, schema-like lessons. Recent agentic-memory systems pursue the consolidated form: an LLM rewrites past trajectories into a textual memory bank that it continuously updates with new interactions, promising self-improving agents without parameter updates. Yet we find that such consolidated memories produced by today's LLMs are often faulty even when derived from useful experiences. As consolidation proceeds, memory utility first rises, then degrades, and can fall below the no-memory baseline. More surprisingly, even when consolidating from ground-truth solutions, GPT-5.4 fails on 54% of a set of ARC-AGI problems it had previously solved without memory. We trace the regression to the consolidation step rather than the underlying experience: the same trajectories yield qualitatively different memories under different update schedules, and an episodic-only control that simply retains those trajectories remains competitive with the consolidators we test. In a controlled ARC-AGI Stream environment that exposes Retain, Delete, and Consolidate actions, agents preserve raw episodes by default and double the accuracy of their forced-consolidation counterparts; disabling consolidation entirely (episodic management only) matches this auto regime. Practically, robust agent memory should treat raw episodes as first-class evidence and gate consolidation explicitly rather than firing it after every interaction. Looking forward, reliable agentic memory will require LLMs that can consolidate without overwriting the evidence they depend on.

</details>


### [102] [Multi-Agent Systems in Emergency Departments: Validation Study on a ED Digital Twin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13345)
*Markus Wenzel,Tobias Strapatsas,Jessika Kress,Dorothea Sauer,Nele Gessler,Horst K. Hahn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种混合离散事件模拟(DES)和基于智能体建模(ABM)的仿真框架，用于模拟急诊科环境并探索资源优化策略。通过与文献数据对比验证了模型的有效性，并将多智能体系统(MAS)集成到框架中以实现资源分配策略的自主探索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 急诊科(ED)在患者护理和资源管理方面面临严峻挑战，需要一个灵活、可配置的模型来探索和验证资源优化策略。

Method: 1) 建立混合DES-ABM模型模拟可配置的急诊科环境；2) 从真实世界研究数据中提取ED规模、患者负荷和人员配置参数；3) 通过与文献中的关键绩效指标对比验证模型表达力；4) 实施科学验证和实践验证的资源优化策略；5) 集成多智能体系统(MAS)基于急诊科事件记录的时间账本自主探索资源分配策略。

Result: 验证结果表明，基于DES-ABM的仿真模型能够有效复现干预措施下的真实急诊科动态特征。

Conclusion: 模块化的DES-ABM-MAS框架为探索急诊科资源优化策略提供了强有力的工具。

Abstract: Emergency departments (ED) face challenges in patient care and resource management. We propose to explore optimization strategies in a realistic and flexible model and develop a hybrid Discrete Event Simulation (DES) and Agent-Based Model (ABM) simulating highly configurable ED environments. We specifically focus on the validation of the modeling approach. We derive configurations for ED sizes, patient load, and staffing from real-world studies. We then validate the model expressivity by matching its key performance indicators and metrics with their values known from literature. We proceed by implementing scientifically established and practice-proven resource optimization strategies. Comparing the documented real-world outcomes with our model's results demonstrates that the DES-ABM based simulation can effectively replicate real-world ER dynamics under interventions. We lastly integrate a Proof-of-Concept multi-agent system (MAS) that can autonomously explore resource allocation strategies within the simulated ER environment based on a temporal ledger of ED event records. This modular DES-ABM-MAS framework offers a powerful tool to explore resource optimization strategies in emergency departments.

</details>


### [103] [MAP: A Map-then-Act Paradigm for Long-Horizon Interactive Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13037)
*Yuxin Liu,Ziang Ye,Yueqing Sun,Mingye Zhu,Jinwei Xiao,Zhuowen Han,Qi GU,Xunliang Cai,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 MAP（Map-then-Act）范式，将交互式 LLM 智能体的"环境理解"从执行过程中的被动副产品，前置为独立的显式建图阶段。核心洞察是现有 ReAct/CoT 式的"边做边想"存在时序倒置，导致"延迟环境感知"与"认知瓶颈"（只能靠试错推断环境约束，陷入目标漂移与冗余试错循环）。MAP 采用三阶段流水线：跨任务全局探索（提炼动作语法/交互规则/错误模式等环境级通用先验 K_g）→ 任务特定认知建图（主动探索生成结构化认知地图 M_t，含空间布局、对象-动作可供性、游戏规则，并以"知识增量+状态新颖性"双收敛准则自适应停止）→ 知识增强执行（以 K_g 与 M_t 为条件求解任务）。同时发布 MAP-2K（约 2000 条 map-then-act 轨迹）并微调得到 MAP-4B。实验显示：MAP 在 ALFWorld/TextCraft/ScienceWorld 上跨十余种 LLM 骨干一致优于 ReAct 与非分阶段变体 CoMAP；MAP-4B 显著优于用同等专家执行轨迹训练的 ACT-4B；在 ARC-AGI-3 上使 Claude 4.6 Opus 从近乎零分提升到 22/25 个游戏有实质进展；总交互步数与 token 消耗不高于 ReAct。结论是：教会智能体"理解环境"比教其"模仿解法"更基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时程交互式 LLM 智能体（ReAct、CoT 等）遵循"目标条件下的逐步规划"，其结构性缺陷是环境理解与任务执行被耦合：智能体必须"先做后懂"（act to understand），通过试错反馈反推空间布局、对象-动作可供性与潜在约束。作者称其为"延迟环境感知"（Delayed Environmental Perception），并指出这是范式级瓶颈（paradigm-level bottleneck）——单纯增强推理能力或扩充记忆无法消除，因为更强的模型在同一范式下依然只在行动副产物中获取环境知识。其后果是"认知瓶颈"（Epistemic Bottleneck），表现为两种失效模式：目标漂移（陷入局部看似合理但全局次优的行为）与冗余试错（反复触发违反潜在环境逻辑的动作）。ARC-AGI-3 上前沿模型（Claude 4.6）在零知识交互环境中近乎零分，为该诊断提供了证据。理论上，作者借 Pearl 的 do-calculus 指出：仅用观测分布 P(a_t|o_t) 无法恢复介入分布 P(o_{t+1}|do(a_t))，这是认知瓶颈的形式化根源。灵感来自 Gibson 的可供性理论（智能体应从空间布局中直接感知动作可供性，而非由失败推断）与 Tolman 的认知地图理论（通过主动探索构建结构化内部表征来导航陌生环境）。

Method: **问题形式化**：轨迹 e=(u,a_1,o_1,...,a_n)。传统 Act-during-Think 为 π_θ(e|u)=∏π_θ(a_t|u,a_{<t},o_{<t})；MAP 将其拆为建图与行动两阶段：M~π_θ(M|u,τ_exp)（通过 do(explore) 获取介入经验），执行 π_θ(e|u,M)=∏π_θ(a_t|u,M,a_{<t},o_{<t})·π_θ(M|u,τ_exp)，即从相关性模式匹配转向因果锚定的知识驱动推理。

**三阶段架构**：
1. *跨任务全局探索*（每环境一次、离线，不占评测预算）：以环境描述与少量人工轨迹为输入，先由 Focus Analyzer 生成 Focus Points（如"探测环境是否强制严格动作语法"），再由 Explorer 在训练集上多轮 think-act，失败时由 Reflector 内省反思并沉淀任务特定反思 ν；最后把成功与失败轨迹统一蒸馏为环境级通用知识库 K_g，含三部分：动作语法（合法命令格式）、交互规则（前置条件与约束）、错误模式（复现失效与诊断信号），最多 15 条、须有证据支撑且不冗余，作为持久先验注入后续所有任务上下文。
2. *任务特定认知建图*：以 K_g 为引导做自适应探索，定义内在奖励含两个条件——Cond_A 知识增量 Δ|M_t|（新知识条目数，连续 k 步为 0 视为收敛，保证地图完备性）与 Cond_B 状态新颖度 r(o_t)=1/√N(o_t)（连续 k 步低于阈值 ε 视为收敛，保证探索多样性）；T_stop=min{t|(Cond_A ∧ Cond_B 均收敛) ∨ t≥T_max}，双条件同时满足以避免过早终止。探索遵循 Role-Purpose-Priority（RPP）提示协议（角色为"Task-oriented Scout"，使命是采集信息而非完成任务）。停止后由 Key Information Extractor 生成 M_t=f_map(τ_exp,u)，包含空间布局、对象-动作可供性、以及（ARC-AGI-3）游戏规则。
3. *知识增强执行*：a_t~π_θ(a_t|u,M_t,K_g,h_t)，双层知识注入使行动基于地图而非原始观测。

**内化阶段**：以 GPT-4.1、Claude 4.5 为"专家认知标注者"执行 MAP 流程生成 map-then-act 轨迹，经环境引擎内部状态的真值对齐校验、空间覆盖与事实准确性阈值过滤，去污染后构成 MAP-2K（约 2000 条；ALFWorld/TextCraft/ScienceWorld 各 667 条，平均 48.8/42.9/60.7 步、平均 6.6/5.7/8.2k token）；用 ms-swift 在 8×H800 上微调 Qwen3-4B-Thinking（lr 1e-5、3 epoch）得 MAP-4B，损失为全动作序列的负对数似然（同时监督理解与执行能力）。基线：ReAct、非分阶段变体 CoMAP（在同一交互循环中同时建图与执行）、以及用 2K 专家执行轨迹同配置训练的 ACT-4B。

Result: **RQ1 主结果**：长时程基准上普遍满足 ReAct < CoMAP < MAP（如 Qwen3-4B-Instruct：ALFWorld 31.8→39.0→37.1，TextCraft 61.1→71.9→70.1，ScienceWorld 24.3→34.8→33.5；GPT-4o-1120 ScienceWorld 53.3→75.6→78.5；Claude 系列、Doubao、Deepseek-V4-Pro、Kimi-K2-Thinking 等均有提升，少数出现 ≤1 分的轻微退化）。MAP-4B 在 ALFWorld 87.1、TextCraft 94.1、ScienceWorld 95.6，全面超过 ACT-4B（78.2/84.3/79.4）并超过多个更大模型。ARC-AGI-3（Claude 4.6 Opus）：ReAct 近乎全零，MAP 在 25 个游戏中 22 个取得进展，6 个代表环境等级 2–4、分数最高 11.59。

**RQ2 环境理解**：Map QA 仅凭 M_t 回答四类问题（物体位置、对象-动作可供性、负知识、任务推理），各模型准确率均高，说明地图忠实捕获环境结构；ARC-AGI-3 上 MAP 能自主发现迷宫布局、传送带按钮耦合、颜色分类规则等隐藏机制；中途扰动实验（移动目标物体）中，MAP-4B 从 87.1 降至 79.5（-7.6，优于 Base 的 -13.3 与 ACT-4B 的 -13.4），再探索率 80.9%、恢复步数 7.3 步，显示定向重规划而非穷举试错。

**RQ3 效率**：在总步数预算相同约束下，MAP 成功率更高；虽建图有前期开销，但执行期消除冗余试错，交互轮数与 token 消耗与 ReAct 相当或更低（案例中 ALFWorld 37 步→7 步、效率 +81%，TextCraft 40→10 步 +75%，ScienceWorld 61→8 步 +87%）。

**RQ4 消融**：去掉 Stage 1 或 Stage 2 均一致掉分（4B：-6.7 / -16.5），任务建图更关键；去掉空间布局（-14.9）比去掉可供性（-9.2）损失更大；探索预算超过约 10 步后性能饱和，大模型（32B）对预算更不敏感。

Conclusion: MAP 通过显式解耦环境理解与任务执行，识别并缓解了既有智能体范式的"认知瓶颈"：在文本长时程交互基准上跨模型规模一致提升成功率并降低交互成本，在 ARC-AGI-3 这类完全未知环境中让前沿模型从近乎零分走向 22/25 个游戏有实质进展；MAP-2K 蒸馏数据训练出的 MAP-4B 明显优于专家执行轨迹微调，说明"理解环境"这一能力比"模仿解法"更具基础性、更易泛化到参数内部；消融表明任务特定空间布局是认知地图的骨架，通用先验与任务地图互补，且中等探索预算即已足够。作者亦明确局限：当前仅在基于文本动作空间的交互环境中验证，尚未扩展至具身智能与多模态感知（视觉输入、连续动作空间，如机器人操作与视觉-语言导航），留作未来方向。

Abstract: Current interactive LLM agents rely on goal-conditioned stepwise planning, where environmental understanding is acquired reactively during execution rather than established beforehand. This temporal inversion leads to Delayed Environmental Perception: agents must infer environmental constraints through trial-and-error, resulting in an Epistemic Bottleneck that traps them in inefficient failure cycles. Inspired by human affordance perception and cognitive map theory, we propose the Map-then-Act Paradigm (MAP), a plug-and-play framework that shifts environment understanding before execution. MAP consists of three stages: (1) Global Exploration, acquiring environment-general priors; (2) Task-Specific Mapping, constructing a structured cognitive map; and (3) Knowledge-Augmented Execution, solving tasks grounded on the map. Experiments show consistent gains across benchmarks and LLMs. On ARC-AGI-3, MAP enables frontier models to surpass near-zero baseline performance in 22 of 25 game environments. We further introduce MAP-2K, a dataset of map-then-act trajectories, and show that training on it outperforms expert execution traces, suggesting that understanding environments is more fundamental than imitation.

</details>


### [104] [Improving Code Translation with Syntax-Guided and Semantic-aware Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13229)
*Yuhan Wu,Huan Zhang,Wei Cheng,Chen Shen,Jingyue Yang,Wei Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出CTO方法，通过对比学习训练的跨语言语义模型直接评估功能等价性，并结合编译器语法反馈，在直接偏好优化框架下解决大语言模型代码翻译中的语法正确性和语义一致性问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于偏好的学习方法受限于不可靠的语义奖励——这些奖励依赖于稀疏的测试用例或受限的参考翻译，导致代码翻译难以同时保证语法正确性和语义一致性。

Method: (1) 对比学习：训练跨语言语义模型直接评估源代码与翻译代码的功能等价性；(2) 多目标优化：将鲁棒语义信号与编译器语法反馈统一于直接偏好优化(DPO)框架中。

Result: 在C++、Java、Python三种语言的翻译任务上，CTO显著优于现有基线和其他偏好优化策略。

Conclusion: CTO通过将语义信号与语法反馈统一在DPO框架中，显著提升了代码翻译质量，在C++、Java、Python三种语言翻译任务上均超越现有基线方法。

Abstract: LLMs have shown immense potential for code translation, yet they often struggle to ensure both syntactic correctness and semantic consistency. While preference-based learning offers a promising alignment strategy, it is hindered by unreliable semantic rewards derived from sparse test cases or restrictive reference translations. We argue that a robust semantic reward for code translation must be derived directly from the source code. In this paper, we propose CTO to improve code translation with syntax-guided and semantic-aware preference optimization. Through contrastive learning, we train a cross-lingual semantic model to directly assess functional equivalence between source and translated code. By formulating code translation as a multi-objective optimization problem, this robust semantic signal is seamlessly unified with compiler-based syntactic feedback within the direct preference optimization framework. Extensive experiments on C++, Java, and Python translations demonstrate that CTO significantly outperforms existing baselines and alternative preference optimization strategies.

</details>


### [105] [RealICU: Do LLM Agents Understand Long-Context ICU Data? A Benchmark Beyond Behavior Imitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13542)
*Chengzhi Shen,Weixiang Shen,Tobias Susetzky,Chen,Chen,Jun Li,Yuyuan Liu,Xuepeng Zhang,Zhenyu Gong,Daniel Rueckert,Jiazhen Pan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RealICU是一个用于评估LLM在真实ICU条件下决策支持能力的基准测试，通过资深医生 hindsight-annotated标注解决了传统基准依赖次优历史决策的问题，包含Gold和Scale两个数据集，揭示了当前模型在安全性和认知偏差上的关键局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICU基准测试依赖历史临床医生的决策作为ground truth，但这些决策往往在信息不完整的情况下做出，可能并非最优，无法真实评估AI系统的推理能力。ICU环境具有长时间跨度、高信息密度、快速演变等特点，对AI决策支持系统提出了更高要求。

Method: 提出RealICU基准测试，采用 hindsight-annotated方式：由资深医生在回顾完整患者轨迹后创建标签，比实时决策更准确。设计四个医生驱动的评估任务：患者状态评估、急性问题识别、推荐行动和红色警戒行动。每个轨迹按30分钟窗口划分，使用Oracle（医生验证的LLM标注器）扩展数据集规模。

Result: 现有LLM（包括增强记忆的模型）在RealICU上表现不佳，揭示两个主要失败模式：临床建议的recall-safety tradeoff（召回率与安全性之间的权衡）和对患者早期信息的anchoring bias（锚定偏差）。ICU-Evo虽能改善长期推理但仍无法完全消除安全失败。

Conclusion: RealICU提供了一个临床可解释的评估框架，揭示了当前LLM在ICU决策支持中的关键局限：recall-safety tradeoff和anchoring bias；ICU-Evo的结构化记忆机制可改善长期推理但无法完全消除安全风险。

Abstract: Intensive care units (ICU) generate long, dense and evolving streams of clinical information, where physicians must repeatedly reassess patient states under time pressure, underscoring a clear need for reliable AI decision support. Existing ICU benchmarks typically treat historical clinician actions as ground truth. However, these actions are made under incomplete information and limited temporal context of the underlying patient state, and may therefore be suboptimal, making it difficult to assess the true reasoning capabilities of AI systems. We introduce RealICU, a hindsight-annotated benchmark for evaluating large language models (LLMs) under realistic ICU conditions, where labels are created after senior physicians review the full patient trajectory. We formulate four physician-motivated tasks: assess Patient Status, Acute Problems, Recommended Actions, and Red Flag actions that risk unsafe outcomes. We partition each trajectory with 30-min windows and release two datasets: RealICU-Gold with 930-window annotations from 94 MIMIC-IV patients, and RealICU-Scale with 11,862 windows extended by Oracle, a physician-validated LLM hindsight labeler. Existing LLMs including memory-augmented ones performed poorly on RealICU, exposing two failure modes: a recall-safety tradeoff for clinical recommendations, and an anchoring bias to early interpretations of the patient. We further introduce ICU-Evo to study structured-memory agents that improves long-horizon reasoning but does not fully eliminate safety failures. Together, RealICU provides a clinically grounded testbed for measuring and improving AI sequential decision-support in high-stakes care. Project page: https://chengzhi-leo.github.io/RealICU-Bench/

</details>


### [106] [An Agentic LLM-Based Framework for Population-Scale Mental Health Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13046)
*Giuliano Lorenzoni,Paulo Alencar,Donald Cowan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"代理式"(agentic) LLM 框架：把文本分类（抑郁检测）流水线的每个配置环节封装为独立的 LangChain 代理，并配以显式策略（freeze/skip/rollback）与代理指标（proxy）引导的探索，在 DAIC-WOZ 上收敛到稳定配置（cosine、dynamic Top-k=5、τ=0.75），且拒绝一切导致性能回退的改动（后置过滤、PRF、阈值 0.78、解码参数扫描）。核心贡献是把"配置管理/可变性治理/非回退保证"作为软件工程一等公民，而非像传统单体 RAG 那样把超参当黑箱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理健康筛查需要可扩展的 AI 流水线，但现实存在三重矛盾：(1) 临床数据量巨大（EHR、远程医疗、人口级筛查），传统 ML/LLM 方案难以在保证可信、可复现的同时扩展；(2) LLM 生态缺乏系统化的超参与配置管理策略——温度、上下文窗口、检索策略、记忆配置对性能、可靠性、成本影响巨大，却缺少可复现的最佳实践；(3) 多 LLM 代理协作机制尚处早期：LLM 输出的随机性、缺乏多代理协调的理论基础、缺乏标准化监控，使部署异构（云/本地/边缘）下脆弱的多步工作流难以治理。此外，医疗场景还要求个性化、适应性与非回退保证：后续环节的"调参"不能覆盖已被验证的早前配置。

Method: 1) 架构：定义九个代理——Step 0 Orchestrator（LangChain/LangGraph 编排、记录决策、触发回滚）+ Steps 1–8（预处理、相似度度量、Top-k 选择/RAG 类型、多样性 MMR、后置过滤、数据扩展/PRF、阈值优化、解码与金标验证），各代理具明确职责与局部策略。2) 动态配置：配置可运行时变更，验证后逐阶段"锁定（freeze）"，未经证明改进不得覆盖；Orchestrator 在 macro-F1/recall 回退时自动回滚。3) Proxy 分层：五族低成本代理指标（语义-检索、统计-文本、排序稳定性、置信度启发式、廉价 LLM judge）先筛除劣候选，仅有通过代理阈值的配置才进入昂贵的金标评估，以控成本。4) 具体策略阈值：预处理需 macro-F1 增益≥0.02；切换相似度度量需增益>0.01；k≤5 且召回饱和即停；MMR 仅在重叠>0.6 且不损少数类召回时启用；后置过滤仅在置信度<0.65 时启用；数据扩展需 macro-F1 下降≤0.02；阈值在 0.70–0.80 扫描且增益>0.01。5) 实现：Python 3.12、PyTorch 2.8、Transformers 4.55、Sentence-Transformers 5.1、LangChain(core+OpenAI)；e5-base(trunc=256) 生成 L2 归一化向量，NumPy 余弦相似度替代 FAISS；LLM 裁判为 gpt-4o-mini（temp=0.0, top_p=0.9, n=1）；纯 CPU（i7/16GB）可跑。

Result: Steps 1–4 锁定 K=5、动态选择、MMR OFF；Step 5 后置过滤无增益保持 OFF；Step 6 PRF 在代理与金标上不一致，拒绝；Step 7 阈值扫描 [0.70,0.80] 的峰值 τ=0.78 仅得 acc=0.821/macroF1=0.789，低于冻结基线（acc=0.857, macroF1=0.825, rec₁=0.875），按非回退策略保留 τ=0.75；Step 8 解码网格（temp∈{0,0.1,0.2}、top_p∈{1.0,0.9}、n∈{1,3}）全部低于基线，最佳 (0.0,0.9,1) 仍为 0.821/0.789，故不改动（temp=0.0, top_p=1.0, n=1）。结论：框架收敛到稳定配置（cosine、dynamic Top-k、τ=0.75），各阶段决策可审计；LangChain 编排结果与 Steps 7–8 金标评估高度一致，验证其为可复用的软件制品而非一次性实验。

Conclusion: 该框架证明代理式编排能把"可变性管理"变成可控的治理机制：配置锁定后，后续代理只能确认或跳过，从而避免性能回退、削减冗余评估成本并提升可解释性与可复现性，为人口规模心理健康筛查（以及需求工程、代码分析、风险评估等域）提供了代理式软件工程的架构范式。作者亦指出现存局限与未来方向：结果仅在 DAIC-WOZ 189 场访谈的小规模验证集上得出，"群体规模"仍属架构愿景而非实证；单次运行比较受采样与验证划分敏感度影响，未来应引入等价类、统计检验与方差感知阈值替代单次决策；变异性空间远未穷尽（静态/动态/混合之外的 RAG 策略、显著性/神经摘要式截断），冻结配置应视为可运行时注入新策略的稳定检查点而非终点。

Abstract: Mental health disorders affect millions worldwide, and healthcare systems are increasingly overwhelmed by the volume of clinical data generated from electronic records, telemedicine platforms, and population-level screening programs. At the same time, the emergence of novel AI-based approaches in healthcare calls for intelligent frameworks capable of processing domain-specific unstructured clinical information while adapting to patient-specific needs. This paper proposes an agentic framework for building robust LLM-based pipelines, where each stage is encapsulated as a LangChain agent governed by explicit policies and proxy-guided evaluation. Stages are incrementally locked once validated, ensuring that later adaptations cannot overwrite configurations without demonstrated improvement. The proposed framework evolves from feature-level exploration, through proxy-based tuning and freeze/rollback mechanisms, to full orchestration by an Orchestrator Agent that coordinates preprocessing, retrieval, selection, diversity, threshold optimization, and decoding. A proof-of-concept in transcript-based depression detection demonstrates that the framework converges to stable configurations, such as cosine similarity, dynamic Top-k, and threshold 0.75, while controlling evaluation costs and avoiding regressions. These results highlight the potential of agentic AI to enable population-level mental health screening over large clinical datasets, addressing critical challenges in trustworthiness, reproducibility, and adaptability required in healthcare environments.

</details>


### [107] [Unweighted ranking for value-based decision making with uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13601)
*Aarón López García,Natalia Criado,Jose Such*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出模糊无加权价值导向决策框架（FUW-VBDM）及其求解算法 Rankzzy：以 LR-模糊数统一表达定量与定性准则构建模糊决策矩阵，取消先验固定权重、改为在有界模糊权重空间内做约束优化，用可定制的广义模糊 p-均值打分并按偏序 ⪯ 排序动作，从而在存在模糊性、道德/伦理判断与主观权重的情况下给出可解释、稳健且计算成本较低的价值对齐排序结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 系统被大量部署到关键基础设施并参与自主决策，其与人类价值的一致性关乎问责、公平、透明与安全，因此需要以人为中心、价值驱动的决策范式。现有 VBDM/MCDM 方法存在四类关键缺陷：(1) 多数方法假定权重可先验设定为固定向量，带来规范性偏差（Jacquet-Lagreze & Siskos 等）；(2) 伦理道德判断本质模糊、难以精确量化，且存在二阶不确定性（环境与问题表征的不确定），需要模糊逻辑刻画；(3) 定性与定量准则很少在同一决策场景中被统一整合；(4) 部分方法依赖序关系/偏好系统，可扩展性与一致性不足。此外，多数处理值对齐的工作缺乏端到端、可解释、同时覆盖"模糊性 + 无权重 + 序关系"的方法。作者的定位是把模糊技术与无加权（unweighted）技术这两条相互独立的路线首次结合起来。

Method: 框架（FUW-VBDM 问题元组）：(Ag, A, V, ⪯, X̃, Ω̃_lu, M̃^p)，包括主体/行动/价值、模糊序关系、模糊决策矩阵、有界模糊权重域与基于 p-均值的打分函数。

关键定义与引理：
- 序关系：Dubois–Prade 偏序 ≲（基于 max/min 逐 α-截集）与 Chen 顶点法导出的预序 ⪯（‖X̃‖₂ ≤ ‖Ỹ‖₂）；Lemma 1 给出 ≲ 的 α-截集刻画，Lemma 2 证明 ≲ ⇒ ⪯，因此 ⪯ 更严格、无歧义，适合排序。
- 决策矩阵：Agent 评估向量 Γ_ij ∈ [0,1]^|Ag|。定量值用梯形模糊数 Ψ_QT（min, 均值−σ, 均值+σ, max）；定性值用 Ψ_QL：按各类别占比对模糊对应 Λ̃ 进行加权求和（⊕/⊙ 模糊算术），得到梯形模糊数。
- 权重域：定义模糊上下界 l̃ ⪯ w̃ ⪯ ũ，构造 Ω̃_lu = { w̃ : Σw_j^L ≤ 1 ≤ Σw_j^R, l̃_j ⪯ w̃_j ⪯ ũ_j }。Theorem 1 证明任意 VBDM 问题都可通过取 min/max（或模糊 ∧/∨）化为该有界模糊权重域，从而把问题一般化为"在权重域上搜索可行解"。
- 打分函数：广义模糊 p-均值 M̃_i^p = [⊕_j w̃_j ⊗ x̃_ij^p]^{1/p}；Theorem 2（分数一致性，分量全正时对 p∈R∪{±∞} 良定义，p=−∞/0/+∞ 分别为 min/几何/最大）、Theorem 3（分数单调性：M̃^{−∞} ⪯ M̃^p ⪯ M̃^q ⪯ M̃^{+∞}）。

Rankzzy 算法五步：(1) 对每个价值按最大化/最小化方向做模糊归一化（引入 ε 模糊数防除零）；(2) 以 M̃_i^p 为目标，在 Ω̃_lu 上做 min 与 max 两次约束模糊优化；(3) 用顶点法相对 0 去模糊得 M_i^{p−min}、M_i^{p−max}；(4) 用稳定性参数 ν ∈ [0,1] 以凸 p-均值聚合（ν≤0.5 悲观、ν≥0.5 乐观、ν=0.5 平衡）；(5) 按 M_i 降序排名。优化用 SLSQP 处理二次型行为（约束域为半空间，排除无约束方法）。输出还包括最优权重 (w̃_i^min, w̃_i^max)，保证可解释性与透明度。Theorem 4 证明严格正归一化（0 ⪯ r̃_ij ⪯ 1）。运行示例：大学统一考试方式（选择题 MC vs 开放题 OA；定性价值公平性 F、定量价值成本 C；100 名教师；p=1；ε=10⁻⁴）。

Result: 运行示例结果：归一化后 M̃_MC^{1−min}=(0.061,0.198,0.473,0.792)、M̃_OA^{1−min}=(0.279,0.502,0.790,0.957)；M̃_MC^{1−max}=(0.091,0.247,0.553,0.902)、M̃_OA^{1−max}=(0.348,0.576,0.892,1.068)；聚合得分 M_MC=1.018 < M_OA=1.457，得 OA 优于 MC，且为"完全支配"关系（min 与 max 两种下界上界均成立）。最优权重恰好落在给定的下界/上界（p=1 线性聚合符合预期）。敏感性分析：250×250 的 (p, ν) 网格（p∈[0,2], ν∈[0,1]）显示结论稳定。

计算成本（50 次随机实验，矩阵规模从 2×2 增至 50×40）：≤23 个价值时平均 <5 秒；24–31 个价值时平均 <10 秒；最坏情况 50×40 耗时 34.19 秒；结论中称 40 准则问题平均 <18 秒、最坏 <35 秒。

排序相关性（与 TOPSIS 比较，50 次实验，5×4 随机矩阵并模糊化 + 噪声凸组合理想解 z̃_λ）：除二次均值外，各 p 取值（−1、0、1）的 Kendall's τ 中位数均 >0.745，表明与 TOPSIS 排序强相关；p=2 相关性偏低，原因是 TOPSIS 用到理想解的相对距离而 M̃² 用到到原点的模糊范数；p=0 相关性高是因为几何均值体现样本的中心趋势。

文献对比：Table 1 汇总 MCDM 与 VBDM 工作，Rankzzy 是首个同时满足 MAS 视角、定性+定量、模糊不确定性、序关系、无固定权重全部要求的方法。

Conclusion: 贡献：(1) 提出端到端的 FUW-VBDM MAS 框架，以数据驱动方式在同一决策矩阵中统一整合定性与定量准则（LR-模糊数），并以模糊区间/有界模糊权重域替代固定先验权重，消除权重诱导的规范性偏差；(2) 提出 Rankzzy，通过基于 ⪯ 模糊序的 min/max 双重优化与可定制 p-均值打分生成动作排序，配套给出 4 个定理/引理以保证良定义性、单调性与归一化正性，即对任意利益相关方配置都具备数学一致性；(3) 通过考试方式统一的运行示例展示了全流程可解释性（分数、边界分数、最优权重）；(4) 评估显示可接受的计算成本与对 TOPSIS 的强排序一致性（τ 中位数 >0.745）。

局限与展望：评估仅使用合成随机矩阵与单一案例研究，未与专门 VBDM 基线方法直接对比；p=2 时与 TOPSIS 相关性下降；未来方向包括高维案例验证、真实场景应用，以及在实时自主多智能体系统中的适用性测试。

Abstract: As intelligent systems are increasingly implemented in our society to make autonomous decisions, their commitment to human values raises serious concerns. Their alignment with human values remains a critical challenge because it can jeopardise the integrity and security of citizens. For this reason, an innovative human-centred and values-driven approach to decision making is required. In this work, we introduce the Fuzzy-Unweighted Value-Based Decision Making (FUW-VBDM) framework, where agents incorporate both quantitative and qualitative criteria to generate human-centred decisions. We also address the normative bias introduced by stakeholders with arbitrary weights by removing prior weights and introducing a fuzzy domain of decision variables defined for a score function. This concept allows us to generalise any VBDM problem as the search for feasible solutions when optimising the score in the weight domain. To provide a solution to FUW-VBDM, we present Rankzzy, a customizable unweighted ranking method that integrates fuzzy-based reasoning to quantify uncertainty. We mathematically prove the consistency of the Rankzzy for any admissible configuration selected by stakeholders. We show the applicability of our method through an illustrative case study, which we also use as a running example. The evaluation conducted indicates a reduced computational cost in large-scale value-based decision-making problems and a strong rank performance regarding existing approaches when employing the aggregation via Pythagorean means.

</details>


### [108] [GRACE: Gradient-aligned Reasoning Data Curation for Efficient Post-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13130)
*Junjie Li,Ziao Wang,NingXuan Ma,Jianghong Ma,Xiaofeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GRACE 把推理轨迹视为一串「优化事件」，为每个推理步骤计算两个基于梯度的信号——与答案梯度方向的对齐度、与前序推理轨迹的一致性——再聚合成样本级分数做 top-ρ 子集选择；为避免逐步反向传播，提出表征层梯度代理，用单次前向传播的 token 级上游信号 (W_out(p_t−y_t)) 估计步骤级梯度方向。在 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct + MMathCoT-1M 上，仅用 20% 数据即达到全量性能的 108.8%，5% 数据保留 100.2%，且子集可跨骨干模型迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理数据筛选（正确率、奖励模型、样本级影响力如 LESS/ICONS/CADC）都在整条轨迹粒度上打分，隐含假设「轨迹内各步价值相同」，但实际上步骤贡献极不均衡：有些直接支撑最终答案，有些只是复述、走偏或引入噪声。百万级 CoT 语料下单次后训练耗费数百 GPU 小时，因此需要能评估「单步对优化的贡献」的细粒度机制。论文因此提出优化视角：把推理轨迹建模为一系列优化事件，每步诱导一个局部更新方向，其效用取决于与目标优化方向的对齐程度及与已累积轨迹的连贯性；同时逐步真实梯度在百万级规模上不可计算（需把轨迹拆成多个训练实例并反复反向传播），因此必须提出可扩展的近似方案。

Method: 1) 问题形式化：样本 z=(x,s,a)，定义 token 级平均损失 L(θ;z,T)，目标是在预算 |S|=⌈ρ|D|⌉ 下选取子集 S 使后训练性能保持或超过全量。2) 步骤级效用：一阶影响近似 θ'=θ−η∇L_k 给出 ΔL_tar≈−η⟨∇L_k,∇L_tar⟩=−η‖∇L_k‖‖∇L_tar‖cos(·)，故取归一化方向分量 A_k^tar=cos(∇L_k,∇L_tar)；两个互补目标——(i) 答案导向 A_k^ans=cos(∇L_k,∇L_ans)；(ii) 轨迹一致性 A_k^hist=cos(∇L_k, r_k)，其中 r_k 为前序步骤梯度的加权归一化和（权重 ω 可取均匀/滑窗/EMA）。Score_k=αA_ans+(1−α)A_hist（k=1 仅有答案项）。3) 表征层梯度代理：由 ∂L_t/∂ℓ_t=p_t−y_t 推出表征界面梯度 u_t=W_out(p_t−y_t)，段级代理 g(T)=|T|^{-1}Σ_{t∈T}u_t，忽略雅可比交互 J_tJ_{t'}⊤，在代理空间计算余弦对齐，从而单次前向即可得到全部步骤的方向性代理。4) 样本级聚合：V(z_i)=K_i^{-1}Σ_k Score_k，按 V 排序取 top-ρ；评分模型由初始模型在 γ=0.05 子集上预热后冻结，训练仍使用原始完整轨迹。

Result: 主结果（Qwen3-VL-2B，≥8 步候选池）：20% 数据时 GRACE 相对均值 108.8%，显著高于最强基线 CADC 102.6%、LESS 101.7%、Random 101.4%、Longest 101.7%、Stepmax 101.5%、ICONS 99.1%；10%/15%/5% 分别为 103.2%/105.2%/100.2%，是唯一在所有比例下都超过全量基线的方法。跨骨干迁移：用 Qwen3-VL-2B 选出的 20% 子集直接后训练 Qwen2.5-VL-3B、LLaVA-1.5-7B、Qwen3-VL-8B 均超过各自全量基线，且训练耗时大幅下降。消融：去掉轨迹一致性降至 105.5%，去掉答案对齐降至 97.5%，目标换成 CoT+Ans 或后缀分别降至 100.2%/99.0%，用 LESS 式投影参数梯度替代代理则降至 98.3%（说明代理不只是效率近似，信号本身更稳定）。超参：预热关键（不预热 89.6%，γ=0.05 最优 106.6%，多检查点 101.7%），均匀历史聚合最优（EMA/滑窗略低），α=0.7 最优（108.8%），α=0.1 最差（100.8%）。成本：代理采集仅需前向，时间 O(M|D_train|C_fwd)、存储 O(M|D_train|(K+1)d)，实测 6.5 单机小时 / 5.7GB，而梯度投影法需 O(M(|D_train|+|D_target|)(C_fwd+C_bwd))。

Conclusion: GRACE 证明推理数据的价值不仅取决于正确性、长度、偏好等外部指标，还取决于其内部步骤是否「建设性地支撑优化轨迹」；基于梯度对齐的细粒度筛选可用极少数据达到或超过全量后训练效果，且所选子集具备跨模型迁移性。作者指出局限：效用估计依赖固定评分模型与预热配置，迁移到显著不同的优化器/训练目标/模型族需额外验证；实验限于多模态 CoT 后训练，尚未覆盖纯语言推理、非 CoT 指令数据与 RL 后训练；数据效率提升亦可能降低训练更强模型用于非预期有害用途的门槛，需配套数据治理与安全评估。

Abstract: Existing reasoning data curation pipelines score whole samples, treating every intermediate step as equally valuable. In reality, steps within a trace contribute very unevenly, and selecting reasoning data well requires assessing them individually. We present GRACE, a gradient-aligned curation method that views each reasoning trace as a sequence of optimization events and scores every step by two complementary signals: its alignment with the answer-oriented gradient direction, and its consistency with the preceding reasoning trajectory. Step-level scores are aggregated into a sample-level value for subset selection, using only the model's internal optimization signals and no external reward models or step annotations. To make this scalable, GRACE introduces a representation-level gradient proxy that estimates step-level alignment from token-level upstream signals in a single forward pass. Post-training Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct on MMathCoT-1M, GRACE reaches 108.8% of the full-data performance with 20% of the data and retains 100.2% with only 5%, with subsets that transfer effectively across model backbones.

</details>


### [109] [A Constraint Programming Approach for $n$-Day Lookahead Playoff Clinching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13142)
*Gili Rosenberg,Kyle E. C. Booth,J. Kyle Brubaker,Ruben S. Andrist*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了国家冰球联盟(NHL)季后赛席位的提前确定问题，提出了一种结合树搜索和约束规划的算法，能够高效计算球队在接下来n天内如何确保季后赛资格，并验证了2021-22至2024-25赛季数百个场景的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在职业体育中，球迷和利益相关者关心的是球队何时以及在什么条件下能够锁定季后赛席位。NHL的季后赛资格判定涉及复杂的平局决胜规则，使得计算特定球队的锁定条件在计算上具有挑战性。

Method: 采用自定义树搜索方法，结合预处理技术、剪枝策略和节点排序启发式算法来高效探索可能的比赛结果空间。核心是一个基于约束规划(CP)的子程序，用于判断某球队在特定时间点是否已锁定季后赛资格（即"0日预判"），其原理是寻找该球队被淘汰的反例。

Result: 使用2021-22至2024-25赛季的公开NHL数据进行验证，通过数百个场景证明了算法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法可扩展至其他度量指标，包括季后赛数学淘汰的证明、总统奖杯(常规赛冠军)的锁定，以及任何其他排名的锁定或淘汰判定。

Abstract: In professional sports, a team has clinched the playoffs if they are guaranteed a postseason spot, regardless of the outcomes of any remaining games. As the season progresses, sports fans and other stakeholders are interested in precisely when, and under what conditions, their team will clinch the playoffs. In this paper, we investigate playoff clinching in the context of the National Hockey League (NHL), where it is computationally challenging to produce clinching scenarios due, in part, to complex tie-breakers. We present an algorithm that determines under which combinations of game outcomes in the next $n$ days a team will clinch the playoffs (i.e., "$n$-day lookahead clinching"). Our approach is a custom tree search which employs various preprocessing techniques, pruning strategies, and node ordering heuristics to efficiently explore the space of possible outcomes. The tree search leverages a constraint programming (CP)-based subroutine for inference that determines if a team has clinched the playoffs for some snapshot in time of the regular season (i.e., "0-day lookahead clinching"). This CP subroutine aims to find a counter-example in which the team being evaluated is eliminated, taking into account qualification rules and the NHL's extensive list of tie-breakers. We validate the efficacy of our algorithm using hundreds of scenarios based on public NHL data for the seasons 2021-22 through 2024-25. The methods introduced can be readily extended to other metrics of interest, including mathematical proof of playoff elimination, clinching the President's Trophy, as well as clinching (or being eliminated from clinching) any other seed in the standings.

</details>


### [110] [Strikingness-Aware Evaluation for Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13153)
*Rikui Huang,Shengzhe Zhang,Wei Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对时序知识图谱推理（TKGR）评测中“所有事件等权”导致的高估问题，提出 strikingness-aware（惊异度感知）评测框架：以基于一阶时序规则的 RSMF 度量未来事件的惊异度（与同类"peer events"对比其期望发生度），并将其作为权重引入 WMRR / WHits@k；在 ICEWS14/18/05-15、GDELT 四个基准上评测 8 个基线，发现模型性能随惊异度升高而下降，路径类方法擅长低惊异度事件、表示类方法擅长高惊异度事件，且集成方法的增益主要来自拟合平凡重复事件而非推理能力提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前 TKGR（尤其是外推/预测式推理）评测对所有测试事件统一赋权，未区分"平凡重复事件"与"罕见的杰出事件"。作者指出 ICEWS 中超过 80% 的事件在历史中已出现过，模型可通过选择历史最高频答案获得捷径，从而在现有评测下虚高；真正需要深度推理的不到 10%。静态 KGR 曾通过删除逆关系三元组（WN18RR、FB15k-237）缓解该问题，但该做法不适用于 TKG，因为所有历史事件（即便重复）都是预测未来的必要证据，不能删数据。因此需要一个不删数据、而是对测试实例重新赋权的方案：频繁平凡事件权重低，罕见杰出事件（如"签署协议"）权重高。挑战在于：需同时兼顾语义与时序相关性，且未来事件的真实影响力事先不可知，只能从可观测的历史模式中推导惊异度；此外静态 KG 中虽有 outstanding fact mining 的工作，TKGR 领域尚缺相关研究。

Method: 框架分三部分。(1) RSMF（Rule-based Strikingness Measuring Framework）度量事件 f=(s,r,o,t) 的 strikingness∈[0,1]：①同伴事件检索——先用规则挖掘得到关系 r 对应的一阶时序规则集 TR，规则形如 (E1,r_h,E2,T2)←(E1,r_b,E2,T1)；将目标事件掩码为查询，在时间窗 [t-w, t) 的历史 KG 上对规则体接地得到候选实体集合 C_f^s / C_f^o / C_f^r，生成 peer events，避免无意义的直接替换（如"Markieff Morris join Microsoft"）。②期望发生度——对每个 peer event 迭代收集规则接地对 RG（含时序约束 t_y<t_h，令最近一次 t_h=t），得分 sc = Σ_tr Σ_rg conf(tr)·e^{-λ(t-t_y)}，即规则置信度 × 指数时序衰减；按被替换元素（s/o/r）形成三个分数向量并做 L2 归一化。③惊异度计算——沿用 Angiulli et al. 的 strikingness 度量：sk_f^be = Σ sc_f'·(sc_f'-sc_f)·I(sc_f'>sc_f)，再按 α^s=0.4、α^o=0.4、α^r=0.2 加权求和得 sk_f（附录给出 [0,1] 有界性证明）。(2) 惊异度感知评测——以 (s_i + b) 为权重定义 WMRR 与 WHits@k（b=0.1 时 sk=1 的事件权重约为 sk=0 的 11 倍），b 控制对杰出事件误报的惩罚；b→∞ 时退化为原始 MRR。(3) 简单的路径类与表示类模型输出分数线性集成 y_ensem = η·y_path + (1-η)·y_rep，η 在验证集网格搜索。作者强调集成的目的不是刷榜，而是探测模型能力边界。实验遵循统一的时序感知过滤协议（NEC TKG-Forecasting-Evaluation），规则学习、置信度与 strikingness 计算严格限于训练集与查询时间戳之前以避免泄漏。

Result: 主要发现：（1）按 strikingness 分组后，所有模型性能随 strikingness 升高单调下降（Welch t 检验与 Mann-Whitney U 检验在 sk<0.2 与 sk>0.8 两组间均 p<0.001，t>60，ΔHits@3>35%）；低 strikingness 事件占测试集绝大多数，呈长尾分布。（2）方法族存在系统性差异：路径类方法（Recurrency、TITer、TLogic）在低 strikingness 事件上更优，在高 strikingness 事件上大幅退化，原始与 striking-aware 指标下降超过 30%（Recurrency 达 50%），说明其"多跳推理"宣称站不住脚；表示类方法（RE-GCN、TiRGN、LogCL）下降小于 30%（LogCL 约 20%），在高 strikingness 上更优；LLM 类（ICL、GenTKG）因上下文窗口受限，表现类似路径类。（3）集成方法在原始指标上提升显著（ICEWS14 WMRR 48.84→51.35），但在 striking-aware 指标下增益大幅缩水（38.17→38.67），分析表明增益来自占比最大的低 strikingness 平凡事件，而在罕见高 strikingness 事件上反而下降（"trade-off" sk<0.1 或 sk>0.5，"enhancement" 仅出现在 0.1<sk<0.5）。（4）b 的取值会改变模型排名：b>0.1 时 Ensemble 优于 LogCL、TiRGN 优于 RE-GCN；b<0.1 时相反，说明 LogCL/RE-GCN 在杰出事件上更优。（5）可预测性分析：引入邻域重叠度 NO_f，高 strikingness 区间内 NO_f 高（历史交互丰富）的事件明显更易预测，佐证 strikingness 反映的是证据稀缺导致的难度而非纯粹不可学。（6）人工评估：6 名 AI 领域研究生在 3000 个事件对上与 RSMF 的 Cohen's Kappa 平均 0.696（substantial agreement）；案例显示 sk=1.0 的"Commando (Kosovo) Occupy territory Serbia"等高关注事件与 sk=0.005 的常规"France Consult Germany"区分明显。（7）与 Freq Inv / Temp Inv 两个朴素基线相比，RSMF 产生真实长尾分布、单调难度梯度，并能区分模型族，前两者分布居中且难以区分模型。（8）超参（τ、α、w、λ、b）变化会改变 strikingness 分布但模型相对排名保持稳定，框架鲁棒。

Conclusion: 当前 TKGR 评测过度加权平凡重复事件，掩盖了模型预测罕见有意义事件的能力。作者提出基于规则接地与同伴事件对比的 strikingness 度量，并构建以 strikingness 为动态权重的评测框架（WMRR/WHits@k），在不删除任何数据的前提下使评测更贴近真实未来事件预测难度。实验证明：该框架能给出真实长尾的惊异度分布、单调的难度梯度、可区分的模型族能力差异，并揭示集成方法的提升主要来自记忆重复事件而非推理能力，从而把该领域的关注点重新引向"预测杰出事件"与超越重复的深层推理；后续工作可探索更高阶/混合规则或近似策略，并进一步提升高 strikingness 事件的预测能力。

Abstract: Temporal Knowledge Graph Reasoning (TKGR) aims at inferring missing (especially future) events from historical data. Current evaluation in TKGR uniformly weights all events, ignoring that most are trivial repetitions, which overestimate the true reasoning ability. Therefore, the rare outstanding events, whose prediction demands deeper reasoning, should be distinguished and emphasized. To this end, we propose a strikingness-aware evaluation framework, which introduces a rule-based strikingness measuring framework (RSMF) to quantify event strikingness by comparing its expected occurrence with peer events derived from temporal rules. Strikingness is then integrated as a weighting factor into metrics like weighted MRR and Hits@k. Experiments on four TKG benchmarks reveal: 1) All representative models perform worse as event strikingness increases, 2) Path-based methods excel on low-strikingness events and representation-based ones on high-strikingness events, 3) We design an ensemble method whose gains stem from fitting trivial events rather than reasoning improvement. Our framework provides a more rigorous evaluation, refocusing the field on predicting outstanding events.

</details>


### [111] [Formal Conjectures: An Open and Evolving Benchmark for Verified Discovery in Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13171)
*Moritz Firsching,Paul Lezeau,Salvatore Mercuri,Miklós Z. Horváth,Yaël Dillies,Calle Sönne,Eric Wieser,Fred Zhang,Thomas Hubert,Blaise Agüera y Arcas,Pushmeet Kohli*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Formal Conjectures是一个包含2615个形式化数学问题的大规模基准数据集，其中1029个为开放的未解决研究猜想，836个为已解决的证明问题，全部使用Lean 4形式化。该基准已被用于辅助数学发现，并建立了AI生成证明作为审核机制来确保形式化正确性的协作框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着自动推理系统的快速发展，现有的基准测试已无法准确评估其在研究级数学问题上的能力，因此需要一个专门针对活跃数学研究领域的正式基准测试来填补这一空白。

Method: 构建了一个包含2615个数学问题的Lean 4形式化基准，通过结构化接口连接数学家与AI系统；采用协作开源方式确保形式化正确性，并利用AI生成的证明/反例作为审核机制迭代改进基准质量。

Result: 基准测试已成功辅助数学发现，包括解决开放研究猜想；建立了标准化评估设置和基线结果，展示了可衡量的研究级自动推理前沿能力。

Conclusion: Formal Conjectures提供了一个可持续演进的评估框架，通过人机协作和AI审核机制相结合，为推动自动推理在研究级数学领域的发展提供了重要基础设施。

Abstract: As automated reasoning systems advance rapidly, there is a growing need for research-level formal mathematical problems to accurately evaluate their capabilities. To address this, we present Formal Conjectures, an evolving benchmark of currently 2615 mathematical problem statements formalized in Lean 4. Sourced from areas of active mathematical research, the dataset features 1029 open research conjectures providing a zero-contamination benchmark for mathematical proof discovery, and 836 solved problems for proof autoformalization. Notably, the repository provides a structured interface connecting mathematicians who formalize and clarify problems with the AI systems and humans attempting to solve them. Demonstrating its immediate utility, the benchmark has already been leveraged to make new mathematical discoveries, including the resolution of open research conjectures. We describe our approach to ensuring the correctness of these formalizations in a collaborative open-source project where contributions stem from an active community. In this framework, AI-generated proofs and disproofs serve as a valuable auditing mechanism to iteratively improve the fidelity of the benchmark. Finally, we provide a standardized evaluation setup and report baseline results on frozen evaluation subsets, demonstrating a climbable signal that measures the current frontier of automated reasoning on research-level mathematics.

</details>


### [112] [Hierarchical Attacks for Multi-Modal Multi-Agent Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13213)
*Hao Zhou,Tiru Wu,Yan Jiang,Wanqi Zhou,Junxing Hu,Ai Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HAM³框架，首次系统性地研究多模态多智能体系统(MM-MAS)的三层对抗攻击：感知层、通信层和推理层。在GQA基准测试中，该框架达到78.3%的攻击成功率，其中推理层攻击最为有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击研究主要聚焦于单智能体或单模态场景，而多模态多智能体系统的潜在漏洞尚未得到充分探索。随着MM-MAS规模与功能不断扩展，研究其安全脆弱性变得日益重要。

Method: 提出HAM³层级攻击框架，从三个互联层次分解攻击：(1)感知层：扰动视觉输入、文本输入及融合的视觉-文本表示；(2)通信层：破坏消息内容和交互拓扑，如操纵共享上下文或通信链路；(3)推理层：干扰智能体的认知流程，偏置推理轨迹。在GQA基准上评估基于ReAct、Plan-and-Solve和Reflexion三种推理范式构建的多智能体系统。

Result: 实验表明HAM³达到最高78.3%的攻击成功率，推理层攻击效果最为显著，超过半数成功攻击导致多个智能体产生一致错误。

Conclusion: HAM³揭示了多模态多智能体系统的多层安全脆弱性，推理层攻击最具威胁性。该研究为构建更鲁棒和可解释的多智能体系统提供了重要参考。

Abstract: Multi-modal multi-agent systems (MM-MAS) have gained increasing attention for their capacity to enable complex reasoning and coordination across diverse modalities. As these systems continue to expand in scale and functionality, investigating their potential vulnerabilities has become increasingly important. However, existing studies on adversarial attacks in multi-agent systems primarily focus on isolated agents or unimodal settings, leaving the vulnerabilities of MM-MAS largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce HAM$^{3}$, a Hierarchical Attack framework for multi-modal multi-agent systems that decomposes attacks into three interconnected layers. Specifically, at the perception layer, HAM$^{3}$ mounts attacks by perturbing visual inputs, textual inputs, and their fused visual-textual representations. At the communication layer, it performs communication-level attacks that corrupt message content and interaction topology, such as manipulating shared context or communication links to distort collective information flow. At the reasoning layer, it conducts reasoning-level attacks that interfere with each agent's cognitive pipeline, biasing reasoning trajectories and ultimately compromising final decisions. We evaluate HAM$^{3}$ on the GQA benchmark through multi-agent systems built on distinct reasoning paradigms including ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, and Reflexion. Experiments demonstrate that our framework achieves an Attack Success Rate of up to 78.3%, with reasoning-layer attacks being the most effective. More than half of the successful attacks lead multiple agents to produce consistent errors. These findings offer valuable insights for building more robust and interpretable multi-agent intelligence.

</details>


### [113] [An Agentic AI Framework with Large Language Models and Chain-of-Thought for UAV-Assisted Logistics Scheduling with Mobile Edge Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13221)
*Hanwen Zhang,Dusit Niyato,Wei Zhang,Xin Lou,Malcolm Yoke Hean Low*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个"智能体AI（Agentic AI）+分层PPO"框架，用于云制造中无人机（UAV）产品回收与移动边缘计算（MEC）任务卸载的联合调度。智能体AI部分用LLM+检索增强生成（RAG）+思维链（CoT）把自然语言需求转换为可解释的数学规划模型；优化部分用两层PPO，上层学UAV路径、下层按时隙做任务执行位置与计算/通信资源分配。仿真显示：6次运行中5次的公式正确率/约束完整度/精确率均达100%、幻觉率0%；分层PPO在最近500回合中99.6%实现全量产品回收，截止期满足率100%，稳定性优于A2C。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云制造（CMfg）中，UAV既要回收产成品，又要为工业传感器设备（ISD）提供移动边缘计算（MEC）服务，形成物理物流与计算任务调度紧耦合的混合调度问题，其难点有两条：Challenge I——问题建模复杂，UAV路径决定了各站点"服务窗口"的存在，而该窗口又决定卸载位置、算力/通信分配与截止期可行性，且路径还受能量、载荷、距离、任务时间约束，这类跨层耦合的组合优化模型难以手工推导，线性化（如Big-M、服务窗口指示变量、能量分项）工作繁重；Challenge II——求解复杂度高，物流决策与计算决策必须联合优化而非割裂处理，联合动作空间随UAV数M、站点数U、任务数急剧膨胀（单层MDP动作空间量级为 (M+2)^U (2U+2)^{K_g}），且反馈稀疏、动作表示复杂（离散执行模式+连续资源分配）。既有工作要么只做移动路径规划、要么只做通信视角的边缘可用性建模，均未把"路径—服务窗口—能量预算—截止期"闭环耦合起来；同时制造业中的LLM应用多停留在问答、APS辅助或概念框架层面，缺乏从自然语言到可解释优化模型的自动化生成能力。作者因此希望用智能体AI自动生成模型（解决建模难），再用可扩展的分层DRL求解（解决求解难）。

Method: 1）系统与模型：以仓库（depot）为中心的同构UAV队，从制造站点回收成品并返航；ISD在离散时隙随机产生计算任务，任务可在本地、UAV机载、或经UAV中继到云端执行。UAV路径侧给出分配变量y、弧变量x、起降时刻T^arr/T^dep、最小服务时长、Big-M线性时序约束，并证明时序约束自动消除子回路。计算侧给出执行模式选择、完工时间编码、时隙级算力/上行/回传容量约束、模式一致性、累积服务充分性（含γ有效速率因子）、服务窗口指示η与"非服务窗口则UAV相关分配为0"的耦合约束、截止期约束，以及飞行/悬停+机载计算+通信三部分能量预算。目标函数为回收价值+准时完成收益−超期惩罚−流程时间惩罚−归一化资源占用惩罚（式32），并论证两个子问题均为NP-hard（受限情形含PARTITION）。

2）智能体AI：自建11个领域知识Markdown的RAG语料（系统实体、记号、目标模式、UAV路由约束、MEC服务约束、跨层耦合记录、通用建模原语与模型变体），递归文本切分（chunk 1800字符、重叠300）、text-embedding-ada-002编码、Chroma向量库、余弦相似度Top-4检索。流程为"规划器（独立LLM调用，生成CoT分步计划）→ Responder Agent（带RAG工具+短期记忆）→ Verifier Agent（独立检索器+独立指令+独立记忆）"，四步CoT：目标函数、UAV路由约束、任务卸载约束、记号总结；每步响应交Verifier校验，未通过则退回重想（限次），采用responder–verifier工作流（不同于APS多智能体SOP工作流）。

3）分层PPO：上层为集中式路由MDP，状态含UAV状态/路径进度/站点属性/任务级上下文，动作=优先度分数+离散路由符号（stay/add(m)/complete），含可行性掩码，奖励含回收价值、覆盖/负载均衡/路径终止塑形项与不可行惩罚、终止结算。下层为时隙级MEC调度MDP，状态含ISD统计、UAV资源、全局标量、UAV–ISD在途卸载状态、服务窗口可用性掩码、Top-N_q任务快照；动作为前K_g个队列位置的三元组（执行位置local/UAV(u)/cloud-via-UAV(u)/SKIP + 归一化算力/通信连续分配，环境量化为离散档位），按EDF排队优先级调度，奖励含完成/派发/进展、势函数塑形（backlog、urgency）、超期/不可行/空转/资源占用/在途负载惩罚与终止结算。上层先训练并固定，其输出（各UAV-站点服务窗口与残余能量裕度）作为下层输入，信息流单向，不做下层到上层的反馈。

Result: 智能体AI部分：6次重复运行中5次的公式正确率FC、约束完整度/召回CC、约束精确率CP均为100%，幻觉率HR为0%，与RAG证据语义一致率SC_RAG为100%；仅第3次出现FC 90.91%、CC/CP 90%、HR 9.09%、SC_RAG 90.91%（错误为累积服务充分性约束未按声明完工时隙截断，导致"未交付服务即标记完工"的时序不一致）。Verifier在73个用例上得TA=35、FA=1、FR=4、TR=33，即FAR 2.94%、FRR 10.26%、准确率93.15%，误拒主要源于对线性化、记号、单位与参数域的额外要求。成本0.69–1.33美元、时延241.99–368.97秒、token用量2.23M–5.00M。消融呈单调改善：Direct LLM（FC 54.55%、HR 45.45%）→RAG-only（72.73%、27.27%）→RAG+CoT（90.91%、9.09%）；语义失真示例：基线把归一化资源占用惩罚改写为原始分配量求和。三种用户提示分解（6/4/3步）均可达FC/CC/CP/SC_RAG 100%，但粗粒度提示使Verifier准确率降至84.62%以下，故推荐细粒度6步提示。分层DRL部分：上层PPO的MA(50)奖励稳定在约400，收率接近100%；下层PPO与A2C均收敛到正奖励，但PPO后期奖励波动更小、能稳定保持接近100%的截止期满足率，而A2C后期出现多次骤降；所提分层PPO在最近500个回合中99.6%实现全量产品回收，截止期满足率100%。复杂度上，上层O(N_up·T̄_up·(UM+P))、下层O(N_lo·T̄_lo·(UK+N_q+K_gU+P))，均为多项式规模，远小于单层MDP的指数动作空间。作者同时声明：实验为"名义负载、可行性导向"的单场景设置，未做资源饱和压力测试、多随机种子显著性检验、异构机队/更真实信道/更大规模/分布外任务到达的泛化验证。

Conclusion: 论文首次在智能制造领域用"LLM+RAG+CoT"智能体AI为云制造中的混合组合优化问题生成可解释数学模型，并用分层PPO求解：智能体AI把非结构化需求可靠地转换为含跨层耦合（服务窗口、能源、截止期）的MILP式公式，验证器-响应者工作流显著抑制幻觉并保持语义忠实；分层PPO在保持跨层协调（路径→服务窗口→资源分配）的同时把联合动作空间从指数级降到多项式级，取得近乎全收集、100%截止期满足的可行且稳定的结果。局限与展望：（1）验证仅限步内，无跨步全局一致性检查与回溯机制，计划引入全局公式记录（决策变量、参数、目标项、约束族、跨步依赖）并做回溯修订；（2）层次训练为单向顺序式，下层MEC指标未反馈到上层路径优化，未来需带收敛控制的反馈感知/迭代式训练；（3）评估面窄：需补充资源受限压力测试、多种子显著性检验、异构UAV、更真实无线信道与动态任务到达、不同规模与约束组合下的系统评估，并扩展消融至替代验证设计、启发式/单体PPO/滚动时域优化/掩码感知SAC-TD3等基线。

Abstract: In cloud manufacturing, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) can support both product collection and mobile edge computing (MEC). This joint operation forms a hybrid scheduling problem, where physical logistics decisions are coupled with computational task scheduling. In this paper, UAVs collect finished products from manufacturing stations and transport them back to a central depot. Meanwhile, computational tasks generated by industrial sensor devices at these stations are processed locally, at UAVs, or offloaded via UAVs to the cloud. This coupling makes the problem challenging. A UAV can provide MEC services only during its service window at a station, so routing decisions directly determine when UAV-assisted offloading is available. Routing decisions also affect the UAV energy budget and the availability of onboard computing and communication resources for computational task execution under task deadline constraints. To address this, we propose an agentic-AI-assisted optimization framework with two components. First, we develop an agentic AI that combines large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, and chain-of-thought reasoning to translate user input into an interpretable mathematical formulation for the hybrid scheduling problem. Second, we design a hierarchical deep reinforcement learning approach based on proximal policy optimization (PPO), where the upper layer learns UAV routing and the lower layer optimizes per-slot task execution and resource allocation. Simulation results show that the proposed framework yields more consistent formulations, while the hierarchical PPO achieves full product collection in 99.6% of the last 500 episodes and maintains a 100% deadline satisfaction rate, with more stable performance than the advantage actor-critic approach.

</details>


### [114] [It's not the Language Model, it's the Tool: Deterministic Mediation for Scientific Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13245)
*Marios Adamidis,Danae Katrisioti,Yannis Tzitzikas,Emmanuel Stratakis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: The paper proposes "typed mediation" as a pattern where LLMs invoke deterministic tools encoding exact researcher procedures rather than generating code, ensuring reproducibility in scientific workflows. The method guarantees identical outputs across regenerations, validated across multiple commercial platforms and deployed successfully on real instruments.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Language models produce inconsistent results when regenerating the same scientific query—varying fits, peak positions, or analytical procedures—creating a trust problem for researchers who need reproducible outcomes.

Method: The approach uses structured interviews to port each researcher's exact analytical procedure as a deterministic tool, which the LLM selects and calls rather than generating code. Evaluation involved photoluminescence analysis across four platforms (three commercial foundation models), each run four times with identical prompts.

Result: The typed tool produced identical results across all runs. Commercial platforms either showed numerical/methodological variance or failed to produce valid results. Deployment over six months on two instruments (with proprietary formats and per-seat licensed software) received positive user feedback.

Conclusion: Typed mediation represents a practical deployment pattern for scientific LLM applications where reproducibility is mandatory, reducing analysis time from weeks to minutes while guaranteeing identical outputs across runs.

Abstract: Language models can produce convincing scientific analyses, but repeated generations on the same data do not guarantee the same result. A researcher may regenerate an identical query and receive a different fit, a different peak position or a different analysis procedure, without an obvious way to decide which output to trust. We propose typed mediation, a pattern in which the model orchestrates deterministic tools rather than generating analytical code. Each tool encodes one researcher's exact procedure for one instrument, ported through structured interviews. The model selects which tool to call and with what parameters. The tool produces the result. Regeneration does not change it. We evaluate this claim by running the same photoluminescence analysis on four platforms, including three commercial foundation models, four times each with the same prompt. The typed tool produces identical results across all runs. The commercial platforms either vary in numerical output and analytical methodology across runs, or fail to produce valid results on the task. We deploy this pattern on two instruments serving users over approximately six months, with very positive user feedback. Both cases are very challenging: they involve proprietary binary formats and per-seat licensed software, which force the tool to remain on local infrastructure alongside the data and the instrument it operates. We argue that deployment topology is not just a preference, but a structural requirement of scientific tool mediation. The result is a practical pattern for deploying language models in scientific workflows where reproducibility is mandatory, reducing analysis time from weeks to minutes while guaranteeing identical outputs across runs.

</details>


### [115] [Respecting Self-Uncertainty in On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13255)
*Junlong Ke,Zichen Wen,Weijia Li,Conghui He,Linfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EGRSD和CL-EGRSD，通过熵引导的token级加权机制改进自蒸馏，解决思维链中不同位置可靠性差异问题，在Qwen3模型上实现精度-长度权衡的提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自蒸馏方法对思维链中的token均匀加权，但教师预测分布的熵在不同位置差异显著，均匀加权无法反映token级学习信号的可靠性。

Method: 提出 EGRSD 框架，统一三个信号：基于奖励的方向、师生似然比幅度、以及教师-熵置信门控（降低高熵token权重但保持非零下界）。进一步提出 CL-EGRSD 因果前看变体，区分持续高熵区间与短暂高熵位置。

Result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B思考模式下，EGRSD和CL-EGRSD在可训练方法中提升了精度-长度前沿。

Conclusion: EGRSD and CL-EGRSD successfully advance the accuracy-length frontier among trainable methods on Qwen3 models, validating the effectiveness of entropy-guided weighting in self-distillation for reasoning tasks.

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation trains a reasoning model on its own rollouts while a teacher, often the same model conditioned on privileged context, provides dense token-level supervision. Existing objectives typically weight the teacher's token-level signal uniformly across a chain-of-thought sequence, despite substantial variation in the entropy of the teacher's predictive distribution. We propose EGRSD (Entropy-Guided Reinforced Self-Distillation), which unifies token-level updates through three signals: a reward-grounded direction, a teacher-student likelihood-ratio magnitude, and the proposed teacher-entropy confidence gate that down-weights high-entropy token positions while maintaining a nonzero lower bound on every token weight. We further introduce CL-EGRSD, a causal-lookahead variant that distinguishes sustained high-entropy spans from transient high-entropy positions whose following context rapidly becomes low entropy. Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B in thinking mode show that EGRSD and CL-EGRSD advance the accuracy-length frontier among the compared trainable methods.

</details>


### [116] [D-VLA: A High-Concurrency Distributed Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning Framework for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13276)
*Yucheng Guo,Yongjian Guo,Zhong Guan,Wen Huang,Haoran Sun,Haodong Yue,Xiaolong Xiang,Shuai Di,Zhen Sun,Luqiao Wang,Junwu Xiong,Yicheng Gong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: D-VLA是一个面向十亿参数级VLA模型的高并发、低延迟分布式强化学习框架，通过"平面解耦"和"泳道"流水线等创新设计，显著提升了大规模具身智能训练的系统吞吐量和采样效率，在万亿参数扩展性测试中保持线性加速和稳定性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在分布式强化学习训练中面临严峻的系统瓶颈：高保真物理仿真与深度学习GPU显存/带宽需求之间存在严重的资源冲突，导致整体吞吐量受限于执行阶段的低效性。这严重制约了大规模具身基础模型的训练效率。

Method: D-VLA提出三项核心技术：(1) 平面解耦（Plane Decoupling）：物理隔离高频训练数据流与低频权重控制流，消除仿真与优化间的干扰；(2) 四线程异步泳道流水线（Swimlane）：实现采样、推理、梯度计算和参数分发的全并行重叠；(3) 双池VRAM管理模型与拓扑感知复制：解决内存碎片化问题并优化通信效率。

Result: 在LIBERO等基准测试上，D-VLA在吞吐量和采样效率上显著优于主流RL框架。万亿参数扩展性测试表明该框架保持卓越稳定性，实现线性加速。

Conclusion: D-VLA为高性能通用具身智能体提供了一个鲁棒的高性能分布式训练系统，有效解决了大规模VLA模型RL训练的系统瓶颈问题。

Abstract: The rapid evolution of Embodied AI has enabled Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to excel in multimodal perception and task execution. However, applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to these massive models in large-scale distributed environments faces severe systemic bottlenecks, primarily due to the resource conflict between high-fidelity physical simulation and the intensive VRAM/bandwidth demands of deep learning. This conflict often leaves overall throughput constrained by execution-phase inefficiencies. To address these challenges, we propose D-VLA, a high-concurrency, low-latency distributed RL framework for large-scale embodied foundation models. D-VLA introduces "Plane Decoupling," physically isolating high-frequency training data from low-frequency weight control to eliminate interference between simulation and optimization. We further design a four-thread asynchronous "Swimlane" pipeline, enabling full parallel overlap of sampling, inference, gradient computation, and parameter distribution. Additionally, a dual-pool VRAM management model and topology-aware replication resolve memory fragmentation and optimize communication efficiency. Experiments on benchmarks like LIBERO show that D-VLA significantly outperforms mainstream RL frameworks in throughput and sampling efficiency for billion-parameter VLA models. In trillion-parameter scalability tests, our framework maintains exceptional stability and linear speedup, providing a robust system for high-performance general-purpose embodied agents.

</details>


### [117] [Differentiable Learning of Lifted Action Schemas for Classical Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13282)
*Jonas Reiter,Jakob Elias Gebler,Hector Geffner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: This paper presents a neural network architecture for learning lifted action schemas from traces where states are fully observed but action arguments are unobserved. The method addresses the dual challenge of schema learning and argument identification simultaneously, providing a robust differentiable component for integration into neuro-symbolic planning models.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Classical planners can solve large deterministic MDPs with lifted action schemas that enable strong search heuristics and structural generalization across domain instances. However, learning these relations and action schemas from data remains a central challenge, especially when action arguments are unobserved while state changes are known.

Method: A novel neural network architecture that simultaneously learns action schemas and identifies action arguments from observed state changes. The method treats states as sets of atoms over objects and relations, learning from traces where states are fully observed but action arguments are unobserved.

Result: Evaluated on various planning domains, the learned lifted action schemas successfully recover ground-truth structure. The architecture also demonstrates robustness to observation noise and performs well on variations related to slot-based dynamics models.

Conclusion: The approach yields a robust differentiable component that can be integrated into larger neuro-symbolic models, and experiments show it can recover ground-truth structure and maintain robustness to observation noise and slot-based dynamics variations.

Abstract: Classical planners can effectively solve very large deterministic MDPs represented in STRIPS or PDDL where states are sets of atoms over objects and relations, and lifted action schemas add or delete these atoms. This compact representation yields strong search heuristics and provides an ideal setting for structural generalization, since lifted relations and action schemas give rise to infinitely many domain instances. A central challenge is to learn these relations and action schemas from data, and recent approaches have addressed this problem using different types of observations. In this work, we develop a novel neural network architecture for learning action schemas from traces where states are fully observed but action arguments are unobserved. The problem is a simplification but an important step towards learning planning domains from sequences of images and action labels, and we aim to solve this simplification in a nearly perfect manner. The challenge lies in learning the action schemas while simultaneously identifying the action arguments from observed state changes. Our approach yields a robust differentiable component that can then be integrated into larger neuro-symbolic models. We evaluate the architecture on various planning domains, where the learned lifted action schemas must recover the ground-truth structure. Additionally, we report experiments on robustness to observation noise and on a variation related to slot-based dynamics models.

</details>


### [118] [What properties of reasoning supervision are associated with improved downstream model quality?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13290)
*Mikołaj Langner,Dzmitry Pihulski,Jan Eliasz,Michał Rajkowski,Przemysław Kazienko,Maciej Piasecki,Jan Kocoń,Teddy Ferdinan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究解决了推理模型训练数据验证成本高的问题，提出一套可在训练前预测数据效用的内在度量指标，发现指标的有效性随模型规模变化——小模型需精确对齐，大模型需冗余信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型的训练数据验证通常需要昂贵的试错式微调循环，研究旨在探索是否可以在训练前通过内在数据指标可靠地预测推理数据集的效用。

Method: 研究提出了量化度量指标套件，通过在8B和11B模型上微调波兰语推理数据集的语义不同变体来评估这些指标的预测能力，并分析了模型规模与有效指标之间的关系。

Result: 实验发现内在指标与下游模型性能之间存在强且显著的相关性，且预测效用的指标具有规模依赖性：较小的模型依赖对齐导向指标以保证精确性，而较大的模型则受益于高冗余性，利用冗长的推理痕迹来解决复杂任务。

Conclusion: 研究建立了规模感知的推理数据验证框架，使从业者能够在无需大量实验测试的情况下选择有效的训练数据集，降低了推理模型训练数据筛选的成本。

Abstract: Validating training data for reasoning models typically requires expensive trial-and-error fine-tuning cycles. In this work, we investigate whether the utility of a reasoning dataset can be reliably predicted prior to training using intrinsic data metrics. We propose a suite of quantitative measures and evaluate their predictive power by fine-tuning 8B and 11B models on semantically distinct variants of a Polish reasoning dataset. Our analysis reveals that these intrinsic metrics demonstrate strong and significant correlations with downstream model performance. Crucially, we find that the predictors of utility are scale-dependent: smaller models rely on alignment-focused metrics to ensure precision, whereas larger models benefit from high redundancy, utilizing verbose traces to solve complex tasks. These findings establish a scale-aware framework for validating reasoning data, enabling practitioners to select effective training sets without the need for exhaustive empirical testing.

</details>


### [119] [Achieving Gold-Medal-Level Olympiad Reasoning via Simple and Unified Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13301)
*Yafu Li,Runzhe Zhan,Haoran Zhang,Shunkai Zhang,Yizhuo Li,Zhilin Wang,Jiacheng Chen,Futing Wang,Xuyang Hu,Yuchen Fan,Bangjie Xu,Yucheng Su,Xinmiao Han,Chenxi Li,Haodi Lei,Yufeng Zhao,Zejin Lin,Qianjia Cheng,Tong Zhu,Xiaoye Qu,Ganqu Cui,Peng Ye,Yun Luo,Zhouchen Lin,Yu Qiao,Bowen Zhou,Ning Ding,Yu Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出将后训练推理骨干模型转化为奥赛级求解器的统一配方，包含逆困惑度课程SFT、两阶段RL和测试时扩展三个阶段。基于30B-A3B骨干训练的SU-01模型在IMO/IPhO问题上达到金牌水平，并能泛化至数学物理之外的科学推理领域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型虽在长时域数学和科学问题求解上取得进展，但缺乏将后训练推理骨干转化为严格奥赛级求解器的统一方法。

Method: 采用逆向困惑度课程进行SFT以培养严格证明搜索和自我检查行为；通过两阶段RL管道从可验证奖励的RL扩展到精细的证明级RL；最终通过测试时扩展提升解题性能。

Result: 训练了30B-A3B骨干模型，仅用约340K条子8K-token轨迹的SFT和200步RL，即实现超过100K token的稳定推理，并在数学和物理奥赛中达到金牌级水平。

Conclusion: SU-01模型在IMO 2025/USAMO 2026和IPhO 2024/2025中达到金牌水平，并在数学物理之外的领域展现出泛化能力；该配方为将后训练推理骨干模型转化为严格奥赛级求解器提供了一条简单统一的路径。

Abstract: Recent progress in reasoning models has substantially advanced long-horizon mathematical and scientific problem solving, with several systems now reaching gold-medal-level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) and International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) problems. In this paper, we introduce a simple and unified recipe for converting a post-trained reasoning backbone into a rigorous olympiad-level solver. The recipe first uses a reverse-perplexity curriculum for SFT to instill rigorous proof-search and self-checking behaviors, then scales these behaviors through a two-stage RL pipeline that progresses from RL with verifiable rewards to more delicate proof-level RL, and finally boosts solving performance with test-time scaling. Applying this recipe, we train a 30B-A3B backbone with SFT on around 340K sub-8K-token trajectories followed by 200 RL steps. The resulting model, SU-01, supports stable reasoning on difficult problems with trajectories exceeding 100K tokens, while achieving gold-medal-level performance on mathematical and physical olympiad competitions, including IMO 2025/USAMO 2026 and IPhO 2024/2025. It also demonstrates strong generalization of scientific reasoning to domains beyond mathematics and physics.

</details>


### [120] [VERA-MH: Validation of Ethical and Responsible AI in Mental Health](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13318)
*Luca Belli,Kate H. Bentley,Josh Gieringer,Emily Van Ark,Nilu Zhao,Pradip Thachile,Matt Hawrilenko,Millard Brown,Adam M. Chekroud*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VERA-MH是一个临床验证的评估框架，用于评估聊天机器人在心理健康支持场景（尤其是自杀意念风险）中的安全性，采用对话模拟、LLM-as-a-Judge评判和结果聚合三步法，评估量表采用流程式单一是/否问题设计，已对四家主流LLM提供商进行了评估测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聊天机器人使用范围不断扩展，已涉及并非其设计目标的领域，特别是心理健康支持领域，因此需要专门的评估框架来验证聊天机器人在危机情境下对有自杀意念用户的安全响应能力。

Method: 采用三步法评估：1）使用另一个聊天机器人扮演基于临床指导开发的特定用户角色进行对话模拟；2）使用第二个支持模型作为LLM-as-a-Judge，配合临床开发的评分量表进行对话评判；3）聚合每轮对话结果得出最终评估。量表设计为流程式结构，每次仅问一个是/否问题以提高答案一致性和突出模型失败模式。

Result: 开发了首个临床验证的、用于评估心理健康支持聊天机器人安全性的框架VERA-MH，覆盖多个风险因素、人口统计学特征和披露因素。

Conclusion: 评估框架包含三个步骤（对话模拟、对话评判和模型评分），并展示了四个主流LLM提供商的评估结果，证明了该框架的实用性和临床价值。

Abstract: Chatbot usage has increased, including in fields for which they were never developed for--notably mental health support. To that end, we introduce Validations of Ethical and Responsible AI in Mental Health (VERA-MH), a novel clinically-validated evaluation for safety of chatbots in the context of mental health support. The first iteration of VERA-MH focuses on Suicidal Ideation (SI) risks, by assessing how well chatbots can responds to users that might be in crisis.
  VERA-MH is comprised of three steps: conversation simulation, conversation judging and model rating. First, to simulate conversations with the chatbot under evaluation, another chatbot is tasked with role-playing users based on specific personas. Such user personas have been developed under clinical guidance, to make sure that, among others, multiple risk factors, demographic characteristics and disclosure factors were represented. In the judging step, a second support model is used as an LLM-as-a-Judge, together with a clinically-developed rubric. The rubric is structured as a flow, with a single Yes/No question asked each time, to improve answers' consistency and highlight models' failure modes. In the last stage, results of each conversation are aggregated to present the final evaluation of the chatbot. Together with the framework, we present the result of the evaluations for four leading LLM providers.

</details>


### [121] [Diversity of Extensions in Abstract Argumentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13332)
*Johannes K. Fichte,Markus Hecher,Yasir Mahmood,Zhengjun Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在抽象论证框架(AF)中引入了一种基于对称差集的扩展多样性定量度量，并提供了系统的计算复杂度分类。研究了AF是否承认k-多样性扩展、是否承认覆盖特定论证的k-多样性扩展，以及计算最大k值等问题，并开发了原型工具进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统抽象论证框架的语义仅通过扩展(extensions)判定哪些论证可被接受，但无法量化不同扩展之间的差异程度。当两个扩展仅有少量论证不同时，它们代表的是"边缘观点差异"还是"根本性不兼容的论证集"这一关键问题无法被揭示。

Method: 基于对称差(symmetric difference)运算定义扩展间的多样性度量，将定性研究推进至定量分析。对三种核心问题进行计算复杂度分类：(1)是否存在k-多样性扩展；(2)是否存在覆盖特定论证的k-多样性扩展；(3)计算最大k值。开发原型工具进行实验评估。

Result: 建立了多样性概念的严格形式化框架，给出了各问题的复杂度分类结果。实验验证了算法可行性，能够有效计算实际AF的多样性水平。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了论证推理中"扩展相似性/差异性"量化研究的空白，为论证系统的深入分析提供了新维度。复杂度结果为算法设计和应用可行性提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Argumentation is an important topic of AI for modelling and reasoning about arguments. In abstract argumentation, we consider directed graphs, so-called argumentation frameworks (AF), that express conflicts between arguments. The semantics is defined by the notion of extensions, which are sets of arguments that satisfy particular relationship conditions in the AF. Usually, standard reasoning in argumentation do not reveal how far apart extensions are. We introduce a quantitative notion of diversity of extensions based on the symmetric difference and provide a systematic complexity classification. Intuitively, diversity captures whether extensions of a framework (accepted viewpoints) differ only marginally or represent fundamentally incompatible sets of arguments. We study whether an AF admits k-diverse extensions, admits k-diverse extensions covering specific arguments, and to compute the largest k for which an AF admits k-diverse extensions. We outline a prototype and provide an evaluation for computing diversity levels.

</details>


### [122] [Ego2World: Compiling Egocentric Cooking Videos into Executable Worlds for Belief-State Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13335)
*Qinchuan Cheng,Zhantao Gong,Pengzhan Sun,Angela Yao,Xulei Yang,Shijie Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Ego2World是一个将自我中心视频转换为可执行符号世界的基准测试，用于评估嵌入式智能体在部分可观测环境下的规划和记忆更新能力。通过从HD-EPIC视频中提取图转换规则，并在隐藏的符号世界图上执行，该基准强制智能体仅通过局部观测和执行反馈来维护信念图并进行重规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试存在局限性：自我中心视频数据集是被动的、无法交互；而交互式模拟器依赖合成场景且假设完全可观测状态，存在sim-to-real gap。缺乏能够测试智能体在部分可观测环境中记忆维护、状态追踪和失败恢复能力的综合基准。

Method: 从HD-EPIC烹饪视频注释中提取可复用的转换规则，在隐藏的符号世界图中执行这些规则。智能体仅能访问自己的部分信念图，通过局部观测和执行反馈进行规划和重规划。

Result: 实验表明：(1)动作重叠分数会高估物理状态成功；(2)持续性信念记忆能提高任务完成率并减少重复视觉探索。

Conclusion: 信念维护应该成为嵌入式智能体评估的首要目标（first-class target），当前评估指标存在不足，需要更全面的评估框架。

Abstract: Embodied agents in household environments must plan under partial observation: they need to remember objects, track state changes, and recover when actions fail. Existing benchmarks only partially test this ability. Egocentric video datasets capture realistic human activities but remain passive, while interactive simulators support execution but rely on synthetic scenes and hand-crafted dynamics, introducing a sim-to-real gap and often assuming fully observable state. We introduce Ego2World, an executable benchmark that turns egocentric cooking videos into executable symbolic worlds governed by graph-transition rules. Built on HD-EPIC, Ego2World derives reusable transition rules from video annotations and executes them in a hidden symbolic world graph. During evaluation, the simulator maintains the hidden world graph, while the agent plans over its own partial belief graph using only local observations and execution feedback. This separation forces agents to update memory and replan without observing the true world state. Experiments show that action-overlap scores overestimate physical-state success, and that persistent belief memory improves task completion while reducing repeated visual exploration -- suggesting that belief maintenance should be a first-class target of embodied-agent evaluation.

</details>


### [123] [RS-Claw: Progressive Active Tool Exploration via Hierarchical Skill Trees for Remote Sensing Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13391)
*Liangtian Liu,Zeyuan Wang,Ziyu Li,Kai Ouyang,Zichao Tang,Chengfu Liu,Haifeng Li,Hanwen Yu,Wentao Yang,Cheng Yang,Dongyang Hou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RS-Claw是一种新型遥感智能体架构，通过主动探索范式重新定义工具选择，利用技能封装技术实现层级化工具描述和按需决策，在保持关键工具召回率的同时大幅压缩上下文负载。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RS智能体采用被动工具选择范式（Flat或RAG），在海量多源异构RS工具生态中难以动态平衡"上下文负载"与"工具集完整性"，导致长时任务中上下文空间不足或关键工具遗漏。

Method: 基于Skill封装技术，在工具端层级化结构化工具描述，实现按需顺序决策：先通过工具摘要选择相关技能分支，再动态加载详细描述，最终实现精确调用。

Result: 实现高达86%的输入token压缩比，在复杂推理评估中全面超越现有Flat和RAG基线。

Conclusion: RS-Claw通过主动探索机制有效过滤语义噪声并释放推理空间，在复杂推理评估中全面超越Flat和RAG基线方法。

Abstract: The rise of multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) is shifting remote sensing (RS) intelligence from "see" to "action", as OpenClaw-style frameworks enable agents to autonomously operate massive RS image-processing tools for complex tasks. Existing RS agents adopt a passive selection paradigm for tool invocation, relying on either full tool registration (Flat) or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
