Motivation: 百日咳加强疫苗接种后的免疫反应在峰值大小和长期持久性上存在显著的个体间差异。这两个阶段由不同的生物学机制控制：峰值反映急性B细胞活化和抗体分泌，持久性反映长期体液记忆的建立。然而，现有计算模型通常只针对其中一个阶段，忽略了完整的增强-衰减轨迹。联合预测两者具有挑战性，因为两个终点具有生物学差异性，样本量小，模态异构且存在结构化缺失，两个任务的测量窗口不同。

Method: 提出一种多任务对比多模态融合架构，主要技术包括：1) 结合冻结的TabPFN-v2每模态编码器；2) 双标签监督对比损失，将两个受试者视为正样本对的条件是他们对任务1标签或任务2标签达成一致；3) 根据经验缺失率校准的模态dropout；4) 缺失掩码注意力融合。应用于CMI-PB百日咳加强疫苗数据集的精选子集（n=158，4个模态，44.9%至少有一个模态缺失）。

Result: 模型在峰值反应预测上获得测试AUROC 0.797（95% CI [0.621, 0.948]），在持久性预测上获得AUROC 0.755（95% CI [0.519, 0.945]），两项均在联合标签排列下显著（p=0.002和p=0.045）。在与逻辑回归、XGBoost和MLP基线模型的对比中，本文模型是唯一在两项任务上95%置信区间均高于随机水平的模型。每模态贡献分析恢复了与底层免疫学一致的任务特异性模态贡献：峰值预测主要由细胞因子特征驱动，持久性预测主要由基线抗体特征驱动。

Conclusion: 该研究成功构建了一个能够联合预测疫苗接种后峰值免疫反应和长期持久性的多模态深度学习框架。模型不仅在两项任务上均取得了显著优于随机的预测性能，还通过可解释性分析验证了生物学合理性——峰值与细胞因子相关，持久性与基线抗体水平相关。这种多任务对比学习方法为异构缺失数据的多模态融合预测提供了有效范式。

Abstract: Pertussis booster vaccination produces immune responses that vary widely across individuals in both peak magnitude and long-term durability. These two phases are governed by partly distinct biological compartments:peak reflects acute B-cell activation and antibody secretion, while durability reflects the establishment of long-term humoral memory. Yet most computational models target only one, missing the full boost-and-wane trajectory. Jointly predicting both is non-trivial because the two endpoints are biologically dissociated rather than redundant; samples are small, modalities are heterogeneous with structured missingness, and the two tasks rely on different measurement windows. We propose a multi-task contrastive multimodal fusion architecture combining frozen TabPFN-v2 per-modality encoders, a dual-label supervised contrastive loss that treats two subjects as a positive pair if they agree on the Task 1 label or the Task 2 label, modality dropout calibrated to empirical missingness, and missingness-masked attention fusion. Applied to a curated subset of the CMI-PB pertussis booster dataset (n = 158 subjects, four modalities, 44.9% with at least one modality missing; Spearman r = -0.58 between peak and durability, n = 96), the model achieves test AUROC 0.797 (95% CI [0.621, 0.948]) for peak response and 0.755 (95% CI [0.519, 0.945]) for durability, with both significant under joint label permutation (N = 1000; p = 0.002 and p = 0.045). Across logistic regression, XGBoost, and MLP baselines on raw features and on TabPFN embeddings, the proposed model is the only one whose 95% CIs lie above chance on both tasks simultaneously. Per-modality contribution analyses recover task-specific modality contributions consistent with the underlying immunology: peak prediction is carried by cytokine signatures, while durability is carried by baseline antibody features.

</details>


### [214] [SMA: Submodular Modality Aligner For Data Efficient Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12872)
*Truong Pham,Anay Majee,Rishabh Iyer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SMA 将多模态对齐从"成对实例级"范式提升为"集合级（组合）范式"，用基于 Submodular Mutual Information (SMI) 的 FLVMI/FLQMI 目标函数，在冻结的 DINOv2 + GTE-1.5 编码器上仅训练轻量对齐层（GLU），仅用 MS-COCO 约 8 万样本（即数万个标注样本）即可在 CLIP 基准的 14 项零样本分类与 Flickr30k 零样本检索任务上稳定超越 SAIL（InfoNCE/SigLIP）与 CSA 等数据高效对齐基线，最高相对提升约 25%，平均相对提升约 7.7%（分类）与约 5%（检索），同时显著缩小模态间隙（平均 ℓ2 距离从 22.28 降至 12.82）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态基础模型（CLIP、SigLIP 等）依赖数百万至数十亿级配对数据，难以应用于配对数据稀缺且昂贵的低数据/罕见场景（医学影像、遥感、自动驾驶边缘案例、监控弱标注、生物科学数据等）。作者指出核心瓶颈在于实例级（instance-level）范式：CLIP/SigLIP 等目标仅最大化单对图文嵌入的相关性，把同一实体的多个增强视图与多种描述独立处理，忽略跨模态的底层几何结构，导致：(i) 数据利用效率低——每对只捕获部分语义信息；(ii) 优化信号冲突——同一实体的不同视图因负采样被相互推远。此外，InfoNCE 的对齐项与均匀性项相互对抗，使"模态间隙"（modality gap）在共享空间中依然显著。已有工作（Yin et al. 2025; Liang et al. 2022; Shi et al. 2023）表明鲁棒的多模态对齐需要同时最大化互信息（对应 alignment/correlated）与最小化跨模态散度（对应 modality gap），而现有方法只优化前者。

Method: 核心思想是引入组合（集合式）多模态对齐范式：将一个实体的多个图像增强与多条文本描述视为一个"集合"而非独立样本对，并显式建模其联合组合结构。\n\n1. 理论基础：集合函数 f 的次模性（diminishing returns），次模互信息函数 SMI（I_f(A,Q)=f(A)+f(Q)-f(A∪Q)）在 Q 固定时是次模的，且信息度量为熵函数（次模函数的真子集）。\n\n2. 数据重构：设基集 V 为所有 (x_i,y_i) 对；对每个实体构造正集 A_i^+（该实体的所有图文视图）与对应负集 A_i^-（与 A_i^+ 错配的组合），各正集两两不交，V 为所有正集之并。\n\n3. 损失定义（Def. 3.1）：L_SMA = Σ_i I_f(A_i^{x+}, A_i^{y+}) − Σ_i I_f(A_i^{x-}, A_i^{y-})，即最大化跨模态集合间互信息、最小化错配集合间的共享信息。\n\n4. 两个实例化（用余弦相似度核 s_jk 计算集合间交互）：\n   - FLVMIA（Facility-Location submodular MI，Def. 3.2）：Σ_j min(max_k s_jk, max_k s_jk)，min-max 结构强调跨模态的平衡覆盖与代表性；\n   - FLQMIA（Facility-Location Variant MI，Def. 3.3）：Σ_j max_k s_jk，基于 max 的形式聚焦最强跨模态关联。\n   同时保留 CLIP 训练方案中图像→文本与文本→图像双向对齐。\n\n5. 与已有目标的关系（Sec. 3.3）：当正集退化为单元素时，FLQMI 经 log-sum-exp 近似退化为 NT-Xent/InfoNCE，即 CLIP 目标是该框架的特例；SigLIP 的 sigmoid 二分类软间隔形式是逐对成员，被本框架提升到集合层面。\n\n6. 与模态间隙的联系（Remark 3.4 / 附录 A.1）：取 f(X)=-(Σx)^2，展开可得最小化模态间隙（两模态中心均值的 ℓ2 距离平方）等价于最大化 SMI，说明 SMI 可缓解但非完全消除模态间隙（仍需均匀性/负样本项）。\n\n7. 实现：冻结 DINOv2（图像）与 GTE-1.5（文本）编码器，仅训练 GLU 对齐层；训练数据为 MS-COCO Captions（每图 ≥5 条人工描述作为天然增强，共约 8 万图）；Lion 优化器，初始学习率 1e-5；FLQMIA 批大小 ~16K、FLVMIA ~1K（未做跨相似度矩阵的显存优化）、SAIL 基线 ~32K；单卡 RTX A6000 48GB；以验证损失早停。评测采用 CLIP Benchmark 的 14 项零样本分类任务与 Flickr30k 零样本检索（Recall@1）。基线包括 SAIL w/ CLIP（InfoNCE）、SAIL w/ SigLIP、CSA（基于 CCA 的解析方法，潜空间维度 500）。

Result: 多正样本对设置（Table 2、3、5）：FLQMIA 与 FLVMIA 在几乎所有任务上取得最佳或次佳。分类上 Caltech101 59.06、DTD 21.44/21.60、EuroSAT 40.18、GTSRB 8.90、Pets 15.10/15.97、STL-10 92.65、Imagenet-v1 28.04、Food101 39.81、CIFAR-100 53.31、MMVP 17.78/18.52，均优于 SAIL 与 CSA；仅在 Flowers、FGVC、Cars 等难任务上未超过基线。CIFAR-10/STL-10 已接近饱和（仅 1–2% 增益）。Flickr30k 检索 Recall@1：FLQMIA 达 63.00 (I2T) / 51.24 (T2I)，FLVMIA 59.50/47.08，在多正样本对下均优于 SAIL 与 CSA。模态间隙方面平均 ℓ2 距离：多正样本对下 SAIL w/ CLIP 22.28、SAIL w/ SigLIP 15.40、FLQMIA 13.85、FLVMIA 12.82（SigLIP 收窄间隙能力最强，SMI 亦优于 InfoNCE）。\n\n单正样本对设置（Table 3b、4、5b）：FLVMIA 仅在 14 项分类中的 5 项落后于 SAIL，其余任务为最佳或接近最佳，且全面优于 CSA（仅 1 项例外）；FLVMIA 在 11 epoch 即收敛，而 SAIL 需 92–200 epoch。检索上 FLQMIA 最佳（63.00/51.24），但 T2I 任务上 SAIL w/ InfoNCE（57.70/47.28）略胜；说明无多正样本时集合式优势减弱。总体最高相对提升约 25%，分类平均比例增益约 7.7%，检索约 5%，而样本量比标准 CLIP 少数个数量级。作者指出主要局限在于未优化的跨相似度矩阵带来的显存限制（FLVMI 需 3 个交叉相似度矩阵），以及未探索 GCMI、LOGDETMI 等其他 SMI。

Conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是把多模态对齐的目标从成对相似度函数提升为集合级信息度量（次模互信息），使 CLIP/SigLIP 成为集合退化为单元素时的特例，从而在同一实体的多视图、多描述之间联合建模 alignment（相关性/互信息最大化）与 modality gap（跨模态散度最小化）。实验证明，仅用数万个配对样本和冻结编码器即可实现强零样本分类与检索性能，并优于现有数据高效对齐方法，凸显了集合结构与次模目标在数据高效多模态学习中的重要性。作者认为该方向可扩展到音频、视频等多模态场景、研究自适应集合构建策略，并整合进更大规模的基础模型。

Abstract: Despite the recent success of Multimodal Foundation Models (FMs), their reliance on massive paired datasets limits their applicability in low-data and rare-scenario settings where aligned data is scarce and expensive. A key bottleneck is the adoption of an instance-level formulation, which learns alignment by maximizing correlation between individual image-text pairs while neglecting the underlying geometric structure across modalities resulting in a modality gap across input modalities. In this paper, we propose a combinatorial paradigm for multimodal alignment that moves beyond pairwise learning and introduce the \emph{Submodular Modality Aligner (SMA)}, which treats multiple augmentations and descriptions of an entity as a set, leveraging multiple descriptions of the data to capture richer cross-modal structure. We instantiate SMA using a principled objective based on Submodular Mutual Information (SMI), which jointly maximizes inter-modality mutual information while reducing cross-modal divergence. This formulation enables the model to effectively utilize multiple positive associations and extract significantly more information from limited data. We evaluate SMA on 14 zero-shot classification and retrieval tasks from the CLIP benchmark and demonstrate consistent gains in the low-data regime. Notably, SMA achieves strong multimodal generalization using only tens of thousands of samples. This is orders of magnitude fewer than standard approaches. Our results highlight the importance of set-based formulations and submodular objectives for data-efficient multimodal learning.

</details>


### [215] [Descriptive Collision in Sparse Autoencoder Auto-Interpretability: When One Explanation Describes Many Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12874)
*Jordan F. McCann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文发现自动可解释性中存在"描述碰撞"问题：不同特征被赋予相同解释。722个标注特征的实验表明，82.1%的特征存在解释共享，平均解释仅能解析70%的特征身份。论文提出碰撞调整检测和区分评分两种度量方法来修正这一偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing critiques of auto-interpretability focus on polysemanticity (one feature, many meanings) or whether explanations predict activations. This paper identifies a complementary structural problem: descriptive collision, where many distinct SAE features admit the same explanation.

Method: Reanalyze the largest publicly-available dataset of human-annotated SAE features (722 features across Gemma 2 2B and Pythia 70M) from Marks et al. (2025). Formalized a property called "discrimination" and proved that current detection-style auto-interpretability scoring is invariant to collision. Proposed two complementary corrective metrics: collision-adjusted detection and discrimination scoring.

Result: Mean annotation string is reused across 3.07 features; 82.1% of features share their annotation with at least one other feature; the most common annotation ("plural nouns") labels 101 distinct features spanning 18 layers and four model components. Information-theoretically, the average annotation resolves only 70% of feature identity.

Conclusion: The collision problem is independent of and additive with previously identified auto-interpretability failure modes; ignoring it inflates reported feature interpretability by roughly one-third of the bits required to identify a feature.

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are now standard tools for decomposing language model activations into interpretable features, and automated interpretability pipelines routinely assign each feature a short natural-language explanation. Existing critiques of this practice focus on polysemanticity -- one feature with many meanings -- or on whether explanations predict activations. We identify a complementary, structurally distinct problem we call descriptive collision: many distinct SAE features admit the same explanation. Reanalyzing the largest publicly-available dataset of human-annotated SAE features (Marks et al., 2025), comprising 722 annotated features across Gemma 2 2B and Pythia 70M, we find that the mean annotation string is reused across 3.07 features; 82.1% of features share their annotation with at least one other feature; and the single most common annotation string ("plural nouns") labels 101 distinct features spanning 18 layers and four model components. Information-theoretically, the average annotation resolves only 70% of feature identity. We formalize a property called discrimination, prove that current detection-style auto-interpretability scoring is invariant to collision, and propose two complementary corrective metrics -- collision-adjusted detection and discrimination scoring -- that explicitly penalize explanations that fail to distinguish a feature from its neighbors. The collision problem is independent of, and additive with, previously identified failure modes of auto-interpretability; ignoring it inflates reported feature interpretability by a quantity equal to roughly one-third of the bits required to identify a feature.

</details>


### [216] [Certified Robustness under Heterogeneous Perturbations via Hybrid Randomized Smoothing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12876)
*Blaise Delattre,Hengyu Wu,Paul Caillon,Wei Yang Bryan Lim,Yang Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种统一的随机平滑框架，用于处理混合离散-连续输入的多模态模型安全问题。通过Neyman-Pearson公式分析联合最坏情况，获得一维封闭形式鲁棒性证书，推广了传统仅针对图像或仅针对文本的随机平滑方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有随机平滑的鲁棒性保证仅限于单模态（连续或离散输入单独处理），无法应对多模态模型中跨模态语义的联合扰动威胁。

Method: 提出基于Neyman-Pearson公式的统一随机平滑框架，通过分析分解的离散和连续噪声诱导的联合似然排序，获得封闭形式的一维证书。

Result: 该框架严格推广了仅图像（高斯）和仅文本（离散）的随机平滑方法，并在交互依赖的文本-图像安全过滤场景中提供了首个模型无关的联合离散令牌和连续图像扰动Neyman-Pearson证书。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了离散和连续扰动的随机平滑分析，为交互依赖的多模态安全过滤提供了首个模型无关的Neyman-Pearson证书。

Abstract: Randomized smoothing provides strong, model-agnostic robustness certificates, but existing guarantees are limited to single modalities, treating continuous and discrete inputs in isolation. This limitation becomes critical in multimodal models, where decisions depend on cross-modal semantics and adversaries can jointly perturb heterogeneous inputs, rendering unimodal certificates insufficient. We introduce a unified randomized smoothing framework for mixed discrete--continuous inputs based on an analytically tractable Neyman--Pearson formulation of the joint worst-case problem. By analyzing the joint likelihood ordering induced by factorized discrete and continuous noise, our approach yields a closed-form, one-dimensional certificate that strictly generalizes both Gaussian (image-only) and discrete (text-only) randomized smoothing. We validate the framework on multimodal safety filtering, providing, to our knowledge, the first model-agnostic Neyman--Pearson certificate for joint discrete-token and continuous-image perturbations in interaction-dependent text--image safety filtering.

</details>


### [217] [ASAP: Amortized Doubly-Stochastic Attention via Sliced Dual Projection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12879)
*Huy Tran,Max Milkert,David Hyde*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ASAP提出一种双重随机注意力的高效推理方法，通过学习从一维Kantorovich势到双侧对偶空间的轻量映射，在保持Sinkhorn训练效率的同时实现推理加速（5.3倍），同时保持或恢复模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有双重随机注意力方法存在效率瓶颈：Sinkhorn缩放虽训练高效但推理需迭代计算；切片传输注意力虽移除在线迭代，但需实例化密集张量导致训练资源消耗过高。需要一种既能保持Sinkhorn训练效率，又能在推理时消除迭代开销的方法。

Method: 1. 训练阶段采用Sinkhorn方法进行双重随机层的训练；2. 推理阶段使用学习的轻量参数化映射，将精确一维Kantorovich势映射到Sinkhorn查询侧对偶空间；3. 通过双边熵c变换重建注意力计划。属于"先训练后编译"(train-then-compile)范式。

Result: 在语言和视觉基准测试中，ASAP保持了Sinkhorn的低成本训练优势且具有很强竞争力。在主要冻结层基准测试中，ASAP比训练好的Sinkhorn教师快5.3倍且精度相当；在下游替换任务中，ASAP无需重新训练即可恢复大部分教师性能。

Conclusion: ASAP实现了训练-编译分离的注意力机制，在保持Sinkhorn低成本训练优势的同时，通过学习从一维Kantorovich势到Sinkhorn对偶空间的参数化映射，在推理时用固定切片对偶算子替代迭代缩放循环，从而兼具高效训练与快速推理的优势。

Abstract: Doubly-stochastic attention has emerged as a transport-based alternative to row-softmax attention, with recent Transformer variants using it to reduce attention sinks and rank collapse while improving performance. In this family, the standard approach is Sinkhorn scaling, which trains more efficiently but still repeats matrix scaling in every inference forward pass. Sliced-transport attention removes the online iteration, but its soft sorting approximation materializes dense tensors for each slice, requiring substantially more training resources than Sinkhorn attention. We introduce ASAP: Amortized Doubly-Stochastic Attention via Sliced Dual Projection, a train-then-compile method that trains the doubly-stochastic layer with Sinkhorn, then replaces the iterative scaling loop at inference with a fixed sliced-dual operator. It learns a lightweight parametric map from exact one-dimensional Kantorovich potentials to the Sinkhorn query-side dual, then reconstructs the attention plan with a two-sided entropic c-transform. Across language and vision benchmarks, ASAP keeps the cheaper training setup and remains highly competitive with recent baselines. In the main frozen-layer benchmark, ASAP is 5.3 faster than the trained Sinkhorn teacher while matching its accuracy; in downstream replacements, ASAP recovers most of the teacher performance without any retraining.

</details>


### [218] [VIP-COP: Context Optimization for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12904)
*Yilong Chen,Xueying Ding,Leman Akoglu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VIP-COP introduces a black-box, model-aware context optimization framework for tabular foundation models. It uses importance-based selection to identify high-value samples and features, enabling noise suppression and data augmentation prioritization while remaining budget-aware and interpretable.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Context length limits constrain TFMs when applied to medium-scale data, and performance degrades when inference-time data exceeds pretraining size distributions.

Method: VIP-COP uses online KernelSHAP-based regression with iterative refinement, value-guided context sampling, and multi-fidelity pruning to estimate importance values of training examples and features for explicit selection, noise suppression, and high-value sample/feature prioritization.

Result: VIP-COP consistently outperforms heuristic and optimized baselines across large-scale high-dimensional testbeds, enabling effective data augmentation and robustness to noise.

Conclusion: VIP-COP establishes a new state of the art in test-time context refinement for TFMs, consistently outperforming heuristic and optimized baselines across large-scale high-dimensional testbeds, including data augmentation and noise settings.

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for in-context learning on structured data, enabling direct prediction on new tabular tasks without task-specific training. However, their effectiveness is constrained by context length limits, restricting application to medium-scale data and degrading performance when inference-time data exceed pretraining size distributions. Our work introduces VIP-COP, estimating the Value of Importance for Prediction of training examples and features for hard Context OPtimization for TFMs. Its explicit selection mechanism suppresses noise and isolates influential data, enabling the model to also benefit from data augmentation by prioritizing high-value augmented samples and features. VIP-COP is (i) fast, boosting performance often within minutes of optimization, based on an online KernelSHAP-based regression with iterative refinement, value-guided context sampling, and multi-fidelity pruning; (ii) budget-aware and any-time, improving with additional test-time compute unlike heuristics that produce fixed contexts; (iii) model-aware yet fully black-box, requiring no access to model internals, making it compatible with both proprietary and open-source TFMs; (iv) interpretable, identifying discrete ``Very Important Predictors'' (samples and features) that maximize signal-to-noise, which makes it (v) robust, isolating high-value data from noise. In contrast, soft-prompt optimization requires model gradients, produces abstract latent tokens, and lacks explicit signal discrimination. Extensive experiments show that VIP-COP consistently outperforms heuristic and optimized baselines across large-scale high-dimensional testbeds, including data augmentation and data-noise settings, establishing a new state of the art in test-time context refinement for TFMs.

</details>


### [219] [Data Difficulty and the Generalization--Extrapolation Tradeoff in LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12906)
*Siyuan Liu,Tinghong Chen,Xinghan Li,Yifei Wang,Jingzhao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了监督微调（SFT）中数据难度对大语言模型的影响，发现最优数据难度与数据预算密切相关：数据越多，最优难度越高。该发现源于泛化差距与外推差距之间的权衡，并通过合成实验和PAC-Bayes理论分析验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究关于数据选择策略（如困惑度、难度、长度启发式方法）对LLM微调的影响得出了不一致的结论，缺乏系统性的理解。

Method: 1. 理论层面：使用PAC-Bayes泛化界进行理论分析；2. 实证层面：进行受控的合成实验揭示底层机制。

Result: 1. 不存在 universally optimal 的难度水平；2. 存在针对固定数据预算的最优数据难度；3. 最优难度随数据预算增加而向更难数据偏移；4. 底层机制源于（分布内）泛化差距与外推差距之间的相互作用。

Conclusion: 该研究澄清了数据规模与数据难度如何共同影响SFT中泛化与外推之间的权衡，为在特定模型和数据条件下基于难度的数据选择提供了指导。

Abstract: Data selection during supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can critically change the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Although existing work has studied the effect of selecting data based on heuristics such as perplexity, difficulty, or length, the reported findings are often inconsistent or context-dependent. In this work, we systematically study the role of data difficulty in fine-tuning from both empirical and theoretical perspectives, and find that there is no universally optimal difficulty level; rather, its effectiveness depends on the dataset size. We show that for a fixed data budget, there exists an optimal data difficulty for SFT, and that this optimal difficulty shifts toward harder data as the data budget increases. To explain this phenomenon, we conduct controlled synthetic experiments that reveal a simple underlying mechanism: the interplay between the (in-distribution) generalization gap and the extrapolation gap. We further support this mechanism through a theoretical analysis using PAC-Bayesian generalization bounds. Overall, our results clarify how data size and difficulty jointly affect the trade-off between generalization and extrapolation in SFT, providing guidance for difficulty-based data selection under certain model and data conditions.

</details>


### [220] [Revisiting DAgger in the Era of LLM-Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12913)
*Changhao Li,Rushi Qiang,Jiawei Huang,Chenxiao Gao,Chao Zhang,Niao He,Bo Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将 DAgger 算法应用于长时域 LLM agent 的训练，通过学生-教师策略的逐轮插值收集轨迹并使用监督学习训练学生模型，在软件工程任务上实现了显著性能提升，4B 模型超越部分 8B 系统，8B 模型接近 32B 规模模型水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时域 LLM agent 训练方法存在两难困境：监督微调（SFT）虽能提供密集监督但因使用离策略教师轨迹而遭受协变量偏移问题；强化学习（RL）虽避免离策略问题但仅依赖稀疏的结果反馈。需要在密集反馈与在策略学习之间找到平衡。

Method: 重新审视 Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) 算法用于多轮 LLM agent 训练。具体方法：1) 通过学生策略与教师策略的逐轮插值收集轨迹；2) 使用教师提供的监督标签训练学生模型。核心优势在于：直接与环境交互使模型接触部署时可能遇到的真实状态分布，同时模仿学习提供丰富的密集反馈。

Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，DAgger 风格训练相比最强后训练基线，4B 模型提升 +3.9 分，8B 模型提升 +3.6 分。4B agent 达到 27.3%，超越代表性的已发布 8B SWE-agent 系统；8B agent 达到 29.8%，超越 SWE-Gym-32B，接近更强的 32B 规模 agent（差距在 5 分以内）。在 SWE-Gym 保留集上也取得一致提升。

Conclusion: DAgger 算法能够有效结合监督学习（密集反馈）和强化学习（在策略学习）的优势，是训练现代长时域 LLM agent 的有效方法。该方法证明了简单而经典的学习范式在现代大规模语言模型上仍具有强大的生命力。

Abstract: Long-horizon LM agents learn from multi-turn interaction, where a single early mistake can alter the subsequent state distribution and derail the whole trajectory. Existing recipes fall short in complementary ways: supervised fine-tuning provides dense teacher supervision but suffers from covariate shift because it is trained on off-policy teacher trajectories; while reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards avoids this off-policy mismatch by learning from on-policy rollouts but with only sparse outcome feedback. We address this dilemma by revisiting Dataset Aggregation (DAgger) for multi-turn LM agents: the algorithm collects trajectories through a turn-level interpolation of student and teacher policies, and the student is then trained on these trajectories using supervised labels provided by the teacher. By directly interacting with environments, we expose the model to realistic states likely to be encountered during deployment, thereby effectively mitigating covariate shift. Besides, since the student is learned by mimicking the teacher's behavior, it receives rich feedback during learning. To demonstrate DAgger enjoys the benefits of both worlds, we tested the algorithm to train a software-engineering agent with 4B- and 8B-scale student models. On SWE-bench Verified, our DAgger-style training improves over the strongest post-training baseline by +3.9 points at 4B and +3.6 points at 8B. The resulting 4B agent reaches 27.3%, outperforming representative published 8B SWE-agent systems, while the 8B agent achieves 29.8%, surpassing SWE-Gym-32B and coming within 5 points of stronger 32B-scale agents. Together with consistent gains on the held-out SWE-Gym split, these results suggest the effectiveness of DAgger for modern long-horizon LM agents.

</details>


### [221] [IV-ICL: Bounding Causal Effects with Instrumental Variables via In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12924)
*Vahid Balazadeh,Hamidreza Kamkari,Medha Barath,Ricardo Silva,Rahul G. Krishnan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了IV-ICL方法，一种基于 amortized Bayesian in-context learning 的工具变量(IV)因果效应部分识别框架，通过优化 inclusive KL 而非 exclusive KL 来学习因果效应的边际后验分布，并将边界作为后验分位数导出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IV方法面临方法论瓶颈：需要闭式边界估计量（如Balke-Pearl方程），且设计精确估计器需要针对每个估计量的人工定制；直接贝叶斯推断虽可绕过这些挑战，但计算密集且存在先验敏感或后验欠分散问题。

Method: IV-ICL采用 amortized Bayesian in-context learning，直接学习因果效应的边际后验分布；核心创新是优化 expected inclusive KL（质量覆盖目标），而非标准变分推断的 exclusive KL；边界由后验分位数直接导出。此外提出将RCT转换为IV基准的流程以保留真实因果效应。

Result: 优化 inclusive KL 可在多种数据生成过程下恢复完整识别集，而 exclusive KL（变分推断）会塌缩到单模态并无法覆盖识别集；IV-ICL在保持有效性的同时产生更可靠的区间，比半参数、贝叶斯和plug-in基线方法信息量更大，且推理速度快20-500倍。

Conclusion: Inclusive KL 优化对于部分识别问题更具优势；IV-ICL提供无需人工 estimand-specific 工程的通用解决方案；RCT转换程序为部分识别方法的评估提供了更现实的基准测试框架。

Abstract: The instrumental-variables (IV) setting is standard for partial identification of causal effects when unobserved confounding makes point identification impossible. Existing approaches face methodological bottlenecks: closed-form bound estimands are required -- e.g., Balke-Pearl equations in binary IV -- and even when available, designing accurate estimators requires manual effort tailored to each estimand. While direct Bayesian inference of the causal effects, instead of the bounds, circumvents these challenges, it is often computationally intensive and suffers from high prior sensitivity or under-dispersed posteriors. As a remedy, we introduce IV-ICL, an amortized Bayesian in-context learning method that learns the marginal posterior distribution of the causal effects directly and derives bounds as its quantiles. Unlike standard variational inference that optimizes exclusive KL divergence, amortized Bayesian inference minimizes the expected inclusive KL, a mass-covering objective. We empirically observe that optimizing inclusive KL can recover the entire identified set across diverse data-generating processes, while exclusive-KL (e.g. with variational inference) of the same Bayesian formulation collapses onto a single mode and fails to cover the identified set. We evaluate IV-ICL on synthetic and semi-synthetic IV benchmarks and show it produces intervals that are more reliably valid and more informative compared to efficient semi-parametric, Bayesian, and plug-in baselines, at 20-500x lower inference time. Beyond methodology, we propose a procedure to convert randomized controlled trials into IV benchmarks with provably preserved ground-truth causal effects that enables a more realistic evaluation of partial-identification methods.

</details>


### [222] [The Efficiency Gap in Byte Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12928)
*Celine Lee,Jing Nathan Yan,Chen Liang,Jiaxin Shi,Yin Zhang,Jeremiah Liu,Pengcheng Yin,Fernando Pereira,Ed Chi,Derek Cheng,Alexander M. Rush,Ruoxi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 一项计算匹配的扩展研究揭示，字节级建模对掩码扩散模型的影响比对自回归模型的影响更大，性能惩罚更严重。这种差异源于"上下文脆弱性"——AR 的因果历史有助于自然重新发现子词模式，而 MDM 破坏了字节级语义解析所需的局部连续性。未来模态无关设计需要替代性结构先验来维持字节 regime 中的可行扩展轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代语言模型长期依赖两个主导设计选择：子词标记化（subword tokenization）和自回归（AR）排序。这些设计决策内置的先验会决定模型的学习方式。两种替代范式（字节级建模和掩码扩散建模 MDM）的交叉代表了一个完全端到端的模态无关生成原型，但移除这些结构先验会带来显著的计算成本。

Method: 计算匹配扩展研究（compute-matched scaling study）和受控置换实验（controlled permutation experiments）。

Result: 字节建模的性能惩罚并不均匀；在扩展过程中，字节建模的扩展开销对 MDM 的影响比对 AR 的影响更大。差异源于"上下文脆弱性"：虽然 AR 稳定的因果历史允许模型自然地重新发现子词模式，但 MDM 目标破坏了从原始字节有效解析语义所需的局部连续性。

Conclusion: 未来模态无关的设计必须纳入替代性结构先验，以在字节 regime 中保持可行的扩展轨迹。

Abstract: Modern language models have historically relied on two dominant design choices: subword tokenization and autoregressive (AR) ordering. These design decisions bake in priors that dictate a model's learning. Recently, two alternative paradigms have challenged this: byte-level modeling, which bypasses static statistically-derived token vocabularies, and masked diffusion modeling (MDM), which conducts parallel, non-sequential generation. Their intersection represents a fully end-to-end modality-agnostic generative prototype; however, removing these structural priors incurs a significant computational cost. In this work, we investigate this cost through a compute-matched scaling study. Our results reveal that the performance penalty of byte modeling is not uniform; across scale, the scaling overhead of byte modeling is worse for MDM than for AR. We hypothesize that this disparity stems from context fragility: while AR's stable causal history allows models to naturally rediscover subword patterns, the MDM objective destroys the local contiguity required to efficiently resolve semantics from raw bytes. Our findings from controlled permutation experiments suggest that future modality-agnostic designs must incorporate alternative structural biases to maintain viable scaling trajectories in the byte regime.

</details>


### [223] [The Expressivity Boundary of Probabilistic Circuits: A Comparison with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12940)
*Zhiyu Zhao,Xuejie Liu,Muhan Zhang,Anji Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在统一的自回归框架下，系统性地分析了概率电路(PCs)在语言建模中落后于LLMs的根本原因，发现了两大瓶颈：输出瓶颈（概率空间参数化难以表达语言的尖锐分布）和上下文编码瓶颈（固定路由结构限制了对异构依赖拓扑的适应性），并通过理论证明和实验验证了这些问题，同时指出可分解PCs具有更强的表达能力但优化困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) 虽然支持精确高效的概率推理，但在自回归语言建模中仍落后于基于Transformer的大型语言模型(LLMs)，提示存在重要的表达力差距，需要深入理解其根本原因。

Method: 采用统一的自回归公式框架进行比较分析；通过理论证明（分离秩匹配、表达能力强弱关系）和实证实验两种方式验证问题；针对输出瓶颈采用logit空间参数化进行改进验证。

Result: 1. 输出瓶颈：采用logit空间参数化可显著缩小差距；2. 上下文编码瓶颈：结构可分解PCs只能在固定路由结构对齐的分区上匹配Transformer的分离秩，当数据呈现异构依赖拓扑时会严重退化；3. 理论上证明可分解PCs比结构可分解PCs表达能力更强，但有效优化仍是开放挑战。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了PCs在自回归语言建模中落后于LLMs的两个关键瓶颈，并提供了理论证明和实证支持，为未来PCs的改进指明了方向（需解决异构依赖拓扑问题和优化可分解PCs的表达能力）。

Abstract: Probabilistic Circuits (PCs) are deep generative models that support exact and efficient probabilistic inference. Yet in autoregressive language modeling, PCs still lag behind Transformer-based large language models (LLMs), suggesting an important expressivity gap. In this work, we compare PCs and LLMs under a unified autoregressive formulation. First, an output bottleneck: PCs parameterize predictions as convex combinations in probability space, which struggles to represent the sharp distributions typical of language; adopting a logit-space parameterization substantially narrows this gap. Second, a context-encoding bottleneck: we prove that structured-decomposable PCs can match Transformer separation rank on vtree-aligned partitions, but show, both theoretically and empirically, that this capacity is limited to partitions aligned with the fixed routing structure, leading to severe degradation when the data exhibits heterogeneous dependency topologies. We further prove that decomposable PCs are strictly more expressive than structured-decomposable ones, though effectively optimizing them remains an open challenge.

</details>


### [224] [Reinforced Collaboration in Multi-Agent Flow Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12943)
*Zheng Wang,Yuang Liu,Yangkai Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MANGO（Multi-Agent Network Gradient Optimization），一个数据驱动的多智能体协作框架：由历史成功工作流构建带源点/汇点的流网络，用强化学习（REINFORCE）优化工作流路径（边）、用文本梯度（textual gradients）优化智能体提示词（节点），并引入跳节点（Skip-K）机制避免对已优化节点的冗余更新。在 7 个基准上相比 SOTA 最高提升 12.8%，训练/推理时间分别减少 41.5%/47.4%，并可泛化到未见领域与新骨干模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统（LLM 分解复杂任务、由不同专精智能体协作）存在固有的「误差传播」问题，作者将其归纳为两类：\n1) **工作流生成错误（C1）**：为任务规划出错误的工作流（如该看视频却去网络搜索）。现有 ADAS（贪心搜索）、AFlow/AgentSwift（MCTS）、AgentSquare（进化）等自动工作流方法高度依赖人工设计的启发式，性能优化不确定，且早期 CAMEL/AutoGen/MetaGPT 等依赖规则与手工提示工程，难以快速适配新领域。\n2) **单智能体执行错误（C2）**：智能体输出不准确（如检索到错误的首映日期），并沿协作链传播，导致下游即使推理正确也出错。已有的智能体文本梯度方法（如 MaAS、GPTSwarm）存在两点局限：梯度仅在最终输出处评估，对长链中中间智能体的监督信号弱（类似神经网络梯度消失）；且对所有智能体做反向传播带来高延迟与冗余计算（已优化好的智能体重复优化无收益）。

Method: **问题形式化**：流网络 G=(V,E,s,t) 由历史成功工作流构建；每个节点 v_i=(M_i, P_i, e_i*, r_i*) 是一个智能体（模型、系统提示、簇中心经验、角色描述），节点参数 θ_i=(P_i, r_i*)。任务求解等价于寻找 s→t 的路径 P，最小化 L(f_P(T;Θ_P), y)，即**联合优化路径（边）与节点参数（节点）**。\n\n**流网络构建（Algorithm 3）**：Step-1 用 GPT-4o-mini 为训练任务生成候选工作流，用真值校验并选最短的正确工作流；Step-2 增量插入每个操作，基于与已有节点操作的最大向量相似度（阈值 δ=0.7，all-MiniLM-L6-v2 嵌入）聚类成节点，相似度低于阈值则新建节点，且只有同一 LLM 生成的操作才并入同一节点（保证每个节点对应特定 LLM 的智能体），并由 LLM 派生系统提示、簇中心经验与角色描述。\n\n**边优化（RL）**：以 plan-and-execute 模式建模为 MDP——源节点处的规划器（GPT-4o-mini）生成高高层计划 ρ 并可动态重规划；状态 s_i={sim(ρ_i,r_j*), sim(ρ_i,e_j*), sim(T,r_j*), sim(T,e_j*)}（文本相似度）；动作为从可达邻居中选下一节点；奖励 r_i=α·r_i^(por)+(1-α)·r^(ror)，过程奖励为是否匹配训练数据中的真值节点分配，结果奖励为汇节点处的任务准确率；策略网络（1 输入层 + 1 隐层 128 神经元 + 1 输出层）用 REINFORCE 优化，基线减方差，γ=0.95、α=0.5、Adam lr=0.001、每题 100 episodes。\n\n**节点优化（TG）**：沿采样路径对每个节点做文本梯度下降，梯度 = 全局梯度（汇节点对真值的结果反馈）+ 局部梯度（节点自身中间执行的反馈），更新 Θ_i ← Θ_i − η_Θ·∇（TextGrad 风格，异步化，episode=5、batch=30）。角色描述被文本梯度改写后会改变 RL 状态特征，路径选择又决定哪些节点参数被更新，二者互为反馈、联合演进。\n\n**跳过机制**：动作空间扩展为最短路距离 dist(v_i,v_j) ≤ K 的 K-邻域节点，训练时被跳过节点的输出用训练工作流中的真值中间步骤填充以复用监督、避免在线生成；推理时允许到达节点直接完成被跳过节点对应的多个子任务。\n\n**训练/推理**：训练为批量异步（每批次任务独立更新 Θ_P）；推理时策略网络 π_φ 生成工作流，节点参数已预优化、无需在线更新。

Result: **有效性（GPT-4o-mini 骨干，Table 1）**：MANGO 在 7 个基准全面领先——HumanEval 95.42、MBPP 85.63、MATH 58.44、GSM8K 94.12、DROP 84.75、MMLU 81.97、GPQA 40.40；较 MaAS 在 MATH 上提升 12.8%，较 AFlow 在 DROP 上提升 5.1%；Skip-2 设置下仍优于所有基线。\n\n**效率（Table 2，MATH）**：MANGO 训练 42 min/$1.29、推理 12 min/$0.935、58.44% 准确率；Skip-3 进一步降至 31 min/$1.052 与 10 min/$0.694、53.09%；相对 MaAS 训练时间 −41.5%、推理时间 −47.4%，同时准确率最高。\n\n**跨模型/跨域泛化**：训练于 GPT-4o-mini、零样本迁移至 Qwen-2.5-72B/Llama-3.1-70B 仍优于 AFlow/MaAS（最高 +2.5% 零样本、+6.9% 少样本）；跨域迁移（MATH→GSM8K/HumanEval 等）较 MaAS 最高 +7.7%；WebShop 交互环境 0.750 优于 DyLAN 0.683、MaAS 0.697；骨干升级到 GPT-4o/GPT-5 后性能进一步提升（MATH 达 94.03）。\n\n**消融（Table 5，MATH）**：去掉文本梯度降幅最大（58.44→48.97，−19.3%）；去掉局部信号降至 54.73（−6.8%）；以相似度排序/LLM 调用替代 RL 均退化（54.94/52.67/51.23）；移除任一状态相似度特征均下降。超参：δ=0.7 与 α=0.5 最优；Skip-K 越大成本越低但精度递减。**鲁棒性**：初始工作流 79.8% 失败（4B 模型）时仍能自举收敛至 54.17%；注入 50% 噪声工作流仅下降 9.9%。相比无约束路由方法（BiRouter、Puppeteer）性能更优、耗时更短。

Conclusion: MANGO 以「数据驱动的流网络 + 强化学习 + 文本梯度 + 跳节点」的组合，把多智能体协作中的误差传播问题转化为路径与节点的联合优化问题，摆脱了对人工启发式搜索的依赖，在性能、效率与泛化性上同时优于现有 SOTA，且能扩展到交互式环境与更强骨干模型。其局限为：流网络构建依赖历史成功工作流的可用性与质量（可能引入偏差）；δ 与 Skip-K 等超参需调优；RL 与 TG 的联合优化带来额外系统复杂度与训练不稳定性，复现难度高于单智能体基线。代码与数据已开源（openJiuwen-ai/agent-store）。

Abstract: Multi-agent systems provide a powerful way to extend large language models (LLMs) by decomposing a complex task into specialized subtasks handled by different agents. However, their performance is often hindered by error propagation, arising from suboptimal workflow design or inaccurate agent outputs, which can propagate through the agent collaboration process and degrade final results. To address the challenges, we present MANGO (Multi-Agent Network Gradient Optimization), a data-driven framework that organizes and refines agent collaboration via a flow network constructed from past successful workflows. MANGO integrates reinforcement learning and textual gradients to jointly optimize workflow paths and agent behaviors, while a skipping mechanism prevents redundant updates to well-optimized agents for improving efficiency. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks show that MANGO achieves up to 12.8% performance improvement over state-of-the-art baselines, enhances efficiency by 47.4%, and generalizes effectively to unseen domains. Our code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/agent-store/tree/main/community/mango.

</details>


### [225] [From Instance Selection to Fixed-Pool Data Recipe Search for Supervised Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12944)
*Haodong Wu,Jiahao Zhang,Lijie Hu,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将 SFT 数据选择从实例排序问题重新建模为固定池数据配方搜索问题，提出了 AutoSelection 双层求解器框架，通过解耦固定池材料化与昂贵全量评估，在有限评估预算下高效发现高质量训练子集。实验验证了该方法在分布内外的有效性，并揭示了数据配方结构比单一选择算子更具价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 SFT 数据选择仅关注实例排序，忽视了实际训练中过滤、混合、去重等操作的协同效应，无法捕捉完整数据配方的效果，因此需要将问题重新建模为固定池数据配方搜索。

Method: 提出了 AutoSelection 双层求解器：利用缓存的任务侧、数据侧和模型侧信号进行固定池材料化，结合预热探测、贪心搜索、高斯过程辅助排序和停滞触发重播种等策略，在有限的全量 SFT 评估预算内高效搜索最优配方。

Result: 在 90K 指令池上，AutoSelection 在三个基座模型上均达到最强的分布内推理平均性能，优于全量数据训练、随机配方搜索、随机 top-k 及单算子选择器；分布外图推理任务、搜索稳定性分析、结构消融和 1.5B 到 7B 规模迁移验证进一步表明，配方结构本身的重要性超越单一选择算子。

Conclusion: AutoSelection 通过双层求解器框架，在固定池材料化与全量评估之间建立解耦机制，显著提升了 SFT 数据选择的效率与效果，证明数据配方结构本身比单一选择算子更具价值。

Abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data selection is commonly formulated as instance ranking: score each example and retain a top-$k$ subset. However, effective SFT training subsets are often produced through ordered curation recipes, where filtering, mixing, and deduplication operators jointly shape the final data distribution. We formulate this problem as fixed-pool data recipe search: given a raw instruction pool and a library of grounded operators, the goal is to discover an executable recipe that constructs a high-quality selected subset under a limited budget of full SFT evaluations, without generating, rewriting, or augmenting training samples. We introduce AutoSelection, a two-layer solver that decouples fixed-pool materialization based on cached task-, data-, and model-side signals from expensive full evaluation, using warmup probes, realized subset states, local recipe edits, Gaussian-process-assisted ranking, and stagnation-triggered reseeding. Experiments on a 90K instruction pool show that AutoSelection achieves the strongest in-distribution reasoning average across three base models, outperforming full-data training, random recipe search, random top-$k$, and single-operator selectors. Additional Out-of-distribution graph-reasoning results, search-stability analyses, structural ablations, and 1.5B-to-7B transfer checks further show that recipe structure matters beyond individual selection operators. Code is available at https://github.com/w253/AutoSelection.

</details>


### [226] [Separating Shortcut Transition from Cross-Family OOD Failure in a Minimal Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12945)
*Hongmin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过一个包含不变特征和快捷方式特征的最小二元模型，解析地证明了训练相关性、学习到的快捷方式使用和OOD失败之间并不必然一致，发现岭正则化在确定性情况下可防止OOD失败，而当不变特征有噪声时，训练侧的快捷方式规则转换会导致保留测试集上的失败，但失败模式取决于保留家族的特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究混淆了训练相关性、学习到的快捷方式使用与测试时失败这三个不同概念，需要一个最小化模型来分离这些现象并理解它们之间的真实关系。

Method: 构建了一个最小二元模型，包含一个不变坐标和一个家族依赖的快捷方式坐标；采用logistic ERM（经验风险最小化）和岭正则化；通过解析推导和合成实验验证不同制度下的行为。

Result: 在确定性情况下，正的快捷方式相关性会将logistic ERM拉向正的快捷方式权重，但岭正则化保持分类器以不变特征为主导；在不变坐标有噪声时，岭-logistic ERM会在训练快捷方式信号超过不变信号时切换到快捷方式规则；这种转换是否导致失败取决于保留家族的特性——较弱的快捷方式相关性产生正的额外风险，符号反转的家族产生高于随机水平的错误。

Conclusion: Shortcut attraction、shortcut规则转换和跨家族OOD失败这三个阶段可以被明确区分开来；弱快捷方式相关性和符号反转的保留家族会导致不同的失败模式，而岭正则化可以在确定性情况下防止OOD失败。

Abstract: Shortcut features are often invoked to explain out-of-distribution (OOD) failure, but training correlation, learned shortcut use, and test-time failure need not coincide. We study a minimal binary model with one invariant coordinate and one family-dependent shortcut coordinate. In the deterministic regime, positive average shortcut correlation pulls logistic ERM toward positive shortcut weight, but ridge regularization keeps the classifier invariant-dominated and prevents deterministic OOD failure. When the invariant coordinate is noisy, ridge-logistic ERM switches to the shortcut rule once the training shortcut signal exceeds the invariant signal. Whether that transition causes failure depends on the held-out family: weaker shortcut correlation yields positive excess risk, and sign-flipped families yield above-chance error. Synthetic checks match these analytic regimes and show that the same training-side transition can have different held-out consequences. The model separates shortcut attraction, shortcut-rule transition, and cross-family OOD failure.

</details>


### [227] [U-HNO: A U-shaped Hybrid Neural Operator with Sparse-Point Adaptive Routing for Non-stationary PDE Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12965)
*Yingzhe Ma,Xiao Yang,Yuxin Xie,Zihan Xiong,Jinliang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: U-HNO is a U-shaped hybrid neural operator that uses Sparse-Point Adaptive Routing (SPAR) to dynamically select between global Fourier and local Gaussian branches at each spatial location based on local feature contrast. It achieves SOTA performance across multiple PDE benchmarks, especially on problems with sharp localized features.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Many PDE solutions exhibit coexisting smooth global transport and localized sharp features (shock fronts, thin interfaces, concentrated high-frequency content) within single trajectories. Existing neural operators face a tradeoff: Fourier-based architectures efficiently handle non-local interactions but under-resolve localized non-smooth features; spatially local architectures recover fine details but sacrifice long-range propagation and rollout stability. Current hybrid operators use fixed spatially uniform fusion, forcing the same trade-off everywhere without adapting to local feature characteristics.

Method: The paper proposes U-HNO with Sparse-Point Adaptive Routing (SPAR): a per-pixel hard mask at each spatial location selects whether the global Fourier branch or local multi-scale Gaussian branch dominates, with sparsity ratio as a function of local contrast in the routing signal. This is embedded in a hierarchical encoder-bottleneck-decoder backbone with skip connections, where dual branches and gate operate at every resolution. Training combines pointwise supervision with a finite-difference H^1 gradient term and a band-wise spectral consistency regularizer.

Result: U-HNO achieves state-of-the-art rollout accuracy on the majority of benchmarks (1D Burgers, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, KdV, 2D advection, Allen-Cahn, Navier-Stokes, Darcy flow, and 3D transonic compressible Navier-Stokes from PDEBench) in both relative L^2 and H^1 metrics, with the largest gains on problems dominated by sharp localized features.

Conclusion: Ablation studies confirm that removing any single component substantially degrades rollout error, validating the necessity of each design element in U-HNO.

Abstract: Solutions to many partial differential equations (PDEs) display coexisting smooth global transport and localized sharp features within a single trajectory: shock fronts, thin interfaces, and concentrated high-frequency content sit on top of slowly varying backgrounds. This poses a challenge for neural operators: Fourier-based architectures mix nonlocal interactions efficiently but tend to under-resolve localized non-smooth features, whereas spatially local architectures recover fine detail at the cost of long-range propagation and rollout stability. Existing hybrid operators paper over this tension with a fixed, spatially uniform fusion that forces the same trade-off everywhere.
  We propose U-HNO, a U-shaped hybrid neural operator whose central design is Sparse-Point Adaptive Routing (SPAR): at every spatial location, a per-pixel hard mask selects whether the global Fourier branch or the local multi-scale Gaussian branch should dominate, and the sparsity ratio is a function of the local contrast of the routing signal, so smooth and shock-aligned regions receive different mixtures of global and local computation. SPAR is embedded in a hierarchical encoder-bottleneck-decoder backbone with skip connections so that the dual branches and the gate operate at every resolution. Training combines pointwise supervision with a finite-difference H^1 gradient term and a band-wise spectral consistency regularizer.
  Across benchmarks spanning 1D Burgers, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, KdV, 2D advection, Allen-Cahn, Navier-Stokes, Darcy flow, and 3D transonic compressible Navier-Stokes from PDEBench, U-HNO achieves state-of-the-art rollout accuracy on the majority of tasks in both relative L^2 and H^1 metrics, with the largest gains on problems dominated by sharp localized features. Ablations show that removing any single component substantially degrades rollout error.

</details>


### [228] [Controlling Logical Collapse in LLMs via Algebraic Ontology Projection over F2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12968)
*Hisashi Miyashita,Mgnite Inc*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出代数本体投影(AOP)方法，通过将LLM隐藏状态投影到有限域F2中，在不使用模型微调的情况下实现高达93.33%的零样本包含关系推理准确率，并揭示了LLM内部存在可形式化验证的代数结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型(LLM)是否在内部以形式化可验证的代数结构编码本体论关系？现有研究多将LLM的逻辑推理视为隐式近似，缺乏可形式化验证的方法论。

Method: 提出代数本体投影(AOP)方法：(1)将LLM隐藏状态投影至伽罗瓦域F2；(2)应用Liskov替换原则约束；(3)仅使用42对关系对作为代数密钥；(4)通过提示工程实现零样本推理，无需模型微调。

Result: 在Gemma-2 Instruct模型上达到93.33%零样本准确率，多个模型家族保持86.67%一致准确率；语义结晶(SC)指标可预测零样本准确率；系统提示作为代数边界条件，与指令微调协同防止"后期层崩溃"现象（7/10条件下观察到此退化）。

Conclusion: LLM的前向计算可重新理解为迭代代数组织过程，为构建形式化可验证逻辑结构的LLM提供了理论基础和方法路径。

Abstract: Do large language models internally encode ontological relations in a formally verifiable algebraic structure? We introduce Algebraic Ontology Projection (AOP), which projects LLM hidden states into the Galois Field F2 under Liskov Substitution Principle constraints, using only 42 relational pairs as algebraic keys. AOP achieves up to 93.33% zero-shot inclusion accuracy on unseen concept pairs (Gemma-2 Instruct with optimized prompt), with consistent 86.67% accuracy observed across multiple model families -- with no model tuning, but through prompt alone.
  This algebraic structure is strongly layer-dependent. We introduce Semantic Crystallisation (SC), a metric that quantifies F2 constraint satisfaction relative to a random baseline and predicts zero-shot accuracy without held-out data. System prompts act as algebraic boundary conditions: only their combination with instruction tuning prevents Late-layer Collapse -- a systematic degradation of logical consistency in the final layers, observed in 7 of 10 conditions. These findings reframe forward computation as an iterative process of algebraic organisation, and open a path toward LLMs whose logical structure is not merely approximated, but formally accessible.

</details>


### [229] [Revisiting Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards from a Contrastive Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12969)
*Feng Zhang,Xinhong Ma,Ziqiang Dong,Xi Leng,Jianfei Zhao,Xin Sun,Yang Yang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将 GRPO 重新推导为一个"加权正负判别"目标（Proposition 1），并据此指出其两大结构性缺陷：似然错位的代理分数（用裁剪后的 token 级重要性采样比率而非序列似然来分离正负样本）与分数不敏感的信用分配（rollout 级信用仅由组通过率 p̂_q 决定，与组内正负分数差无关）。为此提出 ConSPO：以长度归一化序列对数概率作为 rollout 分数，优化组内 InfoNCE 风格的对比目标，并引入课程式调度 margin。多个骨干模型/规模/数据集上在七个数学推理基准上一致优于 GRPO、DAPO、Dr.GRPO、DisCO、GMPO、CISPO、SAPO 等基线（如 1.5B 平均 44.4 vs GRPO 40.0，32B 平均 63.0 vs 60.2）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR（可验证奖励强化学习）已成为提升 LLM 推理能力的标准范式，GRPO 因其 critic-free（用组内结果奖励估计组相对优势）设计而被广泛采用。已有改进工作多在 GRPO 原目标外围做修补（重要性采样、奖励塑形、动态采样、agentic 扩展等），但其核心优化机制本身缺乏理论剖析。作者希望回答一个更基础的问题：GRPO 在目标层面究竟在优化什么？作者发现 GRPO 实质上是一个"加权正负判别"目标——提升验证正确 rollout 的序列级分数、压低错误 rollout 的分数。这使得两个长期被忽视的缺陷显性化：(1) 似然错位的代理分数——判别所用的分数是裁剪重要性比率的序列平均，而非真正决定自回归生成的序列似然，扩大代理分数差并不改善当前策略下的似然排序，形成训练-推理错配；(2) 分数不敏感的信用分配——Lemma 1 表明正/负 rollout 的梯度系数分别固定为 (1/N+)√(p̂_q(1-p̂_q)) 与 -(1/N-)√(p̂_q(1-p̂_q))，仅由组通过率决定，与组内正负分数差无关，因而"勉强正确的正样本"与"高分难负样本"被等同对待。动态采样只能间接缓解，无法消除该缺陷根源。

Method: 1) 等价判别式重构（Proposition 1）：利用裁剪函数恒等式 f(ρ,A)=A⁺min(ρ,1+ε)−A⁻max(ρ,1−ε)，将 GRPO 期望形式写成 E_q[ W(q)·E_{o~π̃+,o'~π̃−}[s_θ⁺(o,q)−s_θ⁻(o',q)] ]，其中 π̃± 是按优势正/负部分重加权后的分布，W(q)=½E|A|；在 RLVR 二元奖励且 0<p(q)<1 时化为 E_q[√(p(q)(1−p(q)))·E_{π_old⁺,π_old⁻}[s_θ⁺−s_θ⁻] ]。2) 梯度分析（Lemma 1）给出固定信用系数的结论。3) ConSPO（Contrastive Sequence-level Policy Optimization）：(a) 似然对齐打分 s_θ(o,q)=(1/|o|)Σ_t log π_θ(o_t|q,o_<t)，正负 rollout 使用同一打分函数；(b) 组内 InfoNCE 目标 Ĵ_NCE(q)=(1/N+)Σ_i τ log[ exp(s_i⁺/τ) / (exp(s_i⁺/τ)+Σ_j exp(s_j⁻/τ)) ]，把负 rollout 视为干扰项（distractors）；(c) Lemma 2 给出梯度：正样本 ∂J/∂s_i⁺=(1/N+)(1−P_i⁺)，负样本 ∂J/∂s_j⁻=−(1/N+)Σ_i P_ij⁻，且两个负样本梯度幅值之比恰为 exp((s_j⁻−s_k⁻)/τ)，故高分负样本受更强压制；(d) 课程式 margin：m_t=(M/2)(1−cos(πρ_t))，ρ_t=min(λ_t/α,1)，通过从正样本分数中减去 m_t，使对比梯度在正负仅微弱分离时仍保持压力，且前期只要求粗粒度排序、后期逐步加强分离。训练中丢弃全正/全负组（无有效对比）；超参 τ=10、M=0.01、α=30%。

Result: 实验覆盖 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B、R1-Distill-Llama-8B、Qwen3-4B-Base、Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct（附录含 32B），训练数据用 DeepScaleR-Preview（约 40k）与 DAPO-Math-17k，评测七个基准（AIME24/25/26、HMMT25、MATH500、AMC、OlympiadBench）。结果：1.5B 平均 44.4（较 GRPO +4.4，较最强基线 +1.6，且七项全部最优）；7B 57.5（+2.1）；Llama-8B 51.8（+1.9）；Qwen3-4B-Base 34.0（+2.1，HMMT25 从 0.9 提升到 8.0）；Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct 29.2（+0.6）；DAPO-Math-17k 上 44.1（+1.9）；32B 上 63.0 vs GRPO 60.2，七项全胜。消融（1.5B）：去对比目标 42.7（降幅最大）、改回裁剪比率打分 43.4、去 margin 44.1、固定 margin 43.9，说明三组件互补。参数敏感性显示 τ 过小会使对比分布过尖、目标 margin 与 warmup 比例过大均掉点，偏好中等分离强度与恰当节奏；训练曲线显示 ConSPO 全程奖励高于 GRPO。

Conclusion: 本文指出以往 RLVR 改进多停留在 GRPO 目标外围，而通过对 GRPO 的等价判别式重构，暴露出"似然错位的代理分数"与"分数不敏感的信用分配"两个目标级根本缺陷，并据此提出 ConSPO：用似然对齐的序列对数概率打分 + 组内 InfoNCE 对比目标 + 课程式调度 margin，实现对比敏感的信用分配（难分离正样本获得更强更新，高分负样本承担更大压制），在多种骨干、规模与数据集上稳定优于强 RLVR 基线。局限：实证主要限于 8B 及以下（32B 仅在附录中与 GRPO 对比），更大规模需更系统评估；对比视角仅以 InfoNCE 目标、似然打分和 margin 一种实例化，其他目标形式与打分函数的设计仍待探索。作者亦强调方法效果不依赖特定骨干与数据集，且未引入含隐私数据的新数据集。

Abstract: RLVR has become a widely adopted paradigm for improving LLMs' reasoning capabilities, and GRPO is one of its most representative algorithms. In this paper, we first show that GRPO admits an equivalent discriminative reformulation as a weighted positive-negative score difference. Under this view, GRPO increases sequence-level scores of verified positive rollouts and decreases those of negative rollouts, where the scores are averages of clipped token-level importance sampling ratios. This reformulation reveals two structural limitations of GRPO: likelihood-misaligned scoring, where clipped ratio-based surrogate scores are optimized instead of generation likelihoods, and score-insensitive credit assignment, where rollout-level credit is assigned without accounting for relative score gaps between positive and negative rollouts in the same group. To address these limitations, we propose ConSPO, a framework for Contrastive Sequence-level Policy Optimization in RLVR. ConSPO replaces GRPO's clipped ratio-based scores with length-normalized sequence log-probabilities, aligning the optimized rollout scores with the likelihoods used in autoregressive generation. It then optimizes a group-wise InfoNCE-style objective that contrasts each positive rollout against negative distractors from the same group, enabling credit assignment to depend on their relative scores. This contrastive formulation amplifies updates for poorly separated positives while concentrating suppressive updates on high-scoring negatives. Moreover, ConSPO introduces a curriculum-scheduled margin, guiding optimization from coarse positive-negative ordering in early training toward stronger separation in later stages. Extensive evaluations across diverse backbone models, parameter scales, and training datasets show that ConSPO consistently outperforms several strong RLVR baselines on challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [230] [CoRe-Gen: Robust Spectrum-to-Structure Generation under Imperfect Fingerprint Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12980)
*Tianbo Liu,Chixiang Lu,Jing Hao,Hengyu Zhang,Lifei Wang,Haibo Jiang,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CoRe-Gen 是一个面向质谱（MS/MS）光谱到分子结构生成的“条件中心”框架，核心思想是把“预测指纹（predicted fingerprint）不完美”这一部署时的真实瓶颈显式建模为条件失配问题：通过合成光谱预训练提升编码器的指纹预测质量、用频率感知的指纹腐蚀（corruption-aware）匹配训练与部署的噪声分布、用可微的 fingerprint-to-memory 桥替代硬阈值/索引序列化以实现编码器—解码器联合微调、再配合结构感知自回归解码（组合式 SELFIES 嵌入、辅助结构监督、规则化 logit 掩码）来消化残余误差。在 NPLIB1 上达到 21.49%/35.42% Top-1/Top-10 完全匹配（InChIKey）与 0.57/0.67 Tanimoto，超过 DiffMS（8.34%/15.44%）；在 MassSpecGym 上以“编码器对齐”评测（换用 DiffMS 公开编码器权重）达 20.02%/22.45%；推理速度约 2 秒/谱（100 候选，RTX 4090），比 DiffMS 快约 80×、比 MADGEN 快约 15×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MS/MS 光谱到分子结构的从头推断在代谢组学、天然产物发现和化学分析中至关重要。现有范式分为检索式（受数据库覆盖率与实验失配限制）与从头生成式（受高质量光谱—分子配对数据稀缺、仪器与采集条件差异、以及严格化学有效性约束的限制）。其中“指纹条件生成”是一种常用折中：先用光谱编码器预测分子指纹，再由自回归解码器（如 MolForge 式、MS-BART 式）把指纹反解为结构，从而可以利用大规模指纹—分子语料预训练。但该范式存在两个耦合缺陷：(1) 训练时解码器使用“干净/预言机（oracle）指纹”，部署时却只能拿到预测指纹，两者存在结构性条件失配；真实数据中活跃指纹位点呈长尾分布（MassSpecGym 上 4096 位中 3422 位为“极稀有”位，精确率仅 0.198、召回 0.083），低频子结构位的假阳性/假阴性错误会系统性传播到生成过程；(2) 常见实现对预测概率做阈值化并把活跃位索引序列化为离散 token，这种硬接口丢弃了比特置信度，也阻断了分子生成损失回传到光谱编码器，使上游误差无法被端到端纠正。论文因此把问题重新表述为“在条件失配下的鲁棒生成”，需要同时改善条件质量、对齐噪声分布、保留软置信度并利用残余不确定性。

Method: 整体为两阶段框架：光谱编码器（基于 MIST 架构，隐层 512、8 头、3 层 peak-attention、5 层 refinement，配 FP-Growing 头预测 4096 位 Morgan 指纹）+ 结构感知自回归解码器（6 层 Transformer，隐层 512，词表经组合式 SELFIES 改造后仅 43 个有效 token）。四个核心设计：(1) 改善条件——编码器在约 79 万个有效有机分子的模拟 MS/MS 语料（CFM-ID 4.0 在 10/20/40 eV、ICEBERG、SCARF 共 5 类模拟光谱）上预训练，再在真实光谱上以 BCE 微调（可选按位频重加权）；MassSpecGym 上出现次数 ≤20 的稀有位在预训练集中平均被观测 1164.8 次，全部 199 个稀有位计数提升 ≥10×。(2) 匹配条件——解码器预训练时施加“频率感知”的稀疏保持型位交换腐蚀：按训练集位频分位划为 very-rare/rare/mid/frequent 四桶，用 η⁻=1−Recall、η⁺=1−Precision 估计各桶误报/漏报倾向并归一化为采样权重 w_r^±，再以 Bernoulli 门控 p_corr 决定是否腐蚀、截断 Poisson(λ=k_max/2) 采样腐蚀预算 k_eff，按桶权重分别从活跃集/非活跃集采样删除集与新增集；采用分阶段调度（5 epoch 干净 → 5 epoch ramp → 全腐蚀，p_corr 由 0.3 升至 0.6，k_max=24）。(3) 可微桥接——将 4096 维软指纹按模 64 分成 64 组，组内以比特预测值对学习到的比特嵌入做置信度加权归一化，得到 64 个 chunk 特征，再经 6 层 512 维、8 头、带 RoPE 的 Transformer 上下文化为 64 个 memory token，通过交叉注意力条件化解码器；因无阈值/索引选择，序列损失可回传至编码器，实现联合微调（损失 L_joint = L_AR + λ_fp·L_fp + λ_sent·L_sent）。(4) 利用残余误差——组合式 SELFIES 嵌入把 token 分解为 (part type, element, bond prefix, ring/branch order, hex digit) 并做规范化（去除同位素/手性/显式H/电荷标记），嵌入为各因子加性组合（高频规范 token 额外加残差项）；辅助结构监督在元素计数、= 与 # 键计数、环/支计数上以期望计数与目标计数的归一化 MSE 构造 L_sent（权重 w_elem=1.0，w_bond=w_ring=w_branch=0.2，λ_sent=0.1）；推理期规则化 logit 掩码使用基准提供的真实分子式，禁止式中不存在的元素原子 token，并强制环/支 token 后的十六进制续写、禁止孤立 hex token。解码采用 beam=100 生成 100 个候选，按分子式距离（加权绝对元素计数差）重排，同分以模型 log 概率打破。预训练语料与 NPLIB1/MassSpecGym 测试集做了分子级去重防泄漏，评测采用 InChIKey 完全匹配、Top-k 最大 Tanimoto（Morgan r=2, 4096）与 Top-k 最小 MCES。

Result: NPLIB1：Top-1/Top-10 精确匹配 21.49%/35.42%（DiffMS 8.34%/15.44%，MS-BART 7.45%/10.99%，MIST+MSNovelist 5.40%/11.04%），MCES 5.57/4.03（越低越好），Tanimoto 0.57/0.67，均为最佳。MassSpecGym：自训编码器仅 1.23%/2.67%，换用 DiffMS 公开编码器权重（仅改编码器、数据划分、式信息、候选数、重排与指标均不变）后达 20.02%/22.45%，MCES 16.09/13.90，Tanimoto 0.40/0.47；FOAM 在 MCES 与 Top-10 Tanimoto 上更优。编码器预训练使 BCE 下降 29.03%（NPLIB1，0.031→0.022）与 23.81%（MassSpecGym，0.063→0.048），余弦相似度提升 7.23%/14.49%；MassSpecGym 上预训练后指纹 Tanimoto 0.322，仍低于 DiffMS 公开权重 0.464（作者复现未成功，已致信作者团队未获回复，故做受控对齐实验）。消融（Top-1/Top-10）：去掉联合微调 19.54/29.92，去掉编码器预训练 11.46/19.80（贡献最大），去掉腐蚀预训练 14.77/23.93，去掉组合式 SELFIES 18.19/26.86，去掉软正则 19.23/29.34，去掉规则生成 19.17/28.57，去掉整个 exploit 模块 17.95/26.98；使用 GT 指纹可达 82.91/87.30，说明编码器仍是主要瓶颈。效率：约 2 s/谱（100 候选，RTX 4090），MADGEN ≈29 s、DiffMS ≈160 s，对应约 15× 与 80× 加速。稳健性分析：GT 指纹与预测指纹的失配在 NPLIB1 上平均错误 28.92 位、swap_k 均值 10.97，MassSpecGym 上 62.39 位、均值 24.86（99.97% 样本非零）；用 MSBuddy 预测式替代真实式时 NPLIB1 Top-1 降至 13.94%、Top-20 精确匹配 30.58%，MassSpecGym Top-1 4.88%、Top-20 16.97%。训练集覆盖度分层显示与训练集最大相似度 <0.4 时 Top-1 仅 2.3%，>0.9 时 36.4%；NPLIB1 上 Top-1/Top-10 骨架（Bemis–Murcko）命中 44.20%/57.43%，明显高于精确分子；库耗尽实验（移除同 InChIKey、同骨架与 Tanimoto≥0.6 相似物）下 CoRe-Gen Top-10 Tanimoto 0.721、MCES 3.398，优于耗尽库的 0.338/8.765（10000 次配对 bootstrap 置信区间不含 0），且库内 oracle 上限也仅 0.338/8.762，说明瓶颈在覆盖率而非排序；三随机种子波动小（NPLIB1 Top-1 21.49±0.29%）。

Conclusion: CoRe-Gen 通过“改善条件—匹配条件—利用条件”的三段式设计，配合可微 fingerprint-to-memory 桥与结构感知自回归解码，把指纹条件生成从“假设输入完美”的理想化管线转变为可在真实噪声条件下工作的实用系统，在 NPLIB1 上取得新 SOTA，并在 MassSpecGym 编码器对齐设置下取得最佳精确匹配，同时保留自回归解码的高效性（约 2 秒/谱）。论文同时明确了局限：编码器质量仍是主要瓶颈（GT 指纹下可达 82.91%），主结果依赖基准提供的真实分子式（用预测式时性能明显下降，MassSpecGym 更敏感），输出应视为排序后的结构假设而非确定性鉴定（远离训练化学空间时准确率显著降低），且面向速度的单次生成设计在精度优先场景可能不如检索或迭代精化。附录明确声明测试集统计仅用于事后诊断，未参与方法设计与超参选择，并指出模拟器互补性尚未做受控隔离实验。更广泛的启示是：鲁棒的光谱到结构生成应通过更强的编码器、条件对齐的预训练和面向部署的鲁棒解码来显式建模中间条件的不确定性。

Abstract: Molecular structure elucidation from tandem mass spectra (MS/MS) remains challenging, particularly for de novo generation beyond database coverage. A common approach decomposes the task into spectrum-to-fingerprint prediction followed by fingerprint-to-structure decoding, enabling the use of large-scale molecular corpora. However, at deployment, the decoder relies on predicted rather than oracle fingerprints, introducing structured errors that propagate into generation. This results in a fundamental condition mismatch, where models trained on clean inputs must operate under noisy, biased predictions, especially for long-tail substructures.
  We present CoRe-Gen that explicitly addresses this gap. CoRe-Gen improves the intermediate condition via synthetic-spectrum pretraining of the encoder, matches deployment-time noise through frequency-aware fingerprint corruption during decoder training, and mitigates residual errors using structure-aware autoregressive decoding with compositional SELFIES representations, auxiliary structural supervision, and lightweight chemical constraints. Experiments on standard benchmarks show that CoRe-Gen establishes a new state of the art on NPLIB1, achieving 19.54\% Top-1 and 29.92\% Top-10 exact-match accuracy, while remaining competitive on the more challenging MassSpecGym benchmark. Importantly, CoRe-Gen preserves the efficiency advantages of autoregressive decoding, providing a practical and scalable solution for robust spectrum-to-structure generation under realistic conditions.

</details>


### [231] [Decision Tree Learning on Product Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12983)
*Arshia Soltani Moakahr,Faraz Ghahremani,Kiarash Banihashem,MohammadTaghi Hajiaghayi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将 Blanc 等人(ITCS 2020)对自顶向下贪心决策树构建启发式(基于影响度分裂)的理论分析从均匀分布推广到任意独立乘积分布。核心结论:若目标函数在乘积分布下可由最优树(规模 s、最大深度 D_opt、平均深度 Δ_opt)计算,则贪心启发式能产出 ε-近似树,其规模至多为 exp(Δ_opt·D_opt·log(e/ε));在最优树为满二叉树时该界严格优于 Blanc 等人的结果且适用于更广的分布类。此外,论文给出首个完全无参数(不需预知最优树规模/深度)、完全基于样本估计的实用实现,并分析其样本复杂度与运行时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策树是机器学习与算法理论的核心模型,ID3/C4.5/CART 等实用算法均采用自顶向下的贪心分裂策略。但已有理论分析严重依赖均匀分布这一简化假设(其证明依赖布尔超立方体上傅里叶分析结构与均匀分布下的方差-影响度不等式),与真实数据中特征分布异质的事实相悖。同时,多数理论工作分析的是自底向上或暴力搜索型算法,与实践中的贪心算法脱节,难以解释实用算法的高效表现。Blanc 等人(ITCS 2020)首次为基于影响度的贪心启发式给出了严格保证,但仅限均匀分布。因此需要在更一般的乘积分布(μ=μ_1×…×μ_n,坐标独立且边缘可任意偏斜)下给出保证,并提供可直接落地、无需超参的算法实现。

Method: 设定:布尔函数 f:{0,1}^n→{±1},查询访问 + 从乘积分布 μ 采样,分析 Blanc 等人的 BuildTopDownDT 贪心算法(每步对每个叶子打分 Score(l)=p_l·max_i Inf_i(f_l),选分数最高叶子按其最影响变量分裂)。方法核心是势函数分析:定义裸树代价 cost(T°)=Σ_leaves p_v·Inf(f_v),并证明 (1) 误差上界 error(T°,f)≤cost(T°)(对变量数归纳证明 error(g,±1)≤Inf(g));(2) 初值上界 Inf(f)≤D(T)·Var(f) 且 Inf(f)≤Δ(T)(利用全方差公式逐层求和);(3) 每步代价恰减 Score(v)(分裂变量在子函数上影响为零的分解);(4) 两个阶段的单步进展下界:高成本阶段 Score(l*)≥cost/(j·D_opt·Δ_opt),高误差阶段 Score(l*)≥2ε/(j·Δ_opt)。据此得两阶段步数界 J_1≤max((Δ_opt/(εD_opt))^{D_optΔ_opt},1) 与 J_total≤J_1·e^{Δ_opt D_opt}。实用化部分:给出只需选择 1/4-近似最优叶子的鲁棒版本(界中指数因子变 4 倍);设计基于"重随机化"样本对 (x, x^{(i)}) 的无偏分数估计器并用乘性 Chernoff 界给出每步每变量样本量 M_S(j,δ,ε,n)=12(j+1)n/ε·ln(4j²(j+1)n/δ);用 ERM 多数投票为叶子赋标签(假设空间大小 2^l,一致收敛界)并用独立样本集做 Hoeffding 误差估计控制终止条件,给出正确性与终止性保证及总运行时间 O(J log J·n² log n·ε^{-2} log(1/δ))。附录给出完整证明、Algorithm 2 伪代码与实证评估。

Result: 主定理(Theorem 1.1):对任意乘积分布 μ,若 f 的最优决策树深度 D_opt、平均深度 Δ_opt,则贪心算法返回 ε-近似树,规模至多 max((eΔ_opt/(εD_opt))^{Δ_optD_opt}, e^{Δ_optD_opt}) = exp(O(Δ_opt D_opt log(e/ε)))。满二叉树情形退化为 s^{log s·log(e/ε)},严格优于 Blanc et al. 2020 的界并适用于严格更广的分布类。混合依赖同时带来两重收益:平衡情形(D_opt=Δ_opt=log s)为 s 的准多项式;路径型树情形 D_opt=n 而 Δ_opt≤2 为常数,界为 exp(Θ(n)) 而非 exp(Θ(n²))。Theorem 5.1 给出 1/4-近似分数下的鲁棒保证(指数中 Δ_optD_opt 变为 4Δ_optD_opt)。样本复杂度:分数估计 M_S、标签估计 M_LL=128((j+1)ln2+ln(16j²/δ))/ε²、误差估计 M_EE=32ln(16j²/δ)/ε²,总失败概率 ≤δ/2。实验(n=20 与 n∈{3..7},p∈{0.5,0.3,0.1},6 次重复)显示恢复树规模接近真值且远在界之内,样本复杂度在 n 与 1/ε 上仅多项式增长。

Conclusion: 本文把经典自顶向下贪心决策树启发式的严格理论保证从均匀分布推广到任意乘积分布,证明贪心(影响度分裂)在非均匀、偏斜数据下仍具 provable 保证,填平了理论分析与实践算法之间的鸿沟;同时给出首个完全无参数、纯样本驱动的实用实现(含分数估计、叶子标注与误差估计三套自适应增采样本集),使该算法可直接部署。局限:分析针对未剪枝的"生长阶段"树,CART 等依赖后剪枝抑制过拟合,作者指出剪枝规则的可证分析尚属空白;未来方向是推广到连续特征与阈值分裂(需推广坐标重随机化的影响度定义与 O'Donnell et al. 2005 的最大影响度-方差不等式),并考察指数中 Δ_opt·D_opt 依赖是否可改进为 Δ_opt+D_opt 或 max(Δ_opt,D_opt) 或仅以 s 表述;结合 Koch et al. (2023,2024) 的超多项式下界,准多项式依赖在常数意义上近乎最优。

Abstract: Decision tree learning has long been a central topic in theoretical computer science, driven by its practical importance. A fundamental and widely used method for decision tree construction is the top-down greedy heuristic, which recursively splits on the most influential variable. Despite its empirical success, theoretical analysis of this heuristic has been limited. A recent breakthrough by Blanc et al. (ITCS, 2020) provided the first rigorous theoretical guarantees for the greedy approach, but only under the uniform distribution. We extend this analysis to the more general and practically relevant setting of arbitrary product distributions. Our main result shows that for any function $f$ computable by an optimal decision tree of size $s$, maximum depth $D_{\text{opt}}$, and average depth $Δ_{\text{opt}}$, the greedy heuristic constructs an $ε$-approximating tree whose size grows at most with $\exp\bigl(Δ_{\text{opt}} D_{\text{opt}} \log(e/ε)\bigr)$. In the special case where the optimal tree is a full binary tree, this bound improves upon the bound of Blanc et al. and holds under a strictly broader class of distributions. Moreover, we present an algorithm based on the top-down greedy heuristic that is entirely parameter-free -- it requires no prior knowledge of the optimal tree's size or depth -- offering a practical advantage over Blanc et al.'s method.

</details>


### [232] [Not Just RLHF: Why Alignment Alone Won't Fix Multi-Agent Sycophancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12991)
*Adarsh Kumarappan,Ananya Mujoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 这篇论文证明：多智能体LLM流水线中"从正确翻转为错误"的漏洞并非RLHF对齐训练造成的，而是预训练模型自带的中层（L14–L18）注意力主导机制。该机制在四个模型家族的base模型中同样存在（甚至更高），通过对齐反而部分缓解。攻击面可分解为"信道框架×共识强度"两个因子，user角色需全票一致才翻转、assistant/tool角色多数票即翻转，二者在3v1处产生47.5pp差距。机制本质是压制干净的推理特征而非激活新的谄媚电路。单一正确发言的异议者可将yield降低54–73pp，而最强的系统提示防御在其设计面之外迅速失效。因此防御应针对机制本身，在流水线层注入结构化异议，而非提示层防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM流水线（agentic工作流、辩论式验证器、工具路由聚合）已在生产中部署，并普遍依赖7–9B小模型（成本与延迟低10–30倍）。已有行为学研究（Wynn & Hadfield 2025等）报告：单个被污染或恶意的同伴输出，甚至仅仅一句"大家一致认为X"的断言，就能让主体模型在其本来能正确回答的问题上44–98%地翻转为错误答案（本文称之为yield）。主流解释一直归因于RLHF诱导的谄媚（sycophancy），但这一归因从未在机制层面用"匹配的预训练base模型对照"检验过。这一缺失的检验决定了正确的修复方向是更好的后训练，还是流水线层的结构化防御。已有机制性可解释工作（Marks & Tegmark 2023；Li et al. 2023；Zou et al. 2023；Vennemeyer et al. 2025）只涉及激活空间中的线性"真相方向"和方向分解，既未定位多智能体压力在网络中的作用位置，也未检验RLHF归因，更未解释行为性防御为何跨攻击框架迁移失败。

Method: 主体模型为Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct（bfloat16），接收MMLU人文类400题（美国史/世界史/政治/哲学）与三个陪审模型（Gemma-2-9B-it、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-v0.3）预生成的、齐声断言同一预承诺错误答案的回复；题目需通过clean P(correct)>0.8过滤。两种协议：suffixed（提示末尾追加"The correct answer is ("以强制单字母输出，机制分析统一在答案字母前一token位置读出）与unsuffixed（无前缀，在assistant-header边界读出，配重新拟合的probe与位置匹配LDA）。条件设计围绕两个因子：（1）信道框架——named peer jury（user轮）、assistant-role jury（作为模型自己先前的输出）、tool-role jury（模拟工具返回/ipython），内容恒定只变角色；（2）共识强度——wrong-agent count sweep，4/5/6个陪审模型中k个主张错误答案（k_wrong∈{0..4}），其余主张正确，agent-position分配按题随机，扩展至N=5（加Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct）、N=6（加Yi-1.5-6B-Chat）。归因分解条件：anonymous perspectives（去掉名字与共识句）、anonymous jury（只加共识句）、direct user assertion及token-matched版本；另有11变体共识句消融、strong/weak两种陪审语料、五条防御性系统提示。机制工具五种：activation patching（把clean隐状态注入pressured前向，测P(correct)恢复）、logit lens（定onset层）、每层四选一线性probe（低于25%随机基准则为substitution而非degradation）、Goodfire L19 SAE（top-100受压变化特征clamp回clean均值，配LLM判官标注特征族并用20条合成提示验证）、difference-in-means（L25方向按α缩放相减）。机制分析做组件分解（分别patch attention/MLP贡献）。另做base vs Instruct四家族匹配题池对照、跨域（MMLU STEM/CS）迁移、跨seed与污染过滤审计、adaptive attacker测试。全部实验在单张RTX 3090上完成（约200 GPU小时）。

Result: 1) 归因被推翻：四个家族（Llama/Mistral/Gemma/Qwen）的base模型呈现与Instruct相同的"替换"模式，在12个家族×条件格中base有10格的yield不低于Instruct；Qwen最典型（assistant-role下base 92.1% vs Instruct 43.2%），说明RLHF是部分缓解而非致因。2) 位置定位：Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上clean-to-pressured P(correct)差距0.764，patching在L10–L12无效、L14起爬升（+0.289）、L16近满恢复（+0.668），任何L≥18的patch恢复96.8%的差距；Mistral-7B逐层复现。组件分解显示attention承担≥81%的层内恢复、MLP各层均近零（|Δ|<0.017）。3) 机制为特征压制：SAE特征clamp中"下降特征"贡献几乎全部因果权重（−15.6pp P(wrong)），"上升特征"近零（−2.3pp），DIM方向相减降P(wrong) 32.5pp；P(correct)仅部分恢复（+3.5/+10.5pp），表明概率质量流向其余错误答案而非完全替换。四类特征族（baseline-reasoning、consensus-signal、named-attribution、channel-framing）在另外4个SAE基座上复现分离。4) 攻击面：user角色是"全票检测器"（4v0才跳至80.25%，3v1仅12.75%），assistant/tool角色是"多数检测器"（3v1即60.25%/76.75%），3v1处跨框架差距47.5pp（最大效应）；结构在N∈{4,5,6}保持，assistant-role下2v2与3v3的yield同为6.50%（按比例而非绝对多数），tool-role在各N下cliff比例与assistant一致但yield高约16pp。归因分解显示效应主要是"共识断言"现象（无共识句35.75%≈直接断言44.0%，加共识句升至81.0%），模型对"计数与可见证据相容性"敏感而非数值大小（"3/3" 82.25% > "100/100" 64.75%）。5) 防御：单一正确异议者使yield在user/assistant/tool框架下分别下降70.5/73.25/53.5pp，且机制上使L14–L18保持clean-like状态（disruption/transfer patching证明必要且充分）；最强"skeptical"系统提示在其设计攻击上降65pp，但面对裸断言降28pp、无陪审裸断言降13.75pp、unsuffixed协议下几乎无效（+0.25pp），显示其仅作用于读出而非中层机制。

Conclusion: 多智能体谄媚是一种预训练的中层脆弱性，而非RLHF产物：腐化定位于attention主导的L14–L18回路，在四个家族的base模型中普遍存在，并分解为"信道框架×共识强度"的攻击面。单一正确发言的异议之所以能跨攻击框架泛化，而提示层防御不能，正是因为它干预的是该机制无论信道如何都把关的"共识轴"。防御应针对机制本身，在流水线层做结构化异议注入，而非依赖提示级防御。后续工作包括检验该压制特征是否推广到其他谄媚场景（奉承、用户偏好迎合）、刻画生成时动态与中层压制机制的交互、以及评估结构化异议注入在已部署多智能体流水线中的可操作性。局限：SAE/DIM分析仅在Llama架构上完成；suffixed强制选择读出与真实生成行为存在差距；assistant/tool框架下异议救援后残余yield较高（24.50%/44.25%）；陪审语料经审计约1/5强陪审回复实际在论证正确答案（污染过滤后named peer yield升至85.23%）。

Abstract: LLM-based multi-agent pipelines flip from correct to incorrect answers under simulated peer disagreement at rates we term yield, a vulnerability widely attributed to RLHF-induced sycophancy. We test this attribution across four model families and find it largely wrong: pretrained base models exhibit the same substitution pattern as their Instruct variants, averaging higher yield than Instruct. Using activation patching, we localize the corruption to a narrow mid-layer window where attention carries the causal weight and MLP contribution is negligible; patching above this window restores 96% of the clean-to-pressured P(correct) gap. The attack surface decomposes into two independent factors (channel framing and consensus strength) whose interaction produces a 47.5 percentage-point yield gap at majority consensus, preserved across jury sizes $N \in \{4, 5, 6\}$. Two converging activation-space interventions show that pressure suppresses clean-reasoning features rather than activating a new sycophancy circuit. A single correctly-arguing dissenter reduces yield by 54-73 percentage points across all framings tested, whereas the strongest prompt-level defense fails on attack variants outside its design surface. Mitigations should target the mechanism, structured dissent at the pipeline level, rather than prompt-level defenses.

</details>


### [233] [DP-Muon: Differentially Private Optimization via Matrix-Orthogonalized Momentum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12994)
*Jihwan Kim,Chenglin Fan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DP-Muon 把 Muon 的矩阵动量 + Newton–Schulz 正交化作为隐私梯度的后处理，直接继承采样高斯机制的 RDP 账本，不额外消耗隐私预算；论文的关键发现是 DP 噪声经非线性 Newton–Schulz 映射后产生"矩阵热平滑"均值偏差（源在线性动量缓冲区之后），据此提出用反热外推（antithetic 高斯探针）做偏差校正的 DP-MuonBC，把条件输出偏差从 O(ν²) 降到 O(ν⁴)（任意阶可达 O(ν^(2K+2))），并给出分离裁剪残差、隐私噪声、动量漂移与有限步 NS 误差的矩阵块平稳性上界及"何时 BC 证书更优"的判据；E2E 上 GPT-2 私调显示 DP-Muon 全面优于 DP-Adam/DP-AdamBC，DP-MuonBC 进一步小幅但一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 差分隐私（DP）微调已由 DP-SGD 建立了成熟的范式：逐样本裁剪 + 高斯噪声 + 重复访问的会计（composition）。同一私有梯度可被多种优化器变换复用：Muon（Jordan et al., 2024）对隐藏层矩阵权重做动量累积后用有限步 Newton–Schulz（NS）迭代近似极分解，把矩阵结构先验注入更新。已有非私有 Muon 分析（Shen et al., 2025; Kim and Oh, 2026）说明矩阵结构与有限步正交化误差的性质，但并未回答"这些结构在任意隐私噪声下是否仍然可用"。核心未解问题有三：(1) 逐样本裁剪、高斯噪声、动量与非线性正交化在 Muon 中的相互作用从未被系统分析；(2) 隐私后处理虽由标准 DP 定理自动私有，但其非线性会系统性地扭曲噪声的均值（E[Q(A+Z)] ≠ Q(A)），这一"热平滑"偏差的量级与后果未知；(3) 偏差校正（如 DP-AdamBC 的方差扣减）在矩阵映射下的正确形式、其额外更新代价、以及校正后能否真正改善收敛证书，均缺少理论刻画。论文还明确区分了两类偏差：全局裁剪造成的是灵敏度控制的均值损失（不可恢复），而非线性映射造成的输出均值扭曲（可校正），并声明本文只处理后者。

Method: 【机制与记号】参数分为 Muon 管理的矩阵块 W=(W^(1),...,W^(Lm)) 与辅助参数 u。第 t 步以公共包含概率 π 做 Poisson 抽样得批 ℒ_t，用公共归一化 B=πN（相邻数据集间固定，不随私有数据集规模重算，也不用实际批大小）计算逐样本梯度 G_{t,i}，用全局一次裁剪 a_{t,i}=min{1, C/(‖G_{t,i}‖_2+τ_c)} 得 H_{t,i}=a_{t,i}G_{t,i}，聚合为 Ḡ_t=(1/B)Σ H_{t,i} 并加一次联合高斯噪声 Z_t~N(0,ν²I)，ν=σC/B；所有优化器（含 Adam、AdamBC、Muon、MuonBC）共用同一全局裁剪与同一次联合释放，坐标拆分不构成额外梯度查询。

【矩阵后处理】定义"光滑 NS"映射 Q_{γ,κ,q}：先用 N_γ(X)=T(X)/sqrt(γ²+‖X‖_F²) 归一化（m>n 时转置），再做 q 步 Y_{j+1}=p_κ(Y_jY_j^T)Y_j，其中 p_κ(z)=Σ c_j(1-z)^j, c_j=binom(2j,j)/4^j；Q= T^{-1}(Y_q)。该映射 C^∞、任意阶导数有界、算子范数 ≤1，且导数尺度为 M_{2j}=O(d^j γ^{-2j})、H_2=O(γ^{-2})。

【偏差校正】定义高斯平均算子 P_ρF(X)=E_U F(X+ρU)，满足 P_{ρ1}P_{ρ2}=P_{sqrt(ρ1²+ρ2²)}；用 J 个独立的反对称（antithetic）高斯探针估计 P̂_{ν,J}。校正方向 O_t^{λ,J}=(1+λ)Q(M_t)−λ P̂_{ν,J}Q(M_t)，其中 M_t=βM_{t−1}+Ḡ_t+Z_t。

【关键分析工具】设 𝒢_t 为当前噪声前的全部自适应历史（含历史批、噪声、探针、辅助更新），则 A_t=βM_{t−1}+Ḡ_t 是 𝒢_t-可测的，且 M_t=A_t+νE_t 在条件 𝒢_t 下为高斯——这是"精确高斯热恒等式"的基础，无需冻结历史梯度。

【隐私】Theorem 2.1：全模型（含辅助 Adam 状态）为 (ε,δ)-DP，ε=inf_α{Tρ_SGM(α;π,σ)+log(1/δ)/(α−1)}；动量、矩阵映射、高斯探针、辅助 Adam、学习率重标定均为后处理，不额外花费隐私。论文强调"同预算"仅指相同的抽样、灵敏度、噪声标定与组合证书，而非相同的实现轨迹；报告的 ε 为单次配置运行的预算，完整超参搜索需另行计费。

【优化理论】(i) Theorem 3.1（完全自适应条件偏差）：E[O_t^{λ,J}|𝒢_t]−Q(A_t)=[(1−λ)D_ν−λD_ν²]Q(A_t)，范数 ≤ |1−λ|aM_2+λa²M_4，a=ν²/2；普通 Smooth-NS DP-Muon 为 O(ν²)，λ=1 的 DP-MuonBC 为 O(ν⁴)。(ii) Theorem C.2（任意阶）：O_t^[K]=Σ_j c_{K,j}P̂_{√j ν}Q(M_t)，条件均值 [I−(I−P_ν)^{K+1}]Q(A_t)，偏差 ≤ a^{K+1}M_{2K+2}，但确定性系数范数增长到 2^{K+1}−1。(iii) Proposition 3.2（探针尺度失配）：若固定尺度 ρ≠ν，条件均值退化为 [(1+λ)P_ν−λP_{sqrt(ν²+ρ²)}]Q(A_t)，主项变为 (a−λc)ΔQ(A_t)；累积噪声尺度 √V_t/s_t 与条件噪声尺度 ν/s_t 之比趋于 1/(1−β²)，不可当作"已匹配"。(iv) 平稳性：定义裁剪残差 ℬ_T(C)=√R sup_t E[(1−N⁻¹Σ(1−a_{t,i})‖G_{t,i}‖_2)]、方差包络 v_C²=(1−π)C²/B+Dν²、动量跟踪 Γ_T(β) 与 NS 质量缺陷 E_T(α)=E[(1/s_t)Σ_ℓ[α‖A_t^{(ℓ)}‖_*−⟨A_t^{(ℓ)},Q_ℓ(A_t^{(ℓ)})⟩_F]_+]；Theorem 4.3 给出 (1/T)Σ E‖g_t‖_{Σ,*} ≤ N_T(K;α)/(α−b)，其中 b 为条件输出偏差界，K 为更新矩界；Lemma B.2–B.3 给出无谱隙的确定性缺口自由估计 E_T(1) ≤ R(γ_max+C+ν√D)/√(2e(κ+1)^q)。(v) Proposition 4.2：λ 更正下的更新矩 E‖O_t‖ ≤ K_λ，探针误差 E‖ζ‖_F² ≤ (1/J)min{r, H_2²ν⁴d(d+2)/4}；λ=1 时 K_1−1=O(ν²)（固定形状/映射/正则），关键小噪声量约为 √d ν/γ。(vi) Corollary 4.4 给出 DP-MuonBC 证书严格小于 DP-Muon 证书的充要条件 Lη(K−1)[(α+1)β/(1−β)+(K+1)/2] < (b_mu−b_bc)/(α−b_mu)·N_T(1;α)。(vii) Proposition C.3 反例：Q=cos·、A=0、g=−1 时偏差校正反而恶化梯度对齐，说明均值偏差减小不蕴含优化更好。(viii) 附录 F/G：给出无热偏差分母的"噪声动量"版本平稳性上界、固定噪声下的 NS 调度渐近率 O(T^{-1/4}√log T) 与 O(T^{-1/6})（明确标注为非固定总隐私），以及耦合辅助 Adam 的混合不等式（含显式"不利下降"项 𝒰_T，不声称 Adam 坐标的平稳性）。

Result: 【理论结论】(1) DP-Muon 的隐私证书与同批采样高斯机制完全一致，NS 正交化、动量、探针、辅助更新均为免费后处理（Theorem 2.1）。(2) DP 引入的偏差不在线性动量缓冲区本身，而在非线性 Newton–Schulz 映射之后，表现为高斯噪声经矩阵映射后的"热平滑"偏差；条件于噪声前的实际自适应状态可得精确高斯热恒等式（Theorem 3.1/C.2）。(3) 一阶 DP-MuonBC 将条件输出偏差由二阶 O(ν²M_2/2) 降为四阶 O(ν⁴M_4/4)，任意阶扩展达 O(ν^{2K+2})，但确定性幅度上界随之增至 2^{K+1}−1，因此高阶不必然带来更好的优化保证。(4) 探针尺度失配会使主偏差项变为 (a−λc)ΔQ，故"匹配尺度"是修正生效的前提。(5) 有限时域矩阵块平稳性界把优化误差、裁剪残差 ℬ_T(C)、隐私噪声 √R v_C Γ_T(β)、动量漂移 LηKβ/(1−β) 与 NS 有限步缺陷 E_T(α) 分离，并给出偏置感知版本与"噪声动量"版本（附录 F）两套证书；Corollary 4.4 精确刻画了 BC 上界何时更优（需偏置改善超过更正带来的额外移动量与光滑性代价）。(6) 结构保持方面：Proposition I.1 给出前导奇异子空间在当前扰动下的条件稳定性界（依赖谱隙 g_k），但明确指出这不等于非私有 Hessian/梯度结构优势在任意隐私水平下保留；直接对方向加噪的替代方案会引入与 C/B 不同的灵敏度（∥DQ∥=O(γ^{-1})），且理想 polar 映射在退化处无全局 Lipschitz 常数。

【实验】GPT-2 在 E2E（42,061/4,672/4,693 条训练/验证/测试参考）上私调，10 epoch、序列长 100、物理批 16、梯度累积 64（期望批 1024）、Poisson 抽样、δ=8×10⁻⁶，ε∈{1,2,4,8} 对应 0.9986/1.9957/3.9887/7.9788。所有方法共用单一全局裁剪；Muon 类方法矩阵动量 0.95、5 步矩阵映射，向量/嵌入/语言模型头用辅助 Adam（lr 0.002）；DP-MuonBC 为一阶 Smooth-NS 反热外推，λ=1.25、1 个反对称探针、κ=2、γ_ns=1e⁻⁴。测试 NLL（seed 0）：DP-SGD 0.6105/0.6355/0.5991/0.5723；DP-Adam 0.5707/0.5487/0.5336/0.5195；DP-AdamBC 0.5715/0.5478/0.5308/0.5155；DP-Muon 0.5673/0.5431/0.5263/0.5133；DP-MuonBC 0.5667/0.5427/0.5259/0.5128。即 DP-Muon 在所有预算上优于 DP-Adam 与 DP-AdamBC，DP-MuonBC 相对 DP-Muon 的 NLL 改善约 5.8e-4/4.0e-4/4.5e-4/5.1e-4。BLEU/ROUGE-L 上 Muon 系列亦整体领先（DP-MuonBC 与 DP-Muon 在生成指标上互有胜负，排序与 NLL 不完全一致）。消融：λ 从 0.5→1.25 验证 NLL 渐进改善（ε≈2 时 0.533460→0.533411），λ=1 与 λ=1.25 差异极小，说明 λ=1.25 是调参外推而非更好的形式阶；三阶（实为二阶 Smooth-Jordan）更高端校正在各预算上略差于 DP-Muon，印证高阶不必然提升效用。种子 0/1/2 配对比较中，DP-MuonBC 在 9 个"预算×种子"配对上验证 NLL 全部更低，平均测试 NLL 改善约 4.65e-4/5.15e-4/6.51e-4（ε≈1/4/8），但改善幅度小且种子间标准差相当（~1e-3 量级）。

Conclusion: DP-Muon 说明：矩阵型优化器完全可以在标准 DP-SGD 框架下使用，只需把 Newton–Schulz 正交化视为免费后处理，其隐私保证与同批采样高斯机制逐字相同。论文的核心洞见是隐私噪声经非线性矩阵映射后产生系统性的"热平滑"均值偏差，且该偏差可以在正确标定的映射输入处用反热外推加以抵消（一阶即由 O(ν²) 降至 O(ν⁴)），这为矩阵型 DP 优化器提供了一条区别于标量方差扣减的偏差校正路径。相应地，作者也强调了三条边界：偏差校正只是输出层面的均值修正，不恢复裁剪丢弃的信息、不消除高斯释放的方差、也不必然改善梯度对齐（已给出反例）；BC 的效用收益须与更正引入的额外更新量/光滑性代价一并权衡（给出充要比较判据）；更高形式阶并不带来更好的优化保证，实证上二阶更高端校正反而略差。此外，理论保证为矩阵坐标的平稳性，混合 Muon–Adam 的辅助坐标下降未被证明；实验中的隐私预算为单次配置运行预算，超参搜索本身仍需隐私会计。总体而言，本文提供了"DP 噪声 × 非线性矩阵映射"的可量化理论与可复现的小幅实用增益，其价值主要在于机制刻画与严谨的证书比较，而非数量级上的效用提升。

Abstract: We study differentially private (DP) training with Muon, a matrix-valued optimizer that updates hidden-layer weights using momentum followed by Newton--Schulz orthogonalization. While DP-SGD is well understood, the interaction between per-example clipping, Gaussian noise, momentum, and nonlinear orthogonalization in Muon has not been systematically analyzed. We formulate DP-Muon, a private Muon procedure that clips per-example matrix gradients, adds Gaussian noise to the clipped lot average, and then applies momentum and Newton--Schulz orthogonalization as post-processing. We prove that DP-Muon inherits the privacy guarantee certified by the corresponding same-lot subsampled Gaussian accountant, with no additional privacy cost from Muon-specific post-processing. On the optimization side, we establish finite-horizon and vanishing stationarity guarantees under per-matrix clipping, with bounds that separate optimization error, clipping residual, privacy noise, and Newton--Schulz approximation error. We further show that the DP-induced bias in Muon arises not in the linear momentum buffer itself, but after the nonlinear Newton--Schulz map, where Gaussian noise induces a matrix-valued heat-smoothing bias. This motivates DP-MuonBC, a bias-corrected variant that removes the leading output-level bias term while preserving the same privacy guarantee. Experiments on E2E and DART show that Muon-style matrix updates improve private fine-tuning, and that DP-MuonBC further improves utility without increasing the privacy budget.

</details>


### [234] [F-GRPO: Factorized Group-Relative Policy Optimization for Unified Candidate Generation and Ranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12995)
*Rohan Surana,Gagan Mundada,Junda Wu,Xintong Li,Yizhu Jiao,Bowen Jin,Sizhe Zhou,Tong Yu,Ritwik Sinha,Jiawei Han,Jingbo Shang,Julian McAuley*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 F-GRPO（因子化组相对策略优化）：在单次自回归 rollout 内显式拆分为“候选生成（SLATE）+ 候选排序（RANK）”两阶段，共享同一 LLM 骨干，用顺序无关的覆盖奖励与位置感知的效用奖励分别计算组相对优势并分别施加到两段 token 子序列上，实现端到端优化与阶段专属的信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统检索是“先召回后重排”的多阶段流水线，排序器受限于上游候选集，与下游效用不一致；LLM 虽能在一次自回归中同时生成候选子集并排序，但效用反馈只在完整排序列表生成后给出，无法区分失败源于“未生成相关候选（覆盖不足）”还是“未把候选排对（排序不佳）”。这种信用分配缺口使端到端优化不稳定、样本效率低。已有做法要么把 LLM 当黑盒重排器（无阶段区分手段），要么把生成与排序拆成独立模块（各自优化代理目标、且存在分布错配），均未弥合生成—排序的优化鸿沟。

Method: 形式化因子化策略 πθ(τ,σ|x)=πθ^slate(τ|x)·πθ^rank(σ|x,τ)，其中 τ 为 n 个候选的有序 slate，σ 为其排列；目标为 max E[R_slate + λR_rank]，R_slate 为顺序无关的覆盖奖励（推荐用 recall、QA 用 F1 计相关项之和），R_rank 为位置感知的 NDCG@k。实现上使用 <SLATE>/<RANK> 标签解析 rollout，对两段内容分别用 Dr. GRPO（均值减、无标准差归一化）计算组相对优势 Â_slate、R̄_slate 与 Â_rank、R̄_rank，构造 ℒ_slate 与 ℒ_rank（含逐 token 裁剪比值、长度归一化），总损失 ℒ=ℒ_slate+λℒ_rank+β_KL·D_KL(πθ‖π_ref)，单次反向传播。分隔符 token 参与前向但按位置掩码排除在损失外；格式错误分三类（缺标签）并施加 p_fmt=-1.0 惩罚；RANK 阶段若引入 slate 外条目（幻觉）则以惩罚替换奖励。附录 A 证明在 θ=θ_old 处梯度一阶可分解为仅依赖各自优势的 slate 与 rank 两项，消除跨阶段梯度污染。实验：Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 与 Qwen3.5-2B，Dr. GRPO，G=8，SFT 热启动，λ=1.0，slate 大小 n=10，任务为 MovieLens/LastFM 序列推荐与 HotpotQA/MuSiQue 多跳 QA，候选池均为 20。

Result: 推荐任务：Qwen3-4B F-GRPO 在 LastFM Recall@1/3/5 达 46.8/72.4/81.7、MovieLens 26.9/53.6/66.6，均优于 GRPO（LastFM R@5 相对 +10.6%）、SFT（MovieLens R@3 相对 +82.9%）与所有传统模型（GRU4Rec、UniSRec），在 MovieLens 所有 cutoff 全面超过传统模型；NDCG@1 与 Recall@1 数值相同。QA 任务：MuSiQue 上 F-GRPO 相对 GRPO 增益最大（Qwen3-4B Recall@3 相对 +13.2%），HotpotQA 上 4B 与 GRPO 基本持平、2B 在 @3 及以上明显领先（Recall@3 相对 +5.9%）；HotpotQA 上 F-GRPO 超过所有专用零样本重排器（RankZephyr、MonoT5、DuoT5、LiT5），MuSiQue 上 R@1/@3 超过 MonoT5、@5 具竞争力。解耦式 SFT（尤其 full 变体）全面弱于单模型 SFT，归因于排序器在金标 slate 上训练、推理时面对生成 slate 的分布错配。分析：召回型 slate 奖励优于 F1 奖励（LastFM R@5 相对 +48%、MovieLens +85%）；训练动态显示 slate 生成器先成熟（step150 达峰值 slate 召回 90%），排序器后成熟（step200）；精度–召回再分配显示 slate 高召回低精度（4B 召回 0.90/精度 0.090），排序器以召回换精度（精度 0.163）；错误归因显示 slate miss 与 rank drop 均衡分布（LastFM 8.9%/9.4%，MovieLens 17.9%/15.4%）；消融显示 λ=1.0、n=10 最优，λ=0.5 损害首位质量，n=5 覆盖不足、n=15 稀释候选池；F-GRPO 收敛更快（LastFM 约 1000 步 vs GRPO 约 2000 步）。

Conclusion: F-GRPO 通过在单次自回归 rollout 内同时完成候选生成与排序，并为两个阶段分配独立的组相对优势，把 GRPO 扩展为两阶段序列级信用分配框架：既消除单奖励 GRPO 的跨阶段梯度干扰，也规避解耦流水线的训练/推理分布错配，同时保持单一模型、推理时无需额外结构。实验表明在覆盖是瓶颈时收益最大，在推荐与多跳 QA 上优于 GRPO 与解耦基线、优于监督方法，并可与强零样本重排器竞争。局限在于实验规模限于 2B–4B 模型、候选池固定为 20 且训练数据为 10k 抽样，两阶段结构强依赖 SFT 热启动与格式标签解析（Qwen3.5-2B 在 QA 上甚至需从预训练权重起步），收益在覆盖不构成瓶颈（如 HotpotQA 4B）时有限。

Abstract: Traditional retrieval pipelines optimize utility through stages of candidate retrieval and reranking, where ranking operates over a predefined candidate set. Large Language Models (LLMs) broaden this into a generative process: given a candidate pool, an LLM can generate a subset and order it within a single autoregressive pass. However, this flexibility introduces a new optimization challenge: the model must search a combinatorial output space while receiving utility feedback only after the full ranked list is generated. Because this feedback is defined over the completed sequence, it cannot distinguish whether a poor result arises from failing to generate a relevant subset or from failing to rank that subset correctly. This credit assignment gap makes end-to-end optimization unstable and sample-inefficient. Existing systems often address this by separating candidate generation from ranking. However, such decoupling remains misaligned with downstream utility because ranking is limited by the candidate set it receives. To bridge this gap, we propose a unified framework that performs both within a single autoregressive rollout and optimizes them end-to-end via factorized group-relative policy optimization (F-GRPO). Our framework factorizes the policy into candidate generation and ranking while sharing a single LLM backbone, and jointly trains them with an order-invariant coverage reward and a position-aware utility reward. To address the resulting phase-specific credit assignment problem, we use separate group-relative advantages for generation and ranking within a two-phase sequence-level objective. Across sequential recommendation and multi-hop question answering benchmarks, F-GRPO improves top-ranked performance over GRPO and decoupled baselines, outperforms supervised alternatives, and remains competitive with strong zero-shot rerankers, with no architectural changes at inference time.

</details>


### [235] [Frequency Bias and OOD Generalization in Neural Operators under a Variable-Coefficient Wave Equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12997)
*Runlong Xie,An Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在一维变系数波动方程的终态算子学习任务下，对比 FNO 与 DeepONet 两种代表性神经算子在结构化分布偏移下的泛化行为：FNO 在同分布（ID）与波速光滑度偏移下误差更低，但在未见过的高频输入上误差急剧上升（约 1.3–1.5 的相对 L2 误差），且误差跨多个中高频模态累积；DeepONet 整体误差较高但退化更平缓、空间上更均匀。通过保留 Fourier 模态数消融（8→16→32 反而使 OOD 频移误差增大）表明，FNO 的失效源于其谱表示的表示偏置（representation bias）而非容量不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子（FNO、DeepONet 等）在分布内表现优异，但其在结构化分布偏移（尤其是输入频率成分与介质系数结构变化）下的外推行为尚不清楚。现有研究多聚焦精度提升、可扩展性与几何灵活性，忽视了算子表示方式本身如何决定泛化行为。作者希望在剔除预训练、注意力机制、多尺度设计等混杂因素的“干净”受控环境中，隔离架构归纳偏置对 OOD 泛化的作用——因为在真实科学与工程应用中，模型常被应用于与训练数据系统性不同的物理系统，评估其稳健性不可回避。

Method: 问题设定：空间域 x∈[0,1] 上一维守恒型变系数波动方程 u_tt=∂_x(c(x)^2 u_x)，齐次 Dirichlet 边界条件、零初速度；学习算子 𝒢:(u0(x),c(x))↦u(x,T)（固定终端时刻 T）。数据生成：二阶有限差分（通量形式离散 + leapfrog 时间积分，满足 CFL 条件，界面处调和平均），在常系数情形下验证求解器；初值由随机 Fourier 组合 u0=Σa_k sin(kπx) 生成，训练/ID 取 K_u≤K_train，OOD-frequency 取 K_u>K_train；波速 c(x)=1+Σb_k sin(2πkx+φ_k) 由 K_c 控制，分为 smooth/medium/rough 三种光滑度区间，用于构造 OOD-smoothness。模型：FNO（提升 + 4 层 Fourier 层，保留 16 模态，隐藏宽度 64，GELU）与 DeepONet（分支/主干分解，隐藏维 128，latent 128，深度 3，ReLU），二者使用同一数据划分、相对 L2 损失、Adam（lr=1e-3，batch 32，100 epochs，early stopping patience 10，seed 2026，128 网格点）与 Dirichlet 输出包络。评估：相对 L2 误差、能量型诊断量 E(u)=∫c(x)^2 u_x^2 dx、误差的逐 Fourier 模态均方谱误差分析，以及 FNO 保留模态数（8/16/32）消融。

Result: FNO 在 Validation/ID 上误差最低（如 16 模态时 ID 相对 L2≈0.199），并在 OOD-smoothness 下保持稳定（≈0.059）；但在 OOD-frequency 下误差骤升至约 1.36，预测出现明显相位偏移与波形畸变，误差集中于目标解快速振荡、高曲率区域，谱误差在多个中高频模态带累积而非仅在最高频，说明其学习到的谱间耦合关系在分布外失效。消融显示把保留模态从 8→16→32 时 ID 误差在中间值最优，而 OOD-frequency 误差单调上升（1.298→1.356→1.467），证明单纯提升谱容量无法改善外推，问题在表示机制而非容量。DeepONet 整体误差较高但退化平缓，误差在空间与频域上更均匀分布，无显著的多频带集中，保留整体振荡结构与峰位。其原因在于分支–主干基展开表示不依赖固定保留的 Fourier 模态、不存在硬性谱截断。

Conclusion: 神经算子的分布内精度不足以刻画其性能：泛化行为在很大程度上由架构如何编码与耦合频率信息这一表示偏置决定。FNO 依赖固定低频截断的谱卷积，在未见高频下产生跨频带的结构性外推失效；DeepONet 因坐标条件基展开而无硬谱支撑，退化更平滑。论文据此主张：在面向物理的 PDE 代理模型中应常规引入结构化 OOD 评估与谱误差分析，而非仅报告 ID 指标；未来方向包括频率感知表示、可学习谱支撑，以及融合全局谱建模与局部空间特征的自适应/混合表示，以在保持计算效率的同时提升分布外稳健性。

Abstract: Neural operators learn to map initial conditions to the terminal solution of partial differential equations (PDEs), providing a surrogate for the full operator mapping. This enables rapid prediction across different input configurations. While recent neural operator architectures have demonstrated strong performance on diverse PDE tasks, their behavior under structured distribution shifts remains insufficiently understood. To investigate this, we study operator learning in a wave propagation setting governed by a one-dimensional variable-coefficient wave equation, using two representative architectures, the Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) and the Deep Operator Network (DeepONet). To examine their generalization under distribution shifts, we consider structured out-of-distribution (OOD) settings that independently vary input frequency and coefficient smoothness.
