### [341] [Efficient and Portable Support for Overdecomposition on Distributed Memory GPGPU Platforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12734)
*Aditya Bhosale,Anant Jain,Shourya Goel,Ritvik Rao,Peddoju Sateesh Kumar,Laxmikant Kale*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: This paper addresses the challenge of supporting overdecomposition—a parallel programming technique used in Charm++—on GPGPU systems. The higher overhead from overpartitioning (multiple objects per GPU) and portability across GPU vendors are the main concerns. The authors propose techniques and software to enable efficient, portable overdecomposition across different GPU types and networks.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPGPUs have become dominant compute components, but overdecomposition (overpartitioning with multiple objects per GPU device) introduces higher overhead, posing challenges to the Charm++ parallel programming paradigm.

Method: Developing techniques and software to support overdecomposition on GPU-based systems.

Result: Techniques and software demonstrating efficient and portable support for overdecomposition across different GPU vendor types and interconnection networks. (Proposed, not yet validated)

Conclusion: Overdecomposition can be efficiently and productively supported on combinations of different GPU vendor types and interconnection networks, enabling portability.

Abstract: Overdecomposition has emerged as a powerful and sometimes essential technique in parallel programming. Many application domains or frameworks, including those based on adaptive mesh refinements, or tree codes use it. Charm++ is a parallel programming system which has demonstrated the utility of overdecomposition for many applications and in multiple contexts. However, the emergence of GPGPUs as a dominant compute component has created some real and perceived challenges for this paradigm, especially regarding the higher overhead brought about by overpartitioning -- having multiple objects assigned to the same GPGPU device. We address this issue as well as the issue of portability by developing techniques and software that demonstrate that overdecomposition can be efficiently and productively supported on combinations of GPU vendor types, and interconnection networks.

</details>


### [342] [The Distributed Complexity Landscape on Trees Depends on the Knowledge About the Network Size](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12787)
*Alkida Balliu,Sebastian Brandt,Fabian Kuhn,Dennis Olivetti,Timothé Picavet,Gustav Schmid*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了 LOCAL 模型中"节点是否知道网络规模 n"这一常被忽略的建模假设对树上局部可检验标号 (LCL) 复杂度理论的影响。作者以 k-层级 1/2-着色与 k-rake-and-compress 分解（Θ(n^{1/k}) 复杂度类的完备代表问题）为载体，证明了四类模型设定下复杂度景观差异巨大：①完全不知道 n（且 ID 无界）时所有多项式类坍缩为 Ω(n)；②只知道 n 的多项式上界 N≤n^c 时复杂度变为 O(n^{cα₁})，其中 α₁ 由隐式方程确定（如 k=3,c=3 时约 n^{0.566}），且下界必须使用 Hardy-Littlewood 版的 Ω 而非 Knuth 版；③仅承诺 ID 空间受界（≤n^c）即可达到同样的上界；④无 n 知识且随机时，2-层级着色为 Θ(n/log n)、3-层级着色为 O(n/f(n))，其中 f(f(n))=log n（对数的函数平方根）。基本分类结论（要么 Θ(n^{1/k})，要么 O(log n)）仍成立，但复杂度变得极不自然，随机性的作用范围也大幅扩大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Linial 的 LOCAL 模型是分布式计算的核心理论模型，但文献中对初始假设的设定并不统一：有的工作让节点精确知道 n，有的只给出 n 的多项式上界，有的完全不给信息。LCL（Naor & Stockmeyer 1995 引入）是研究最充分的图问题类，其复杂度图景（尤其在树上的确定性复杂度分类、随机化加速、复杂度间隙 round elimination）在过去十年取得巨大进展，但这些结论（如 Chang-Kopelowitz-Pettie 2016、Chang-Pettie 2017、Balliu 等 2018）几乎都建立在"节点免费知道 n"的前提之上。作者因此追问：这些模型细节差异是纯粹技术性的，还是从根本上动摇了 LCL 理论？特别是：随机性是否仍只对确定性复杂度 Θ(log n) 的问题有帮助？是否存在复杂度落在 ω(√n) 与 o(n) 之间的 LCL？已知的多项式复杂度类是否会在放松 n 知识后"坍塌"？

Method: 在有界度树上研究 LCL，聚焦两个代表问题族：k-层级 1/2-着色（Chang-Pettie 2016 首次提出的 Θ(n^{1/k}) 代表问题）与 k-rake-and-compress 分解（对 Θ(n^{1/k}) 类具有完备性，可归约求解所有同阶 LCL）。分四个模型设定展开：(1) 纯 LOCAL（无 n 上界、ID 为任意自然数）；(2) 给定 N 与 c，满足 n≤N≤n^c，ID 取自 [1,n^c]；(3) 只知 c 与 ID≤n^c 的承诺，不知 n；(4) 随机 LOCAL（无 n 知识、无 ID）。技术要点包括：构造 k-层级下界图（参数 ℓ₁,…,ℓ_k 的递归路径图）并用"奇偶翻转"式图变换论证任何算法在常数时间内无法安全地给长路径做合法 2-着色；把 rake-and-compress 算法的各阶段用参数化指数 α₁,…,α_{k-1} 表达并归结为一个非平凡优化问题（平衡"前期激进投入"与"后期节省"），其最优解满足 1=(1/(1-cα₁))^{k-i₀}·i₀α₁，i₀=⌊1/(cα₁)⌋；用"decline gadget"（下降小工具）计数（ID 不交的小工具数 ≤ C·I^{1-α₁}，几何级数求和）间接估计 n；随机情形下每节点以 1/2 概率自我标记以产生概率性的长度阈值，并通过"友好/不友好路径"刻画 3-层级情形，最终用对数的函数平方根 f（f(f(x))=log x）刻画最优阈值。

Result: 主要结论如下。①完全无 n 知识（ID 无界）时：对所有 k>0，k-层级 1/2-着色与 k-rake-and-compress 都需要 Ω(n) 轮（Thm 1、2），即所有 Θ(n^{1/k}) 多项式类坍缩为单一线性类。②给定 n 的多项式上界：存在常数 α₁<1/c 为方程 1=(1/(1-cα₁))^{k-i₀}·i₀α₁（i₀=⌊1/(cα₁)⌋）的唯一解，此时所有已知 n 时复杂度为 O(n^{1/k}) 的 LCL 可在 O(n^{cα₁}+log*I) 轮内求解（Thm 3），且下界 Ω(n^{cα₁}) 在 Hardy-Littlewood 意义下成立（Thm 4、5）；在 Knuth 意义下则不可能证明 ω(n^{1/k}) 下界（Thm 6），因为构造出对无穷多个 n 只需 O(n^{1/k}) 轮的对策算法（Lemma 31，用 s_i=s_{i-1}^{2c} 的稀疏序列猜 n）。例：k=3,c=3 时复杂度为 O(n^{(7-√13)/6})≈O(n^{0.566})。③仅承诺 ID≤n^c：k-层级 1/2-着色可在 O(n^{cα₁}) 轮完成（Thm 7），与更强设定的下界匹配——说明"ID 空间大小的承诺"可以替代"n 的上界"。④随机且不知 n：2-层级 1/2-着色随机复杂度为 Θ(n/log n)（Thm 58、59），优于确定性 Θ(n)；3-层级着色存在 Las Vegas 算法 O(n/g(n)) 轮，其中 g(g(x))=log x，且下界为 Ω(n/(g(n)log n))（Thm 61、62），呈"半个对数"式非自然复杂度。结论层面：LCL 的基本分类（不是 Θ(n^{1/k}) 就是 O(log n)）保持不变，但复杂度取值、随机性的作用范围（不再局限于 Θ(log n) 的确定性复杂度问题）、以及下界表述所依赖的 Ω 定义都发生了显著改变。

Conclusion: 模型中"关于网络规模的先验知识"绝非技术细节，而是决定性因素：即便在有界度树上、即使 LCL 的基本问题分类保持不变，复杂度景观也会变得显著更复杂——出现极不自然的复杂度指数（由优化问题隐式决定的 α₁）、随机性在更多情形下带来加速（从仅限 Θ(log n) 扩展到 Θ(n/log n)、n/f(n) 量级）、甚至下界的成立与否取决于采用 Hardy-Littlewood 还是 Knuth 的 Ω 定义。作者强调这些结果只是第一步：任意 LCL 在"仅知多项式上界"或"仅知 ID 空间"设定下的精确复杂度、以及不知 n 时任意 LCL 的随机化复杂度仍是开放问题；作者也指出本文算法可直接迁移到不对未来节点数作假设的动态 LOCAL 模型变体，说明模型假设的影响远超标准 LOCAL 模型。

Abstract: One of the central models in distributed computing is Linial's LOCAL model [SIAM J. Comp. 1992]. Over time, researchers have studied distributed graph problems in the LOCAL model under slightly different assumptions, such as whether nodes know the exact network size $n$, only a polynomial upper bound on $n$, or nothing at all. We ask whether these differences are merely technical or fundamentally affect the theory of Locally Checkable Labelings (LCLs), one of the most studied problem classes.
  LCLs are graph problems whose valid solutions can be characterized by a finite set of allowed constant-radius neighborhoods. Since their introduction by Naor and Stockmeyer [FOCS 1995], they have become central in distributed computing, and the last decade has seen major progress in understanding their complexity. For example, Chang, Kopelowitz, and Pettie [FOCS 2016] showed that the randomized complexity of any LCL on $n$-node graphs is at least its deterministic complexity on $\sqrt{\log n}$-node graphs. Later, Chang and Pettie [FOCS 2017] showed that any randomized $n^{o(1)}$-round algorithm for LCLs on bounded-degree trees can be turned into a deterministic $O(\log n)$-round algorithm. Then, Balliu et al. [STOC 2018] showed that such automatic speedups are impossible for general bounded-degree graphs. However, these results fundamentally rely on nodes knowing $n$. How much does this assumption affect the theory of LCLs?
  Our work shows that if nodes are oblivious to $n$, or know only a polynomial upper bound on it, then even on trees, the theory of LCLs changes significantly. While the fundamental classification of problems remains the same, we show the landscape becomes much more complex: for example, for LCLs, randomness helps in more cases; some problems have very unnatural complexities; and some have a lower bound that depends on which definition of $Ω$ we use!

</details>


### [343] [Communication Efficient Byzantine Agreement with Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12935)
*Muhammad Ayaz Dzulfikar,Seth Gilbert*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本论文证明拜占庭协议中，高通信量（Ω(n³)）和预测信息共享并非预测增强方法的必要代价。通过无认证算法O~(n^{2.5})和有认证算法O(n²κ)两种方案，在不牺牲最优轮复杂度的前提下大幅降低了通信开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统拜占庭协议存在Ω(f)轮数下界。现有的预测增强算法存在两个问题：(1)只能处理有限的预测错误；(2)通信复杂度高达Ω(n³)，足以让进程大致共识预测分类。

Method: 提出两个新算法：(1) 无认证算法，采用O~(n^{2.5})通信复杂度；(2) 有认证算法，达到最优O(n²κ)通信复杂度（κ为安全参数）。两算法均能容忍任意数量的预测错误。

Result: 所有算法对任意数量的预测错误均具有最优轮复杂度，且在有认证情况下达到最优通信复杂度O(n²κ)。

Conclusion: 本研究证明了高通信量并非不可避免，提供了更高效的拜占庭协议解决方案；其中无认证算法达到O~(n^{2.5})通信复杂度，有认证算法达到最优O(n²κ)复杂度，且所有结果对任意数量的预测错误均具有最优轮复杂度。

Abstract: In Byzantine agreement with predictions each process begins with an input value and some (unreliable) prediction bits. Recently, it has been shown that with \emph{classification predictions} -- where the predictions predict each process to be honest or faulty -- Byzantine agreement can be completed more quickly than without predictions, circumventing the traditional $Ω(f)$ round lower bound. However, existing algorithms either handle limited prediction errors or send too many messages. Moreover, they all exchange $Ω(n^3)$ bits -- enough to allow the processes to approximately agree on the classifications. In fact, it almost seemed necessary to share a significant number of prediction bits if one wanted to tolerate a high number of incorrect predictions.
  In this paper, we show that this high level of communication (and sharing of predictions) is not inherent by developing an unauthenticated algorithm with $\tilde{O}(n^{2.5})$ communication complexity. Furthermore, with authentication, we give an algorithm with optimal $O(n^2κ)$ communication complexity (where $κ$ is a security parameter). All of our results have optimal round complexity for any number of errors in the predictions.

</details>


### [344] [Comparing the Performance of Heterogeneous Conjugate Gradient and Cholesky Solvers on Various Hardware Using SYCL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13209)
*Tim Thüring,Alexander Strack,Dirk Pflüger*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 提出基于SYCL的异构CG与Cholesky分解实现，在大矩阵场景下相比GPU-only方案性能提升12%-32%，并支持NVIDIA、AMD、Intel多供应商GPU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高规模线性系统求解是许多实际应用（如高斯过程系统辨识）的核心需求，现有方法仅依赖GPU而未充分利用现代HPC系统中强大的CPU资源。

Method: 利用SYCL实现多供应商异构编程，同时调度CPU和GPU协同计算CG方法与Cholesky分解。

Result: 大矩阵场景下，异构CG实现比GPU-only快32%，Cholesky分解快29%；跨NVIDIA/AMD/Intel平台均实现至少12%的性能提升。

Conclusion: 异构实现能够在不同供应商（NVIDIA、AMD、Intel）的GPU上均超越传统的GPU-only方法，为高性能计算系统中的线性系统求解提供了更优解决方案。

Abstract: Many important real-world applications, such as System Identification with Gaussian Processes, involve solving linear systems with symmetric positive-definite matrices. The iterative CG method and direct solvers based on the Cholesky decomposition are two popular methods that can be applied in this case. Since often very large systems have to be solved when dealing with such real-world scenarios, GPUs are commonly used to accelerate the computations. However, homogeneous approaches that only leverage the GPU in the system do not take full advantage of the often powerful CPUs located in modern HPC systems. In this work, we present multi-vendor, heterogeneous implementations of the CG method and the Cholesky decomposition that leverage the CPU and GPU of a heterogeneous system simultaneously using SYCL. Furthermore, we compare their runtime behavior to traditional, homogeneous approaches. The results show that for large matrices, our heterogeneous implementation is up to 32 percent faster for the CG method and up to 29 percent faster for the Cholesky decomposition compared to the corresponding GPU-only implementations. In addition, for large matrices, our heterogeneous implementation of the Cholesky decomposition can achieve at least 12 percent faster runtimes across several systems with GPUs from NVIDIA, AMD, and Intel.

</details>


### [345] [PipeSD: An Efficient Cloud-Edge Collaborative Pipeline Inference Framework with Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13319)
*Yunhe Han,Yunqi Gao,Bing Hu,Mahdi Boloursaz Mashhadi,Yitong Duan,Pei Xiao,Yanfeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: PipeSD是一个高效的云边协同推理框架，通过动态规划优化的流水线调度重叠token生成与通信，并利用双阈值NAV触发机制和贝叶斯优化实现自适应验证，在真实环境中实现1.16x-2.16x加速和14.3%-25.3%能耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有云边协同推理框架存在两个关键问题：(i) token生成与通信顺序执行导致资源利用率低；(ii) 云端非自回归验证(NAV)触发机制不灵活，容易导致过早验证或昂贵的回滚操作。

Method: PipeSD提出两个核心创新：1) 基于动态规划优化的token-batch流水线调度机制，将token生成与通信过程重叠执行；2) 双阈值NAV触发机制配合轻量级贝叶斯优化自动调优器，实现灵活的验证时机控制。

Result: 在真实云边测试环境中，使用两对draft-target模型在四种场景下评估，PipeSD相比最优基线方法实现1.16x-2.16x加速比，同时降低能耗14.3%-25.3%。

Conclusion: PipeSD通过流水线调度和自适应验证触发机制，有效解决了传统云边协同推理中资源利用率低和验证不灵活的问题，在保持系统鲁棒性的同时实现了显著的性能提升和能耗降低。

Abstract: Speculative decoding can significantly accelerate LLM inference, especially given that its cloud-edge collaborative deployment offers cloud workload offloading, offline robustness, and privacy enhancement. However, existing collaborative inference frameworks with speculative decoding are constrained by (i) sequential token generation and communication with low resource utilization, and (ii) inflexible cloud non-autoregressive verification (NAV) triggering that induces premature verification or costly rollbacks. In this paper, we propose PipeSD, an efficient cloud-edge collaborative pipeline inference framework with speculative decoding. PipeSD overlaps token generation and communication by a token-batch pipeline scheduling mechanism optimized by dynamic programming, and improves verification flexibility through a dual-threshold NAV triggering mechanism with a lightweight Bayesian optimization autotuner. We implement PipeSD using llama-cpp-python, PyTorch, and FastAPI, and evaluate it on a real-world cloud-edge testbed with two draft-target model pairs across four scenarios. Results show that PipeSD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving 1.16x-2.16x speedup and reducing energy consumption by 14.3%-25.3%.

</details>


### [346] [TurboGR: An Accelerated Training System for Large-Scale Generative Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13433)
*Huichao Chai,Zhixin Wu,Xuemiao Li,Shiqing Fan,Hengfeng Wang,Maojun Peng,Lu Xu,Yaoyuan Wang,Yibo Jin,Wei Guo,Yongxiang Feng*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对Ascend NPU上的生成式推荐系统训练提出\model系统，通过参差加速、分布式通信优化和负采样优化三大创新，解决了稀疏计算与NPU架构不匹配的关键瓶颈，实现了94%的NPU利用率和近线性扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）作为统一Transformer架构的新范式展现出良好的扩展定律，但在大规模Ascend NPU上部署面临系统性挑战，主要源于参差算子的高性能实现缺失以及不规则稀疏原语与NPU密集计算优化架构之间的不匹配。

Method: 提出\model系统，包含三大核心创新：（i）Ascend亲和的参差（jagged）加速，通过融合算子消除填充冗余，动态负载均衡将设备间不平衡从47%降至2.4%；（ii）分布式通信优化，采用分层稀疏并行、半异步训练（带收敛保证）及细粒度流水线编排；（iii）负采样优化，通过异步卸载、参差感知的FP16量化及批次内logit共享扩展有效负空间。

Result: 在KuaiRand-27K数据集上验证，支持最高0.2B参数规模训练，达到54.71%的MFU利用率，近线性扩展性达0.97。

Conclusion: 所提系统在Ascend NPU上成功解决了生成式推荐系统部署的瓶颈问题，通过三种核心创新实现了高NPU利用率（94%）和近线性扩展性（0.97），为大规模生成式推荐训练提供了可行的Ascend生态解决方案。

Abstract: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as a promising paradigm that replaces fragmented, scenario-specific architectures with unified Transformer-based models, exhibiting scaling-law behavior where recommendation quality improves systematically with increased model capacity and training data. However, deploying GR at scale on Ascend NPUs faces fundamental system-level challenges. These challenges are further exacerbated on Ascend NPUs due to the absence of high-performance implementations for jagged operators and the architectural mismatch between irregular sparse primitives and NPU's dense-computation-optimized design. In this paper, we present \model, an Ascend-affinity training system for generative recommendation that systematically addresses these bottlenecks through three core innovations: (i) Ascend-affinity jagged acceleration, including fusion operators that eliminate padding redundancy and dynamic load balancing that reduces inter-device imbalance from 47\% to 2.4\%; (ii) distributed communication optimization, comprising hierarchical sparse parallelism, semi-asynchronous training with proven convergence guarantees, and fine-grained pipeline orchestration that sustains 94\% NPU utilization; and (iii) negative sampling optimization via asynchronous offloading, jaggedness-aware FP16 quantization, and intra-batch logit sharing that expand the effective negative space without additional embedding lookups. Evaluated on the KuaiRand-27K dataset, \model supports training at up to 0.2B parameters and achieves 54.71\% MFU with near-linear scalability (0.97).

</details>


### [347] [Sustainable Graph Analytics Workload Scheduling with Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning in Edge-Cloud Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13489)
*P. Ramicetty,H. Moore,S. Qi,A. Islam,M. Ghose,D. Milojicic,C. Bash,S. Pasricha*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: MERSEM 将进化搜索与强化学习（Q-learning 引导的局部搜索）相结合，用于异构边-云系统中图分析工作负载的卸载调度，在动态碳强度下联合优化 SLA 违约率与碳排放；相对 CAGWO/CACSA/CASSA/PSOGA 等基线，最多降低 45% SLA 违约、12% 碳排放，并验证了其在 GNN 工作负载与规模扩展下的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图分析/GNN 工作负载（遍历、聚合、邻居采样）具有不规则执行模式、严格数据依赖与频繁同步，IoT 设备数量激增（预计 2030 年近 390 亿）使边端卸载压力剧增。边-云执行在满足延迟/SLA 与降低能耗、碳排放之间存在根本权衡。现有碳感知雾/云调度框架普遍存在三点缺陷：(1) 忽略 DAG 引起的执行瓶颈；(2) 未显式建模应用级 SLA 约束；(3) 依赖静态或启发式优化，难以适应动态碳强度、负载结构与资源可用性波动。同时，已有多目标进化算法（NSGA-II/III）与 RL-进化混合框架多以云为中心，未涉及图工作负载与异构边-云环境。

Method: 系统建模：三层架构（边缘设备 / 雾数据中心 FDC / 云数据中心 CDC），节点具有 CPU、内存、存储、空闲与最大功率；负载采用 Rezaee 等人的大规模图工作流数据集（约 50 万作业、130 万任务，以 DAG 表示），作业整体绑定单一 VM 且不可拆分，VM 内顺序执行；端到端延迟 = 通信（WiFi/MAN/WAN 传输+传播）+ 排队（同 VM 前序作业执行时间之和）+ 执行（DAG 临界路径，或核数不足时退化为串行求和）；能耗按 CPU 利用率线性插值的功率模型、以 Δ 采样累计得 kWh，乘以按地理位置变化的碳强度 CI 得 gCO2。问题形式化为加权多目标最小化 min Σ_e (w_s·SLA_rate,e + w_c·CO2_total,e)，w_s+w_c=1，约束为每个作业恰好分配给一个 VM，并产生三种配置：MERSEM-Carbon / MERSEM-SLA / MERSEM-Balanced。MERSEM 框架（Algorithm 1）：初始化候选作业-VM 映射种群与一组目标偏好权重向量；每代先筛选部分解，交由 RL 引导局部搜索（Algorithm 2）精化标量化适应度并替换原种群成员；再经交叉与变异产生子代；最后用基于适应度与 Pareto 支配关系的支配式更新插入种群，输出多目标 Pareto 解集。RL 引导局部搜索：Q-learning 代理学习“何种扰动策略最有效”，状态由标量化适应度、时刻、归一化 SLA 违约率、归一化碳足迹、各层（边/雾/云）作业数、每 epoch 总作业数分箱离散化构成；动作空间为 5 种扰动强度（2%、5%、8%、10%、15% 作业重分配）；奖励 r = 0.7·tanh(Obj_current − Obj_new) + 0.3·r_dom，支配奖励为 +1.0 / −0.5 / 0.1；采用轨迹缓冲，episode 末以折扣回报 G_t 与整体改进信号 I=tanh(f_start − f_localBest) 统一更新 Q 值 β=α(G_t+I−Q(s,a))；ε-greedy 探索，ε 初始 0.4 逐步衰减；α=0.15、γ=0.9。实验基于扩展的 EdgeCloudSim：1 个 CDC（Xeon Platinum 8470 / Gold 6430 / Silver 4410Y，20 服务器 88 VM）、4 个 FDC（Core Ultra 7 / Xeon D-1746TER / Gold 6430，各 5 服务器 20 VM）、500 边缘设备（半数智能手机 4 核 2000 MIPS/核，半数智能摄像机 6 核 2400 MIPS/核，3W 空闲、12W 峰值）；带宽 40 Mbps WiFi、150 Mbps MAN、100 Mbps WAN；6 秒能耗采样；统一使用同一负载预测器、碳强度模型与太阳能发电模型；基线为 CACSA、CAGWO、CASSA、PSOGA；指标为碳排放、SLA 违约率、Pareto 超体积（PHV）、95% 置信区间。

Result: 超参数敏感性（Fig.3）显示 PHV 对局部搜索参与比例与 episode 数不敏感，增大每 episode 步数因计算开销降低 PHV，遗传算子率取 1.0 时略有提升，最终配置为 30% 局部搜索参与率、10 episode、每 episode 1 步、遗传算子率 1.0。与 SOTA 对比（Fig.4）：基线碳排放约 25,000–26,000 gCO2，MERSEM-Carbon/Balanced 降至约 23,000（10–12% 降幅），MERSEM-SLA 约 23,500（8–10% 降幅）；基线 SLA 违约率 17–23%，MERSEM-SLA 降至 11–12%（相对最差基线降 35–45%），MERSEM-Balanced 接近且保持低排放，MERSEM-Carbon 约 18%。可扩展性（Fig.5）：负载从 100 增至 1100 作业/epoch，100 时各法相当（18,000–19,000 gCO2、违约 0–10%），500 时基线 25,000–26,000 gCO2 / 违约 20–25%，MERSEM 为 23,000–24,000 gCO2 / 15–18%；1100 时基线 35,000–36,000 gCO2 / 违约 40–45%，MERSEM-Carbon 约 32,000 gCO2（低 8–10%）、违约 40–43%。资源规模扩展（Fig.6，500 作业/epoch）：300 ED/2 FDC 时基线 20,500–21,800 gCO2、违约 20–24%，MERSEM 约 18,200–18,800 gCO2，MERSEM-SLA 违约 16%；900 ED/8 FDC 时基线 33,200–35,200 gCO2、违约 13–17%，MERSEM-Carbon 约 32,000 gCO2，MERSEM 各变体违约降至 6–7%。GNN 负载实验（Fig.7，CORA+GraphSAGE、Amazon+GCN、CiteSeer+GAT 及混合场景，每 epoch 500 作业）显示 MERSEM-Balanced 在小/混合/大负载下碳排放均低于最优基线 CACSA，且在混合与大负载下 SLA 违约显著降低，小负载下改善幅度较小但仍占优。

Conclusion: MERSEM 通过显式建模 DAG 结构、有限并行度与通信敏感性，联合优化应用级 SLA 合规与运行碳排放，填补了碳感知资源管理中“忽视 SLA 与图结构”的空白；进化种群搜索提供全局多样性，RL 引导的局部搜索提供自适应细化，兼顾探索与利用，并可按权重配置输出 SLA 优先、碳优先或均衡三类可部署策略。相对最佳 SOTA 实现最多 45% 的 SLA 违约下降与 12% 的碳排放下降，在负载强度、设备数量与雾基础设施规模增长时保持可扩展性与鲁棒性。局限与后续方向：基于仿真（EdgeCloudSim）评估、权重为标量化而非显式 Pareto 前沿演化、状态表示粒度较粗且动作仅 5 档扰动强度、假设集中式编排器全知且有负载预测器、缺少真实硬件与真实电力碳强度数据验证；未来可引入深度 RL/分布式编排、在线碳强度预测与多代理扩展、硬 SLA 约束下的 Pareto 前沿直接优化，以及在真实边云系统上的部署验证。

Abstract: Graph analytics powers modern intelligent systems such as smart cities, cyber-physical infrastructure, IoT security, and large-scale social networks. As these workloads scale in complexity, their execution in heterogeneous edge-cloud environments results in higher energy use and carbon emission footprint. To address this challenge, we propose MERSEM, a multi-objective evolutionary reinforcement learning framework for sustainable edge-cloud system management. MERSEM integrates evolutionary search with reinforcement learning (RL) to solve the problem of graph workload allocation and scheduling. The evolutionary component explores diverse global solutions, while the RL agent refines decisions through adaptive local optimization. The framework is designed to jointly minimize service-level agreement (SLA) violations and carbon emissions by considering dynamic carbon intensity, resource heterogeneity, and workload characteristics. Experimental results demonstrate that MERSEM outperforms the state-of-the-art with up to 45% SLA violation reductions and up to 12% carbon emission reductions.

</details>


### [348] [MARLIN: Multi-Agent Game-Theoretic Reinforcement Learning for Sustainable LLM Inference in Cloud Datacenters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13496)
*H. Moore,S. Qi,D. Milojicic,C. Bash,S. Pasricha*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出MARLIN框架，利用多智能体博弈论强化学习协同优化大语言模型推理的多个指标，包括首token响应时间(TTFT)、碳排放、水资源消耗和能源成本，在云数据中心环境中实现显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理请求占LLM整个生命周期能源消耗的90%，远超训练成本；随着LLM服务请求量增长，碳排放和水资源消耗等环境足迹问题日益严峻，亟需在保证服务质量的同时实现可持续发展的推理服务框架。

Method: 提出名为MARLIN的多智能体博弈论强化学习框架，通过协同优化四个关键指标（TTFT、碳排放、水资源使用和能源成本）来管理LLM推理服务。

Result: 相比当前最先进的LLM推理管理框架，MARLIN实现了：TTFT降低至少18%、碳排放降低33%、水资源使用降低43%、能源成本降低11%。

Conclusion: MARLIN框架能有效平衡LLM推理服务的性能与可持续性，为云数据中心环境下的绿色AI服务提供了可行的技术方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become increasingly prevalent in cloud-based platforms, propelled by the introduction of AI-based consumer and enterprise services. LLM inference requests in particular account for up to 90% of total LLM lifecycle energy use, dwarfing training energy costs. The rising volume of LLM inference requests is increasing environmental footprints, particularly carbon emissions and water consumption. To improve sustainability for LLM inference serving in cloud datacenter environments, we propose a novel multi-agent game-theoretic reinforcement learning framework called MARLIN to co-optimize time-to-first token (TTFT), carbon emissions, water usage, and energy costs associated with LLM inference. MARLIN demonstrates a reduction of at least 18% in TTFT, 33% in carbon emissions, 43% in water usage, and 11% in energy costs compared to state-of-the-art LLM inference management frameworks.

</details>


### [349] [KVServe: Service-Aware KV Cache Compression for Communication-Efficient Disaggregated LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13734)
*Zedong Liu,Xinyang Ma,Dejun Luo,Hairui Zhao,Bing Lu,Wenjing Huang,Yida Gu,Xingchen Liu,Zheng Wei,Jinyang Liu,Dingwen Tao,Guangming Tan*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: KVServe 是首个面向分离式 LLM 服务的"服务感知、自适应"KV 通信压缩框架。它把各类 KV 压缩方法抽象为可组合的模块化策略空间（Transformer/Quantizer/Codec），通过贝叶斯优化（高斯过程）离线搜索并蒸馏出 Acc-CR-Latency 三维 Pareto 候选集（离线搜索开销从 ~1000 小时降至 ~20 小时，50× 缩减），再在运行时用解析延迟模型（O(1) 分段最优查表 + 带宽收益阈值过滤）叠加轻量级残差修正 bandit，在 SLO 与质量约束下按请求选择压缩 profile。集成 vLLM 后，PD 分离场景 JCT 最高加速 9.13×，KV 卸载/前缀缓存场景 TTFT 最高降低 32.8×。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分离式推理（PD 分离、KV 状态卸载）把 KV cache 从 GPU 内部状态变成跨网络/存储边界的显式负载，通信成为端到端瓶颈：实测 KV 通信占 JCT 最高 60%（PD 分离，10–50 Gbps），远端 KV 池场景占端到端时间最高 66%（5–15 Gbps）；Llama3.1-70B 在 128K 上下文下产生 39.06 GB KV，Qwen3-235B 32K 请求在 64 节点 prefill 集群需 2.1 Tbps 出口带宽，而云上跨集群带宽常低于 100 Gbps、远端存储常低于 10 Gbps。

现有 KV 压缩（CacheGen、KIVI、KVQuant、DuoAttention、MixHQ 等）均为静态运行时配置，论文用两组实验证明其不可靠：
1) 工作负载依赖性：KIVI 在 Qasper 上准确率最好却在 GSM8K/HumanEval 垫底，DuoAttention 反之；CacheGen 压缩比在 Multi-News 达 6.20× 但 HumanEval 仅 3.98×（低于 MixHQ 的 5.36×）。
2) 带宽依赖性：最优策略随带宽切换（CacheGen 在极低带宽最优，随后被 MixHQ、KIVI 反超），且每种 profile 只在特定带宽区间有益——CacheGen/MixHQ/KIVI 的"负优化"阈值分别为 50/55/110 Gbps，超过阈值压缩反而慢于不压缩。

由此提出核心论点：KV 压缩不是固定的算法选择，而是"受约束、服务状态相关的策略选择问题"。三大挑战：(1) 现有方法代码与参数接口紧耦合，难以即插即用组合；(2) 抽象为可搜索策略空间后组合爆炸（约 10^4 候选，单次端到端 profiling 约 15 分钟，穷举需数十至数百 GPU 小时）；(3) 在线选择缺乏能联合刻画延迟与质量、在 SLO/质量预算下可解释的决策模型。

Method: 问题建模：以请求为决策粒度，服务上下文 c=(w, B, T_SLO, q_min)，w 为会话段工作负载标签（由上层路由器提供），B 为有效带宽（应用层 goodput 而非标称链路带宽）；策略三元组 p=(cr_p, s_p, q_p)，其中 s_p 为编解码吞吐的调和平均。段级 JCT 模型：T_p(c)=T_model(w)+V/s_p+V/(B·cr_p)，无压缩基线 T_0(c)=T_model(w)+V/B；可行集 P(c)={p | T_p(c)≤T_SLO, q_p(w)≥q_min}，优化目标为在可行集上最小化 T_p(c)。

三大组件：
(1) Modular Strategy Pool：统一流水线 BS=C(Q(T(X)))，Transformer 模块（Delta、Hadamard、Affine）、Quantizer（多维量化、layer-wise/head-wise 混合精度）、Codec（nvCOMP）；将 CacheGen、KIVI、DuoAttention 等拆解为可插拔组件以枚举笛卡尔积组合。新组件 MixHQ：区分 Retrieval Heads 与 Streaming Heads，对后者做超低位宽量化而非直接剪枝，保留长程依赖的高精度检索头，并可沿 layer（PyramidKV）/token（SnapKV）维度泛化，与重要性估计方法正交。

(2) Bayesian Profiling Engine：把问题形式化为约束黑箱优化 max CR(c) s.t. Acc(c)≥Acc_ths。用高斯过程 BO，自定义采集函数 α(c)=CR(c)·P(Feasible)+λ_t·σ_norm(c)，λ_t 指数衰减；异构参数编码（One-Hot + Min-Max）；双向剪枝（不可行时剔除更高 CR 候选，可行时剔除更低 CR 候选）；早停机制。输出 Acc-CR-Latency 三维 Pareto 前沿作为运行时静态查表。

(3) Service-Aware Online Controller：解析延迟模型层——定理 6.1 给出收益带宽阈值 B*_p=(1−1/cr_p)·s_p，压缩有益当且仅当 B<B*_p；定理 6.2 证明在 x=1/B 上最优 profile 是分段常数（各直线 T̃_p(x)=1/s_p+x/cr_p 的下包络），离线构建每质量桶的分段策略表，线上 O(1) 查表。残差修正 bandit 层：以模型最优 profile 及 1–2 个相邻下包络 profile 构成 2–3 个候选的微型环境，维护 EWMA 残差 δ̄=(1−α)δ̄+α(T_obs−T̂_p)，以 T_eff=T̂_p+δ̄ 做 ε-greedy 选择；安全护栏包括保守可行过滤（T̂_p≤T_SLO，空集回退保守配置）与违规冷却机制（最近 M 次使用中违规超 K 次则临时移除）。

三阶段运行：离线 profiling → 在线选择 → 运行时服务。实现于 vLLM 0.10.1，将压缩流水线注入通信路径，并集成 lm-eval-harness 评估精度。

Result: 端到端性能：跨硬件层级与数据集，KVServe 始终取得最低 JCT，带宽受限设备上最高 3.15× 加速；长上下文任务 HotpotQA 上达 9.13× JCT 降低；在 GSM8K/HumanEval 等短上下文负载上，静态基线因 (反)解压开销超过通信收益出现负优化，而 KVServe 通过理论过滤非有益 profile 使性能收敛到不压缩基线。PD 分离场景 5 Gbps 下最高 9.2× 加速，且随带宽上升自动切换低开销策略维持最优下界。

KV 卸载/前缀缓存场景：5–15 Gbps 全区间稳定满足严格 SLO，CacheGen 在 5–6 Gbps 因找不到可行配置回退到重算（高延迟），KVServe 峰值相对重算 TTFT 降低 32.8×。

精度与压缩效率（Qwen2.5-7B，97% 相对精度约束）：KVServe-Unified 平均相对精度 98.20%、平均 CR 7.42×；KVServe-Aware 平均相对精度 100.35%、平均 CR 8.28×，Multi-News 峰值 10.12×，在 2WikiMQA/HotpotQA 等未见数据集上仍保持高保真。基线：CacheGen 精度崩塌明显（HumanEval 仅 57.32%，源于 Qwen2.5 Key/Value 投影含 bias 导致分布非零中心、不适合均匀映射），平均 CR 6.17× 但精度仅 65.76%；KIVI 精度稳定（97.43%）但受细粒度分组元数据开销限制 CR 上限约 5.33×，实际 4.40×；DuoAttention 剪枝式在激进压缩下精度损失大，CR 仅 3.10×。

延迟分解：Default 基线通信占 JCT 82–90%，KVServe 将通信占比降至 6–9%，系统从网络受限转回算力受限；在线控制开销每次决策 <1 ms。消融：完整 BO 在 194 次迭代内收敛到全局最优 9.31× CR，w/o Enc/Exp 陷入局部最优（8.96×/8.53×），w/o Prune/Stop 需耗尽 300 次迭代；带宽波动（0–60 s，20–40 s 骤降）下 w/o Controller 出现近 0.9 s 延迟尖峰，w/o Bandit 持续偏高，完整系统稳定在约 0.3 s。

Conclusion: 论文将 KV 压缩从"固定算法选择"重构为"受约束、服务状态依赖的控制问题"，并给出首个统一框架实现：模块化可组合策略空间（含新组件 MixHQ）、高效贝叶斯离线搜索产出三维 Pareto 候选集、解析延迟模型 + 残差修正 bandit 的在线控制器在 SLO 与质量约束下做到 O(1) 决策且对离线-在线失配鲁棒。实证表明该框架能同时避免静态压缩的"负优化"，在 PD 分离与 KV 状态解耦两类服务形态下取得数量级级别的端到端收益，且几乎不引入在线控制开销。作者认为同一原则可推广至参数卸载、嵌入检索等更多网络化状态搬运场景，为分离式 LLM 服务建立了服务感知的 KV 优化基础。局限方面：实验依赖上层路由器提供工作负载标签（作者声明非强假设）、质量评估依赖 lm-eval-harness 离线打分、profiling 需数百次端到端运行（数十分钟到小时级）、MixHQ 与下包络理论在极端非平稳漂移下的理论保证较弱。

Abstract: LLMs are widely adopted in production, pushing inference systems to their limits. Disaggregated LLM serving (e.g., PD separation and KV state disaggregation) improves scalability and cost efficiency, but it also turns KV into an explicit payload crossing network and storage boundaries, making KV a dominant end-to-end bottleneck. Existing KV compression are typically static runtime configurations, despite production service context varies over time in workload mix, bandwidth, and SLO/quality budgets. As a result, a fixed choice can be suboptimal or even increase latency. We present \emph{KVServe}, the first service-aware and adaptive KV communication compression framework for disaggregated LLM serving: KVServe (1) unifies KV compression into a modular strategy space with new components and cross-method recomposition; (2) introduces Bayesian Profiling Engine that efficiently searches this space and distills a 3D Pareto candidate set, reducing $50\times$ offline search overhead; and (3) deploys a Service-Aware Online Controller that combines an analytical latency model with a lightweight bandit to select profiles under constraints and correct offline-to-online mismatch. Integrated into vLLM and evaluated across datasets, models, GPUs and networks, KVServe achieves up to $9.13\times$ JCT speedup in PD-separated serving and up to $32.8\times$ TTFT reduction in KV-disaggregated serving.

</details>

### [350] [Beyond Centralization: User-Controlled Federated Recommendations in Practice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12527)
*Manel Slokom,Alejandro Bellogin*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本研究在一个53天、22人参与的联邦推荐系统部署中证明，隐私保护、用户控制与有效个性化三个目标可以同时实现，用户愿意主动调节推荐策略且满意度较高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推荐系统需要集中化用户数据，限制了用户对推荐目标的控制能力，并引发隐私问题，亟需探索在保护隐私前提下保持有效推荐质量的方法。

Method: 在53天内部署实验中，22名用户与8807个标题的目录进行交互，可以在个性化和多样性增强排序之间切换，通过CTR、满意度评分和设置变更次数等指标评估用户行为。

Result: 用户在被给予明确选择时偏好个性化（65.37% vs 62.07% CTR），积极使用控制机制（满意度3.93/5，248次设置变更），并通过即时反馈理解交互对推荐的影响。

Conclusion: 联邦学习可以在保护用户隐私的同时实现有效的个性化推荐，且用户愿意主动使用控制机制来平衡个性化与多样性，验证了交互式隐私保护推荐系统的可行性。

Abstract: Recommendation systems typically require centralized user data, limiting user control and raising privacy concerns. Federated learning offers an alternative by keeping data on-device, but its impact on real user behavior remains largely unexplored. We present a live federated recommender system that allows users to control the recommendation objective while keeping their data local. In a 53-day deployment with 22 participants and a catalog of 8807 titles, users interacted with recommendations and switched between personalization and diversity-enhanced ranking. We find that users prefer personalization when given explicit choice (65.37\% vs.\ 62.07\% CTR), actively engage with control mechanisms (3.93/5 satisfaction; 248 settings changes), and develop an understanding of how their interactions affect recommendations through immediate feedback. Our results show that user control, privacy, and effective personalization can be combined in a working system. We demonstrate a practical approach to interactive, privacy-preserving recommendation. Code and demo materials are available at: https://github.com/SlokomManel/federated-recommendations-participants

</details>


### [351] [MLPs are Efficient Distilled Generative Recommenders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12617)
*Zitian Guo,Yupeng Hou,Clark Mingxuan Ju,Neil Shah,Julian McAuley*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文针对生成式推荐模型中高推理延迟问题，提出基于MLP蒸馏的SID-MLP框架，绕过attention机制直接预测SID tokens，在保持精度的同时实现8.74倍加速，并可作为即插即用的加速器应用于不同模型架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Generative recommendation models using Semantic IDs (SIDs) suffer from high inference latency due to beam-expanded autoregressive decoding. Standard attention-heavy Transformer decoders are structurally overkill for this task because the hierarchical nature of SIDs makes prediction difficulty drop sharply after the first token, rendering repeated attention computations highly redundant.

Method: SID-MLP: A lightweight MLP-centric distillation framework that captures global user context in a single operation (decoupled from sequential token prediction), then distills the heavy autoregressive teacher into position-specific MLP heads, eliminating dense attention overhead while preserving prefix and context dependencies. SID-MLP++ extends this by replacing the Transformer encoder for further latency reduction.

Result: SID-MLP matches teacher model accuracy while achieving 8.74x inference speedup. The distillation strategy serves as a plug-and-play accelerator for different backbones and tokenizer settings.

Conclusion: Decoder-side MLPs distillation is an effective acceleration path for structured SID recommendation; full encoder replacement offers an additional speed-accuracy trade-off. SID-MLP++ provides further latency reduction by replacing the Transformer encoder.

Abstract: Generative recommendation models employing Semantic IDs (SIDs) exhibit strong potential, yet their practical deployment is bottlenecked by the high inference latency of beam-expanded autoregressive decoding. In this work, we identify that standard attention-heavy Transformer decoders represent a structural overkill for this task: the hierarchical nature of SIDs makes prediction difficulty drops sharply after the first token, rendering repeated attention computations highly redundant. Driven by this insight, we propose SID-MLP, a lightweight MLP-centric distillation framework that fundamentally simplifies the decoding paradigm for GR. Instead of executing complex, step-by-step attention mechanisms, our approach captures the global user context in a single operation, decoupled from sequential token prediction. We then distill the heavy autoregressive teacher into position-specific MLP heads, eliminating the dense attention overhead while preserving prefix and context dependencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SID-MLP matches the accuracy of teacher models while accelerating inference by 8.74x. Crucially, this distillation strategy can serve as a plug-and-play accelerator for different backbones and tokenizer settings. Furthermore, we introduce SID-MLP++, extending our distillation framework to replace the Transformer encoder, unlocking further latency reductions. Ultimately, our work reveals that decoder-side MLPs distillation is an effective acceleration path for structured SID recommendation, while full encoder replacement offers an additional speed--accuracy trade-off.

</details>


### [352] [EcoGEO: Trajectory-Aware Evidence Ecosystems for Web-Enabled LLM Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12887)
*Hengwei Ye,Jiasheng Mao,Zhenhan Guan,Zheng Tian*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出「生态系统级生成式引擎优化」（EcoGEO）视角，并给出实例化方法 TRACE：一个面向 Web 联网 LLM 搜索智能体的「轨迹感知协同证据生态系统」。作者构建了含 3,124 个「查询-虚拟产品」对的开源商品推荐基准 OPR-Bench，在 GPT-5.1 搜索智能体、5 次搜索 + 5 次爬取预算下对比单页基线与三种页面级 GEO 基线（C-SEO、E-GEO、AutoGEO）。TRACE 在三个数据集上的最终目标推荐率分别为 67.2%/71.9%/73.9%，较各数据集最强基线绝对提升 31.3/15.7/14.9 个百分点；轨迹指标显示首轮目标结果爬取率、目标定向二次搜索率与内链爬取率均显著上升，消融实验进一步分离出「多页协同」与「导航入口设计」两项贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GEO（生成式引擎优化）研究基本停留在「单网页」视角：如何改写/结构化一个页面以提升其在生成式引擎答案中的可见性、引用率或答案包含率。但联网 LLM 智能体的搜索并非单文档场景：它会多轮发起查询、抓取页面、沿链接跳转、reformulate 查询，并跨多步综合证据。因此影响不仅取决于页面内容本身，还取决于页面在搜索结果中的呈现方式、页面之间的链接组织与相互一致性、以及智能体沿「浏览轨迹」何时、以何种顺序遭遇这些证据。作者主张把 GEO 提升为「环境级/轨迹级」问题（Ecosystem GEO）。此外，真实开放网络评测需要把虚构产品发布到公网，既不安全也不可复现，因此需要受控的合成评测环境与基准。

Method: 1）形式化建模：将智能体-网页交互形式化为动作序列 a_t ∈ {Search, Crawl, Answer}，历史 H_t 由查询、搜索结果列表 R^(k)（标题/链接/摘要）与已抓取页面集合构成，Answer 基于 H_T 生成最终回答。2）OPR-Bench：从 SafeSearch、E-Commerce、E-GEO 三个公开查询源用统一意图过滤规则（保留开放式推荐/对比/选购意图，剔除品牌指称、方法类、日期/站点限定等）筛出 3,124 条查询，为每条查询构造一个「虚构但合理」的目标产品 (P_name, P_desc)，主实验在 E-GEO 上使用前 1,000 条。3）TRACE：构建证据图 G_P=(V_P,E_P)，含一个「导航入口页」v_0 与六类角色化支撑页（官方页、评测页、专家文章、新闻页、论坛帖、社交帖），通过属性一致性（统一名称/品类/特性/用途/限制，防身份漂移）与跨页互引（内链 + 引用式链接）实现协同；入口页以「购买指南/评测/对比」式词汇撰写，承担从搜索结果到证据空间的导航枢纽角色。4）受控暴露协议「9+1」：每次搜索返回 9 条 Google 真实结果 + 第 5 位插入 1 条合成目标相关结果；非目标定向的后续搜索同样插入由 bge-reranker-v2-m3 语义打分选出的最相关支撑页，目标定向查询则仅在生态内支撑页池中做生态内检索返回 Top-10。5）页面实现：按信息源类型设计专用 HTML 模板，实验中直接用 Markdown 实例化（与 Crawl4AI 抓取输出格式等价），摘要由页面正文经 Tantivy 检索式抽取（≤150 字符）。6）评测：GPT-5.1 温度 0，10 步工具交互，2–5 次搜索 + 2–5 次爬取，Crawl4AI 解析，最终答案由 GPT-5.4-mini 判定；指标含目标推荐率、首轮目标结果爬取率、目标定向二次搜索率、后续目标结果爬取率、内链爬取率。7）消融：在强制首轮抓取同一页面的条件下比较 Uncoordinated（评审页入口 + 独立支撑页）/Coordinated（评审页带引用链接且支撑页互链）/TRACE（导航型入口）。

Result: 最终推荐率上 TRACE 全面领先：SafeSearch 67.2（基线最高 35.9，+31.3pp）、E-Commerce 71.9（+15.7pp）、E-GEO 73.9（+14.9pp）。轨迹层面：首轮目标结果爬取率由 27.0–43.8 提升至 42.2–61.2；目标定向二次搜索率由 7.8–20.3 提升至 21.9–29.7；内链爬取率 9.4–20.4%，而所有基线均为不适用/0，即只有 TRACE 能驱使智能体沿网页内链进入多页证据网络。值得注意的是 TRACE 在「后续目标结果爬取率」上并非最高（单页基线因重复指向同一页反而更高，如 E-GEO 24.9% vs 31.9%），说明延迟接触单一目标页不足以转化为推荐结论；页面级 GEO 改写也未稳定优于未优化的单页基线，原因是其收益仅体现于爬取后的正文与短摘要，无法支撑多源交叉验证类的轨迹行为。消融（强制首爬）在两个小数据集上显示：Uncoordinated→Coordinated 提升（SafeSearch 75.0→82.8，E-Commerce 81.8→87.6）来自多页协同与互链；Coordinated→TRACE 再提升（→89.1 / 93.4）且内链爬取率跃升至 29.7%/25.6%，归因于导航型入口设计。

Conclusion: 研究结论支持一种「生态系统/轨迹级」的 GEO 研究范式：联网 LLM 智能体的可影响单位不是孤立网页，而是由入口点、跨页连通性与证据组织共同构成的受控证据环境；TRACE 的增益主要来自重塑智能体的证据获取过程（更早接触目标、更多目标定向再检索、更多内链遍历）而非单纯增加目标相关内容量，而多页协同与导航入口设计是其中两个可分离的关键因素。局限包括：使用虚构产品与合成受控环境，无法反映真实排名波动、自然发现、内容时序变化与商业来源交互；仅覆盖一种协同证据生态家族；尚未考察支撑页规模、页式多样性、入口位次、跨链密度、摘要设计与后续搜索行为的影响，未来需研究如何促使智能体跨更多独立来源交叉验证的防御机制。伦理上，全部页面与环境均为合成，仅用于受控评估，不主张应用于真实系统或公网平台，完整代码出于安全原因不公开，基准数据将在论文接收后开放。

Abstract: Web-enabled LLM agents are changing how online information influences search outcomes. \ Existing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) studies mainly focus on individual webpages. \ However, agentic web search is not a single-document setting: an agent may issue queries, crawl pages, follow links, reformulate searches, and synthesize evidence across multiple browsing steps. \ Influence therefore depends not only on page content, but also on how pages are organized, connected, and encountered along the agent's browsing trajectory. \ We study this shift through \textbf{Ecosystem Generative Engine Optimization} (\textbf{EcoGEO}), which treats GEO as an environment-level influence problem for web-enabled LLM agents. \ To instantiate this perspective, we propose \textbf{TRACE}, a \textbf{Trajectory-Aware Coordinated Evidence Ecosystem}. \ Given a recommendation query and a fictional target product, our method builds a controlled evidence environment that coordinates an agent-facing navigation entry page with heterogeneous support pages. \ These pages use shared terminology, internal links, and consistent product attributes to introduce, verify, and reinforce the target product. We evaluate our method on OPR-Bench, a benchmark for open-ended product recommendation. \ Experiments show that it consistently outperforms page-level GEO baselines in final target recommendation. \ Trajectory-level metrics further show increased initial target-result crawls, target-specific follow-up searches, and internal-link crawls, suggesting that the gains come from shaping the agent's evidence-acquisition process rather than merely adding more target-related content. \ Overall, our findings support an ecosystem research paradigm for GEO, where web-enabled LLM agents are studied in relation to the broader evidence environments that guide search, browsing, and answer synthesis.

</details>


### [353] [Same Image, Different Meanings: Toward Retrieval of Context-Dependent Meanings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.12905)
*Ayuto Tsutsumi,Ryosuke Kohita*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出L1-L4框架来组织图像语义的抽象层级，研究叙事语境如何影响图像检索。结果表明：具体语义（物体、动作）可在无语境情况下检索，而抽象语义（氛围、意图）高度依赖叙事植入；图像端语境注入比查询端更有效；但最抽象层级（L4）在全语境下仍具挑战性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 场景图像的意义高度依赖叙事上下文（如雨中场景在重逢故事中传递希望，在告别故事中传递悲伤），但现有检索系统缺乏处理这种语境依赖性的能力。

Method: 提出L1-L4语义抽象框架，从上下文无关（L1：物体）到最大上下文相关（L4：氛围/意图）；使用合成故事语境和查询进行控制实验；测试查询端与图像端语境注入对不同抽象层级检索效果的影响。

Result: 具体查询（L1-L2层）无需语境即可检索；抽象层级（L3-L4）检索性能随叙事语境注入而提升；图像端语境丰富化比查询端更有效；L4层即使在完整语境下仍具挑战性。

Conclusion: 语境依赖的图像检索是重要开放问题；L1-L4框架为构建能处理叙事场景中语境依赖意义的检索系统奠定基础。

Abstract: A scene of two people in the rain can convey hope and warmth in a reunion story or sorrow and finality in a farewell story. We investigate this context-dependent nature of image meaning and its implications for retrieval. Our key observation is that context dependency correlates with semantic abstraction: concrete elements (objects, actions) remain stable across contexts, while abstract elements (atmosphere, intent) shift with context. We operationalize this as the L1--L4 framework, organizing image semantics from context-independent (L1) to maximally context-dependent (L4). Using synthetic story contexts and queries for controlled evaluation, we examine how injecting narrative context into embeddings affects retrieval across abstraction levels. Concrete queries are retrievable without context, while abstract levels increasingly depend on narrative grounding. Where context is injected also matters, with image-side enrichment proving particularly effective. The most abstract level, however, remains challenging even with full context, highlighting context-dependent image retrieval as an important open problem. Our framework and findings lay groundwork toward retrieval systems that handle the context-dependent meanings images acquire in narrative settings.

</details>


### [354] [RAG-Enhanced Large Language Models for Dynamic Content Expiration Prediction in Web Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13052)
*Tingyu Chen,Wenkai Zhang,Li Gao,Lixin Su,Ge Chen,Dawei Yin,Daiting Shi*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于大语言模型的查询感知动态内容过期预测框架，用于百度搜索引擎。该框架将时效性重新定义为动态有效性推断任务，通过提取文档的细粒度时间上下文，利用LLM推断基于用户意图的查询特定"有效性范围"，并集成幻觉缓解策略以确保可靠性。离线和在线A/B测试验证了该方法在提升搜索新鲜度和用户体验指标方面的显著效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: In commercial web search, aligning content freshness with user intent is challenging due to highly varied information lifespans. Traditional industrial approaches rely on static time-window filtering, resulting in "one-size-fits-all" rankings where content may be chronologically recent but semantically expired.

Method: Proposed a novel LLM-based Query-Aware Dynamic Content Expiration Prediction Framework for Baidu search, which reformulates timeliness as a dynamic validity inference task. The framework extracts fine-grained temporal contexts from documents and leverages LLMs to deduce query-specific "validity horizons" - semantic boundaries defining information obsolescence based on user intent. Robust hallucination mitigation strategies are integrated to ensure reliability.

Result: Significant improvements in search freshness and user experience metrics were achieved, validated through both offline and online A/B testing on live production traffic.

Conclusion: LLM-driven reasoning can effectively solve semantic expiration problems at industrial scale, with significant improvements in search freshness and user experience metrics validated through offline and online A/B testing on Baidu search production traffic.

Abstract: In commercial web search, aligning content freshness with user intent remains challenging due to the highly varied lifespans of information. Traditional industrial approaches rely on static time-window filtering, resulting in "one-size-fits-all" rankings where content may be chronologically recent but semantically expired. To address the limitation, we present a novel Large Language Models (LLMs)-based Query-Aware Dynamic Content Expiration Prediction Framework deployed in Baidu search, reformulating timeliness as a dynamic validity inference task. Our framework extracts fine-grained temporal contexts from documents and leverages LLMs to deduce a query-specific "validity horizon"-a semantic boundary defining when information becomes obsolete based on user intent. Integrated with robust hallucination mitigation strategies to ensure reliability, our approach has been evaluated through offline and online A/B testing on live production traffic. Results demonstrate significant improvements in search freshness and user experience metrics, validating the effectiveness of LLM-driven reasoning for solving semantic expiration at an industrial scale.

</details>


### [355] [A Standardized Re-evaluation of Conversational Recommender Systems on the ReDial Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13053)
*Ivica Kostric,Krisztian Balog*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该研究对对话推荐系统领域进行了系统性复现研究，发现现有评估存在粒度差距、重复捷径误导和LLM能力混淆等问题，建议采用以新颖性和交互效率为导向的评估实践。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究在ReDial数据集上的预处理和实验使用方式存在差异（特别是ground-truth定义），加上LLM选择和外部数据等混杂因素，使得跨研究结果比较困难。

Method: 对三种架构家族的七个突出CRS方法在标准化条件下进行评估，并应用用户中心效用指标进行验证。

Result: 揭示了"粒度差距"现象；发现近50%的准确率来自重复捷径；证明性能收益更多源于LLM backbone能力而非特定架构创新；传统召回率常高估系统实际对话效果。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了透明、受控的基准，推动优先考虑新颖性和交互效率的评估实践。核心发现包括：1）细粒度排序对实现细节高度敏感；2）约50%的准确率来自"重复捷径"；3）性能提升主要源于LLM能力而非架构创新；4）传统召回率高估了实际对话效果。

Abstract: Recent years have seen a surge of research into conversational recommender systems (CRS). Among existing datasets, ReDial is the most widely used benchmark, cited in hundreds of studies. However, variations in how the dataset is preprocessed and used in experiments, particularly in the definition of ground-truth items, make it difficult to compare results across studies. These comparisons are further complicated by confounding factors such as the choice of the underlying large language model (LLM) and the use of external data sources. In this work, we revisit seven prominent CRS methods across three architectural families and evaluate them under standardized conditions. Our reproducibility study reveals a ``granularity gap,'' where fine-grained ranking (Recall@1) is highly sensitive to implementation details, while our replicability analysis shows that nearly 50% of reported accuracy stems from ``repetition shortcuts'' that are absent in novelty-focused evaluation. Furthermore, we find that performance gains are often driven more by the capacity of the LLM backbone than by specific architectural innovations. Finally, by applying user-centric utility metrics, we demonstrate that traditional recall frequently overstates a system's actual conversational effectiveness. This work establishes a transparent, controlled baseline and promotes evaluation practices that prioritize novelty and interaction efficiency.

</details>


### [356] [LeanSearch v2: Global Premise Retrieval for Lean 4 Theorem Proving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13137)
*Guoxiong Gao,Zeming Sun,Jiedong Jiang,Yutong Wang,Jingda Xu,Peihao Wu,Bryan Dai,Bin Dong*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出LeanSearch v2，一个用于Lean 4定理证明中全局前提检索的双模式系统。标准模式通过层次化Mathlib语料库和嵌入-重排序管道实现单查询检索（nDCG@10=0.62）；推理模式通过迭代循环实现全局前提检索，在69个基准测试中恢复46.1%的前提组。实验证明检索质量能有效传导至下游证明生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在Lean 4中证明定理需要识别一组分散的库引理，现有工具无法完整恢复整个定理所需的前提集。语义搜索引擎仅匹配单个声明，定理前提选择系统仅逐个 tactic 步骤预测，均无法解决"全局前提检索"问题。

Method: 标准模式：构建层次化形式化Mathlib语料库 + 嵌入-重排序管道；推理模式：基于标准模式作为检索底座，通过迭代"草图-检索-反思"循环实现全局前提检索。

Result: 标准模式达到nDCG@10=0.62（比次优系统0.53提升17%）；推理模式在69个研究级Mathlib定理基准测试中，10个候选内恢复46.1%的前提组（超过推理检索系统38.0%和前提选择基线9.3%）；下游证明生成任务中，使用LeanSearch v2的证明成功率达20%（次优16%，无检索仅4%）。

Conclusion: LeanSearch v2通过双模式架构（标准模式+推理模式）有效解决了全局前提检索问题，在数学库定理证明中显著提升前提发现效率，并验证了检索质量能有效传导至下游证明生成任务。

Abstract: Proving theorems in Lean 4 often requires identifying a scattered set of library lemmas whose joint use enables a concise proof -- a task we call global premise retrieval. Existing tools address adjacent problems: semantic search engines find individual declarations matching a query, while premise-selection systems predict useful lemmas one tactic step at a time. Neither recovers the full premise set an entire theorem requires. We present LeanSearch v2, a two-mode retrieval system for this task. Its standard mode applies a hierarchy-informalized Mathlib corpus with an embedding-reranker pipeline, achieving state-of-the-art single-query retrieval without domain-specific fine-tuning (nDCG@10 of 0.62 vs. 0.53 for the next-best system). Its reasoning mode builds on standard mode as its retrieval substrate, targeting global premise retrieval through iterative sketch-retrieve-reflect cycles. On a 69-query benchmark of research-level Mathlib theorems, reasoning mode recovers 46.1% of ground-truth premise groups within 10 retrieved candidates, outperforming strong reasoning retrieval systems (38.0%) and premise-selection baselines (9.3%) on the same benchmark. In a controlled downstream evaluation with a fixed prover loop, replacing alternative retrievers with LeanSearch v2 yields the highest proof success (20% vs. 16% for the next-best system and 4% without retrieval), confirming that retrieval quality propagates to proof generation. We have open-sourced all code, data, and benchmarks. Code and data: https://github.com/frenzymath/LeanSearch-v2 . The standard mode is publicly available with API access at https://leansearch.net/ .

</details>


### [357] [Task-Aware Automated User Profile Generation for Recommendation Simulation Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13497)
*Xinye Wanyan,Chenglong Ma,Danula Hettiachchi,Ziqi Xu,Jeffrey Chan*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 本文提出 APG4RecSim——一个免训练（training-free）、上下文自适应的用户画像自动生成框架，将用户交互历史自动转化为"任务可执行"的 LLM 智能体画像，用于推荐系统仿真评测。三阶段流程为：多视角属性抽取（3 次并行生成并集，高召回）→ 上下文感知语义整合（去重+对齐数据集 schema/任务描述/示例）→ 因果映射与精化（实例化任务决策路径，用反事实测试判定哪些属性真正影响决策并绑定到决策节点）。在 ML-1M、Amazon-Book、Amazon-Beauty 三个数据集的判别/排序/评分三类任务上，24 项指标中取得 16 项最优、7 项次优；相比现有画像生成基线，nDCG@10 最高提升约 7%，评分分布 JSD 降低约 8%；且对位置偏差、流行度偏差具有稳健性，并在不同 LLM 后端上保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 驱动的智能体仿真已成为推荐系统（RS）实时、严格评测的重要手段，典型框架包含画像模块（profile）、记忆模块（memory）、动作模块（action）三个核心组件，但既有研究几乎都聚焦记忆与动作设计，画像构建被默认为"人工、静态、弱评测"。其带来三大局限：(1) 刚性 schema 造成信息瓶颈——依赖人工属性清单的"闭世界"约束使智能体无法捕捉设计者分类体系之外潜在或演变的用户特质（如兴趣漂移、条件偏好）；(2) 行为失配——缺乏统计严谨的画像机制时，智能体缺少"指令锚点"，直接损害模拟行为真实性与模拟-真实交互的对齐；(3) 领域泛化性差——人工画像高度领域依赖，电商属性（价格、品牌）无法迁移到内容流媒体（类型、氛围），且属性粒度需与目标域元数据匹配。同时，针对推荐仿真专门设计的数据集稀缺，导致框架依赖手工画像，可扩展性与跨数据集泛化性受限。作者还指出属性是否"任务相关"至关重要（如电商的价格敏感度在社交媒体场景是噪声），需要结构化、上下文感知、与下游决策需求对齐的画像生成方法。为此提出三个研究问题：RQ1 如何在无人工 schema 下自动抽取潜在且任务相关的用户特质；RQ2 自动画像如何提升多任务下模拟与真实用户的行为对齐；RQ3 框架能否在统一受控协议下跨域、跨数据集、跨 LLM 泛化。

Method: **问题形式化**：用户历史 H_u={(i_k,r_k,t_k)}；任务对齐画像 P_u(T)=⟨I_meta（不可变标识）, A_dom（领域锚定的任务无关自然语言特质集）, G_policy(T)（任务特定决策策略）⟩，目标为映射 f: H_u → P_u(T)，以 g_ext / g_merge / g_map 分阶段分解实现。

**Stage 1 属性初始化与抽取**：不依赖单次生成以规避 LLM 随机性，并行初始化 N=3 份初步画像（经验上特质召回在 2–3 次即饱和），提示 LLM 解释历史中反复出现的交互模式而非预测未来物品，取并集得 A_raw——刻意过度完备、含冗余/同义改写/与词表不匹配项，以召回优先。

**Stage 2 上下文感知语义整合**：在显式上下文 C=⟨D_info（数据集 schema 与可用元数据字段）, T_desc（任务族与所需语义粒度）, E_shot（代表性输入-输出示例以校准术语）⟩ 条件下，用 LLM 语义合并完成 (i) 去重归一为标准描述符、(ii) 落地到数据集原生概念，输出任务无关的 A_dom。

**Stage 3 因果映射与精化**：为任务 T 实例化有序决策路径 Π(T)=[s_1..s_m]（如硬过滤→权衡比较→最终选择/评分），可由领域专家启发式模板或 LLM 条件生成；随后对每个属性 a 做反事实测试——仅替换 a 为最小扰动变体 a'、固定其余特质与候选集重跑，若该步预测（判别任务的选择集变化、排序任务的次序变化、评分任务的数值变化超阈值）改变，则判定 a 与 s_j 相关；从不触发反事实变化的特质被去优先级或进一步合并，保留经因果验证者，输出将特质绑定到决策步骤的 G_policy(T)，实现可控可解释的仿真。框架无需额外训练。

**实验设置**：数据集 MovieLens-1M、Amazon-Book、Amazon-Beauty（按时间排序，每用户前 80% 用于画像生成、后 20% 用于评测）；基线为 No Profile、Recent-Interaction（仅最近交互）、RecAgent（预定义性格/兴趣/行为属性+五类行为角色）、Agent4Rec（仅保留 LLM 抽取的品味与理由）、Semantic Merge（前两阶段消融版）；三类仿真任务——判别（候选 C=10，正例 P=1/3/5，Overlap Ratio）、排序（top-1 留一，nDCG@5/10、HR@3）、评分（10 个目标物品，微观 RMSE、宏观按评分分组的 JSD）；推理智能体为 gpt-4o-mini（temperature=0.1），刻意不装配记忆/动作/规划模块以隔离画像质量；采用严格行为画像策略，生成与推断阶段均排除性别、年龄、地区等人口属性以避免刻板偏见；固定上下文窗口（最近交互），5 次独立运行取平均；泛化实验使用 Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct、GPT-5.1、DeepSeek-V3.2。

Result: **主结果**：APG4RecSim 在 24 项指标中 16 项最优、7 项次优，整体表现最强且无单一维度明显牺牲。判别任务 9 个场景中 7 项最优（Amazon-Beauty 1:10 达 0.3300 对基线 0.15/0.10），Semantic Merge 常居次优。排序任务 ML-1M 上 nDCG@5=0.4300、nDCG@10=0.5850、HR@3=0.4165 均为最优；Amazon-Book 取得最高 nDCG@10=0.8105 并并列最佳 HR@3；Amazon-Beauty 各指标处于最优或近最优，验证跨域泛化。评分任务中除两个无画像设置外均取得最优综合表现，且"混合语义-因果"版本在三个域上 JSD 均为最低。整体相比基线 nDCG@10 最高提升约 7%、JSD 降低约 8%。分析显示：仅用空画像或原始历史的智能体会退化为"安全/中性"评分（几乎只给 3–5 分），微观 RMSE 低但宏观分布失真；结构化画像使智能体同时表达正负偏好，更贴近真实评分分布。

**初始化/上下文长度敏感性**：直接历史提示法随历史长度波动剧烈（Amazon-Book 在 15 个物品时峰值 0.641，降至 10 个时骤降 10.4% 至 0.537，延至 25 个降 4.7% 至 0.594），体现"冷启动"与"迷失于中间"现象；APG4RecSim 轨迹稳定，最短历史（5 个物品）下 overlap ≈0.62 对原始交互基线 ≈0.60，且中位数最高、四分位距最窄。

**跨 LLM 泛化**：24 项设置中 14 项最优、7 项次优，HR@3 在所有设置下均为最高；增益在开源模型（Llama-3.3-70B、DeepSeek-V3.2）上最显著，说明结构化画像可弥补小模型能力差距。

**偏差稳健性**：位置偏差实验（ML-1M 排序）APG4RecSim 中位 nDCG@5≈0.415 且均值最高、分布紧凑，基线方差大；流行度偏差实验（Amazon-Beauty 判别）Semantic Merge 与 APG4RecSim 的中位 Overlap Ratio 更高且更稳定，RecAgent 与纯交互基线最低且波动最大。

**参数化先验探查**（ML-1M 隔离属性消融）：随机负采样下仅给"流行度"即达 0.4900/0.7400，远超仅标题（0.2930/0.5390）与类型（0.2365/0.4955），多属性组合无稳定增益；改用流行度-评分匹配的 De-bias 采样后各配置性能全面塌缩、流行度优势消失（如仅流行度降至 0.3990/0.5395），说明随机采样下的相当部分性能来自全局统计伪线索而非语义推理或个人化信号，凸显受控评测的必要性。

Conclusion: APG4RecSim 将用户画像从推荐仿真中的"人工附属物"提升为一等研究对象，证明免训练、无需人工 schema 的上下文感知抽取 + 任务决策路径反事实映射，可在无需改动智能体架构的前提下显著改善模拟与真实用户的行为对齐，在排序、判别、评分三类任务上取得最均衡的整体表现，并能抑制智能体对全局流行度统计与呈现位置顺序的依赖，跨数据集与跨 LLM 稳定可迁移，为更通用、可解释、可靠的 LLM 智能体用户行为仿真奠定基础。

作者明确三点局限与未来方向：(1) LLM 参数化记忆与全局物品级线索（流行度/评分统计）可能混淆"画像驱动推理"的评估，未来需引入物品匿名化、合成数据集或曝光更少的领域等更强控制；(2) 框架刻意只聚焦画像生成与整合以隔离画像质量，未探索画像与长期记忆、规划模块、多步决策策略的交互，扩展至端到端智能体系统是重要后续工作；(3) 因果映射依赖 LLM 反事实推理，仍受模型随机性影响，可引入轻量统计/学习型因果估计器做混合式精化以提升稳定性。代码已开源于 https://github.com/WennyXY/APG4Sim。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agent simulation has emerged as a promising approach to meet the increasing demand for real-time and rigorous evaluation in modern recommender systems. A typical LLM-driven simulation framework comprises three essential components: the profile module, memory module, and action module. However, existing studies have primarily concentrated on enhancing the memory and action modules, with limited attention to profile generation, which plays a pivotal role in ensuring realistic agent behaviours and aligning simulated interactions with real user dynamics. Moreover, the scarcity of datasets specifically designed for recommendation simulations has led to heavy reliance on manually crafted profiles, significantly limiting the scalability and generalisability of simulation frameworks across different datasets. To address these challenges, this work proposes an Automated Profile Generation Framework for Recommendation Simulation, APG4RecSim, that constructs realistic, coherent, and robust user profiles with minimal supervision. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that APG4RecSim achieves the best overall performance on discrimination, ranking, and rating tasks, improving ranking quality by up to 7% in nDCG@10 and reducing rating distribution divergence by 8% in JSD compared to existing profile-generation baselines. Beyond overall performance gains, our results show that profiles generated by APG4RecSim are resilient to popularity- and position-induced biases and maintain stable performance across datasets and different LLMs.

</details>


### [358] [Granite Embedding Multilingual R2 Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13521)
*Parul Awasthy,Aashka Trivedi,Yushu Yang,Ken Barker,Yulong Li,Bhavani Iyer,Martin Franz,Meet Doshi,Riyaz Bhat,Vignesh P,Vishwajeet Kumar,Todd Ward,Abraham Daniels,Rudra Murthy,Madison Lee,Luis Lastras,Jaydeep Sen,Radu Florian*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: IBM发布多语言Granite Embedding R2模型系列，包含311M和97M参数两个基于ModernBERT架构的编码器模型，支持200+语言及编程代码检索，在多项多语言检索任务上达到SOTA性能，采用Apache 2.0开源许可。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有英语聚焦型R1模型无法满足企业级多语言场景需求，需扩展支持52种语言及编程代码，并扩展上下文窗口以处理更长文档；同时市场缺乏高质量、开源许可的小型多语言嵌入模型。

Method: 采用ModernBERT架构构建双编码器模型，扩展多语言词汇表；通过模型剪枝和词汇表选择压缩得到紧凑版；全尺寸版支持Matryoshka表征学习以实现灵活的嵌入维度；在企业级合规数据上进行训练并接受治理监督。

Result: 在多语言/跨语言文本检索、代码检索、长文档检索和推理检索数据集上均达到最先进的性能表现；97M参数紧凑模型成为100M参数以下开源多语言嵌入模型中检索得分最高者；上下文窗口扩展至32,768个token，相比R1提升64倍。

Conclusion: 发布两款基于ModernBERT的多语言嵌入模型（311M参数全尺寸版和97M参数紧凑版），均采用Apache 2.0许可协议发布。紧凑版在100M参数以下开源多语言嵌入模型中实现了最高检索得分，支持灵活的嵌入维度调节，适用于企业级负责任AI部署和研究应用。

Abstract: We introduce the multilingual Granite Embedding R2 models, a family of encoder-based embedding models for enterprise-scale dense retrieval across 200+ languages. Extending our English-focused R2 release, these models add enhanced support for 52 languages and programming code, a 32,768-token context window (a 64x expansion over R1), and state-of-the-art overall performance across multilingual and cross-lingual text search, code retrieval, long-document search, and reasoning retrieval datasets. The release consists of two bi-encoder models based on the ModernBERT architecture with an expanded multilingual vocabulary: a 311M-parameter full-size, and a 97M-parameter compact model built via model pruning and vocabulary selection that achieves the highest retrieval score of any open multilingual embedding model under 100M parameters. The full-size also supports Matryoshka Representation Learning for flexible embedding dimensionality. Both models are trained on enterprise-appropriate data with governance oversight, and released under the Apache 2.0 license at https://huggingface.co/collections/ibm-granite, designed to support responsible use and enable unrestricted research and enterprise adoption.

</details>


### [359] [Benchmarking the Open Science Data Federation services to develop XRootD best practices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.13593)
*Fabio Andrijauskas,Igor Sfiligoi,Frank Würthwein*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: 该文对构建在 Pelican 平台之上的全球科学数据分发网络 OSDF 所依赖的 XRootD/Pelican 传输栈进行了系统性基准测试：在国家研究平台（NRP）主机上覆盖不同文件大小、并行流数、不同地理距离的客户端，并对比 wget、curl、pelican 等独立客户端与 HTCondor 原生文件传输机制，最终给出一套可复用的测试方法与面向 XRootD/Pelican 团队的配置调优建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科研活动日益依赖算力与存储，数据共享成为关键环节。OSDF 旨在构建基于 Pelican 平台的全球科学数据分发网络，但 OSDF 的运行依赖于 XRootD 与 Pelican 两个项目，因此在各种配置条件下（限速、缓冲区配置、后端存储类型等）必须清楚 XRootD 的性能边界与限制行为。缺乏这份量化认知会导致部署时的错误配置、传输瓶颈与性能不可预期，因此需要通过基准测试刻画这些边界并形成可操作的最佳实践建议。

Method: 在 NRP（National Research Platform）主机上执行一组基准实验：改变文件大小与并行传输流数；采用来自不同距离（网络拓扑/地理距离）的客户端以评估网络距离对传输速率的影响；对照多种独立客户端（wget、curl、pelican）与 HTCondor 原生文件传输机制；在 XRootD 侧考察传输速率限制、缓冲区（buffer）配置以及存储类型（storage type）对性能的影响。作者将整套测试流程方法化，以便持续跟踪 XRootD 与 Pelican 层在不同场景下的表现。

Result: 文中给出了所执行的测试集合及其结果分析，并据此产出一系列推荐性结论（面向 XRootD 与 Pelican 团队的配置建议），例如在限速、缓冲区参数与存储类型选择上应如何取舍。摘要提供的文本仅说明已开展测试并给出建议，未列出具体数值指标。方法论本身被证明可用于持续监测 XRootD 与 Pelican 层在不同场景下的性能表现。

Conclusion: 通过这套基准测试方法，OSDF 能够明确 XRootD 在不同配置与网络条件下的性能上限与限制行为，从而为 XRootD/Pelican 团队提供可复用的调优建议，并为 OSDF 的部署与运维提供配置依据；该方法也可作为后续持续性能跟踪与回归监测的基线。需要注意的是，具体量化结果与建议细节需查阅论文全文（含表格/图表）才能获取。

Abstract: Research has become dependent on processing power and storage, one crucial aspect being data sharing. The Open Science Data Federation (OSDF) project aims to create a scientific global data distribution network based on the Pelican Platform. OSDF relies on the XRootD and Pelican projects. Nevertheless, OSDF must understand the XRootD limits under various configuration options, including transfer rate limits, proper buffer configuration, and storage type effect. We have thus executed a set of benchmarks to create a set of recommendations to share with the XRootD and Pelican teams. This work describes the tests and results performed using National Research Platform (NRP) hosts. The tests cover various file sizes and parallel streams and use clients from various distances from the server host. We also used several standalone clients (wget, curl, pelican) and the native HTCondor file transfer mechanisms. Applying the methodology creates a possibility to track how XRootD and the Pelican layer perform in different scenarios.

</details>
